intent: Analyze the batsman's strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate strike rate for each batsman overall and specifically in the death overs. Use CASE for phase definition. Compare these two metrics. Group by batsman. Use CTEs.
sql:
WITH MaxOverNumber AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_innings_over
    FROM df
),
BatsmanAggregatedStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS total_runs_overall,
        SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_overall,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (m.max_innings_over - 5) THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_death_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (m.max_innings_over - 5) THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls_death_overs
    FROM
        df AS d
    CROSS JOIN MaxOverNumber AS m
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    (total_runs_overall * 100.0) / NULLIF(total_balls_overall, 0) AS overall_strike_rate,
    (total_runs_death_overs * 100.0) / NULLIF(total_balls_death_overs, 0) AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM
    BatsmanAggregatedStats
WHERE
    total_balls_overall > 10
    AND total_balls_death_overs > 0;

intent: Analyze the trend of batsman strike rate over successive phases of the innings (e.g., powerplay, middle, death).
structure: Define innings phases using CASE on CEIL(overs). Calculate strike rate for each batsman within each phase. Group by batsman and phase. Use CTEs.
sql:
WITH PhaseStats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman, phase
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  phase,
  CASE WHEN total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate
FROM PhaseStats
WHERE total_balls > 10
ORDER BY batsman, 
  CASE phase
    WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3
  END;

intent: Analyze the consistency of boundary hitting by batsmen across different phases of the innings. Specifically, calculate the percentage of boundaries hit in the powerplay versus later overs.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE expressions to define powerplay (first 6 overs) and later overs based on CEIL(overs). Sum boundaries (fours + sixes) and total balls faced for each phase. Calculate boundary percentage for each phase. Use a CTE to organize phase calculations.
sql:
WITH phase_boundary_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_pp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_pp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_later,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_later
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN balls_pp > 0 THEN CAST(boundaries_pp AS REAL) * 100.0 / balls_pp ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_pp,
  CASE WHEN balls_later > 0 THEN CAST(boundaries_later AS REAL) * 100.0 / balls_later ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_later
FROM phase_boundary_stats
WHERE balls_pp > 0 OR balls_later > 0
ORDER BY boundary_percentage_later DESC;
description: Calculates the percentage of boundaries hit by each batsman during the powerplay (first 6 overs) and later overs, providing insight into their boundary-hitting consistency across different game stages. The results are ordered by the boundary percentage in later overs.

intent: Evaluate the strike rate of batsmen during the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate overall batsman stats (total runs, total balls). Use another CTE to calculate death over stats (runs, balls) based on CEIL(overs) being in the last 5 overs. Join these CTEs and calculate strike rates for both. Use COALESCE to handle batsmen appearing in only one of the phases.
sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
death_over_stats AS (
  SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(o.batsman, d.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN o.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(o.total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / o.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN d.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / d.death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_over_strike_rate
FROM overall_stats o
FULL OUTER JOIN death_over_stats d ON o.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE o.total_balls > 0 OR d.death_balls > 0
ORDER BY death_over_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Compare the wicket-taking and run-conceding efficiency of bowlers in the initial phase (first 6 overs) versus the middle phase (overs 7-12).
structure: Use two CTEs: one for initial phase stats (wickets, runs given) and one for middle phase stats. Both CTEs group by bowler. Use a full outer join to combine stats for all bowlers, and calculate wicket-to-run ratio for each phase. Handle division by zero.
sql:
WITH initial_phase AS (
  SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_initial, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_initial
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6
  GROUP BY bowler
),
middle_phase AS (
  SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_middle, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_middle
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 12
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(i.bowler, m.bowler) AS bowler,
  CASE WHEN i.runs_initial > 0 THEN CAST(i.wickets_initial AS REAL) / i.runs_initial ELSE NULL END AS wicket_run_ratio_initial,
  CASE WHEN m.runs_middle > 0 THEN CAST(m.wickets_middle AS REAL) / m.runs_middle ELSE NULL END AS wicket_run_ratio_middle
FROM initial_phase i
FULL OUTER JOIN middle_phase m ON i.bowler = m.bowler
WHERE i.runs_initial > 0 OR m.runs_middle > 0
ORDER BY bowler;
description: Compares the wicket-taking efficiency (wickets per run conceded) of bowlers in the initial phase (first 6 overs) versus the middle phase (overs 7-12). This helps identify bowlers who perform better or worse in different stages of the game regarding their wicket-taking ability relative to runs conceded.

intent: Calculate the percentage of boundaries scored by batsmen in the first 10 overs, considering only batsmen who have faced a significant number of balls.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate boundary runs (fours + sixes) and total runs for each batsman within the first 10 overs (CEIL(overs) <= 10). Filter this CTE to include only batsmen with a minimum total runs scored. Calculate the boundary percentage.
sql:
WITH first_10_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 10
  GROUP BY batsman
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) > 0
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_runs > 0 THEN CAST(boundary_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / total_runs ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage
FROM first_10_overs_stats
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 10;

intent: Analyze the bowling performance of a specific bowler by calculating their wickets and runs given in the death overs (last 5 overs) as a proportion of their total wickets and runs given in the match.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate total wickets and runs given for each bowler. Use another CTE to calculate death overs wickets and runs given (CEIL(overs) > max_over - 5). Join these CTEs using a full outer join. Calculate the percentage of death over wickets and runs given relative to their total. Include a placeholder for the bowler's name.
sql:
WITH total_bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler
),
death_over_stats AS (
  SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_wickets) AS death_wickets, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS death_runs
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(t.bowler, d.bowler) AS bowler,
  CASE WHEN t.total_runs > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / t.total_runs ELSE 0 END AS percentage_death_over_runs_given,
  CASE WHEN t.total_wickets > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_wickets AS REAL) * 100.0 / t.total_wickets ELSE 0 END AS percentage_death_over_wickets
FROM total_bowler_stats t
FULL OUTER JOIN death_over_stats d ON t.bowler = d.bowler
WHERE t.total_runs > 0 OR t.total_wickets > 0
AND COALESCE(t.bowler, d.bowler) = 'Azmatullah'
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Investigate the scoring pattern after a boundary: what is the average runs scored on the ball immediately following a four or a six, grouped by batsman.
structure: This query utilizes a CTE with a LAG window function to determine the runs scored on the previous ball. It then filters for instances where the previous ball was a boundary (4 or 6) and calculates the average runs scored on the current ball for each batsman.
sql:
WITH subsequent_ball_runs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS previous_ball_runs
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM subsequent_ball_runs
WHERE
  previous_ball_runs IN (4, 6)
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Identify bowlers who perform exceptionally well (high wickets per run conceded) in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their performance in the rest of the innings.
structure: This query uses CTEs to calculate the wickets and runs conceded by each bowler in two phases: death overs and non-death overs. It then calculates the wicket-to-run ratio for each phase and presents it side-by-side for comparison.
sql:
WITH death_phase AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_late,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_late
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    bowler
  HAVING
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) > 0
),
non_death_phase AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_early,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_early
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    bowler
  HAVING
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) > 0
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(d.bowler, n.bowler) AS bowler,
  CASE WHEN d.runs_late > 0 THEN CAST(d.wickets_late AS REAL) / d.runs_late ELSE NULL END AS wicket_run_ratio_death,
  CASE WHEN n.runs_early > 0 THEN CAST(n.wickets_early AS REAL) / n.runs_early ELSE NULL END AS wicket_run_ratio_non_death
FROM death_phase AS d
FULL OUTER JOIN non_death_phase AS n ON d.bowler = n.bowler
WHERE
  d.wickets_late > 0 OR n.wickets_early > 0
ORDER BY
  wicket_run_ratio_death DESC;

intent: Examine the change in a bowler's wickets taken per over from the first half to the second half of the innings.
structure: Uses CTEs to calculate wickets per over for the first half (first 10 overs) and the second half (remaining overs) of the innings. Then joins these CTEs to show the difference or ratio.
sql:
with first_half_wickets as (
    select
        bowler,
        cast(ceil(overs) as integer) as over_num,
        sum(bowler_wickets) as wickets_taken
    from df
    where ceil(overs) <= 10
    group by bowler, over_num
),
second_half_wickets as (
    select
        bowler,
        cast(ceil(overs) as integer) as over_num,
        sum(bowler_wickets) as wickets_taken
    from df
    where ceil(overs) > 10
    group by bowler, over_num
),
first_half_agg as (
    select bowler, sum(wickets_taken) as total_wickets_fh, count(*) as overs_fh from first_half_wickets group by bowler
),
second_half_agg as (
    select bowler, sum(wickets_taken) as total_wickets_sh, count(*) as overs_sh from second_half_wickets group by bowler
)
SELECT
    coalesce(fh.bowler, sh.bowler) as bowler,
    CASE WHEN fh.overs_fh > 0 THEN CAST(fh.total_wickets_fh AS REAL) / fh.overs_fh ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_over_fh,
    CASE WHEN sh.overs_sh > 0 THEN CAST(sh.total_wickets_sh AS REAL) / sh.overs_sh ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_over_sh,
    CASE WHEN fh.overs_fh > 0 AND sh.overs_sh > 0 THEN 
        (CAST(sh.total_wickets_sh AS REAL) / sh.overs_sh) - (CAST(fh.total_wickets_fh AS REAL) / fh.overs_fh)
    ELSE NULL END AS wickets_per_over_change
FROM first_half_agg fh
FULL OUTER JOIN second_half_agg sh ON fh.bowler = sh.bowler
WHERE (fh.overs_fh > 0 OR sh.overs_sh > 0) AND (fh.total_wickets_fh > 0 OR sh.total_wickets_sh > 0) -- Ensure bowler has wickets in at least one half
ORDER BY wickets_per_over_change DESC;

intent: Calculate the average number of balls faced by a batsman immediately after a bowler concedes a boundary.
structure: Uses CTEs to identify balls immediately following a boundary conceded by a bowler. Then groups by the batsman on that subsequent ball to calculate the average balls faced.
sql:
WITH numbered_balls AS (
    SELECT
        overs,
        batsman,
        batsman_bowls_faced, -- Added this column
        (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) AS is_boundary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overs) AS rn
    FROM df
),
max_rn_val AS (
    SELECT MAX(rn) + 1 AS max_rn FROM numbered_balls
),
boundary_info AS (
    SELECT
        nb.overs,
        nb.batsman,
        nb.batsman_bowls_faced, -- Propagated this column
        nb.is_boundary,
        nb.rn,
        -- Find the row number of the next boundary *after* this ball.
        -- If no boundary follows, use max_rn_val to include all subsequent balls until end of data.
        COALESCE(
            MIN(CASE WHEN nb.is_boundary THEN nb.rn END) OVER (ORDER BY nb.rn ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),
            (SELECT max_rn FROM max_rn_val)
        ) AS next_boundary_rn_after_this
    FROM numbered_balls nb
),
sequence_starters AS (
    SELECT
        bi.rn,
        bi.overs,
        bi.batsman,
        bi.batsman_bowls_faced, -- Propagated this column
        bi.is_boundary,
        bi.next_boundary_rn_after_this,
        LAG(bi.is_boundary, 1, FALSE) OVER (ORDER BY bi.rn) AS prev_is_boundary
    FROM boundary_info bi
),
-- Filter for balls that are immediately after a boundary.
-- These are the first balls of the 'balls faced after boundary' sequences.
valid_sequences AS (
    SELECT
        ss.rn AS sequence_start_rn,
        ss.batsman AS sequence_batsman,
        ss.next_boundary_rn_after_this AS sequence_end_rn -- This marks the next boundary event.
    FROM sequence_starters ss
    WHERE ss.prev_is_boundary IS TRUE
    -- Removed 'AND ss.is_boundary IS FALSE' to include sequences where the ball immediately after a boundary is also a boundary.
),
-- Now, for each valid_sequence, sum the balls faced by 'sequence_batsman'
-- from 'sequence_start_rn' up to 'sequence_end_rn' (exclusive).
balls_in_sequences AS (
    SELECT
        vs.sequence_batsman,
        SUM(nb.batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_faced_in_sequence -- Changed from COUNT(nb.rn) to SUM(nb.batsman_bowls_faced)
    FROM valid_sequences vs
    JOIN numbered_balls nb
        ON nb.rn >= vs.sequence_start_rn
        AND nb.rn < vs.sequence_end_rn
        AND nb.batsman = vs.sequence_batsman
    GROUP BY
        vs.sequence_batsman,
        vs.sequence_start_rn -- Group by sequence_start_rn to get individual sequence counts
)
-- Aggregate to get the average for each batsman and apply the count constraint.
SELECT
    sequence_batsman AS batsman,
    AVG(balls_faced_in_sequence) AS avg_balls_faced_after_boundary
FROM balls_in_sequences
GROUP BY
    sequence_batsman
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 5 -- Only include batsmen with at least 5 such instances
ORDER BY
    avg_balls_faced_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Analyze the variation in a batsman's strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate overall and death overs strike rates for each batsman using CTEs for clarity. Group by batsman, use CASE for death overs filtering, and calculate strike rates as a ratio. Compare the two strike rates.
sql:
WITH BattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_balls, 0) AS overall_strike_rate,
  CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(death_overs_balls, 0) AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM BattingStats
WHERE total_balls >= 10 AND death_overs_balls >= 5
ORDER BY death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Find the batsmen who have the highest strike rate immediately following a boundary (4 or 6).
structure: Use a CTE to lag the runs scored on the previous ball for each batsman, partitioned by batsman and ordered by overs. Then, calculate the strike rate for balls that immediately follow a boundary. Filter for batsmen with a sufficient number of such instances.
sql:
WITH batsman_runs_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS previous_ball_runs
  FROM df
),
post_boundary_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_after_boundary,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_after_boundary
  FROM batsman_runs_lag
  WHERE previous_ball_runs IN (4, 6)
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_balls_after_boundary > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs_after_boundary AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls_after_boundary ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_after_boundary
FROM post_boundary_stats
WHERE total_balls_after_boundary > 5
ORDER BY strike_rate_after_boundary DESC;

sql: WITH BowlerPhaseData AS ( SELECT bowler, CEIL(overs) AS over_number, bowler_wickets, bowler_runs_given FROM df WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 15 ), BowlerOverallStats AS ( SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_given_pp_mo, SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets_pp_mo FROM BowlerPhaseData GROUP BY bowler ), QualifiedBowlers AS ( SELECT bowler FROM BowlerOverallStats WHERE total_runs_given_pp_mo > 0 AND total_wickets_pp_mo > 0 ) SELECT bpd.bowler, CASE WHEN bpd.over_number <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay' WHEN bpd.over_number > 6 AND bpd.over_number <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs' END AS phase, SUM(bpd.bowler_wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bpd.bowler_runs_given), 0) AS wickets_per_run_given FROM BowlerPhaseData AS bpd INNER JOIN QualifiedBowlers AS qb ON bpd.bowler = qb.bowler GROUP BY bpd.bowler, phase ORDER BY bpd.bowler, CASE phase WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1 WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2 END;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in the initial phase of their innings versus later phases.
structure: Use a CASE statement to define phases based on CEIL(overs). Group by batsman and phase, calculating strike rate (runs/balls). Use CTEs to separate phase calculations and then a full outer join to combine them.
sql:
WITH initial_phase AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman, 
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_initial,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_initial
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 5
  GROUP BY batsman
),
middle_phase AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman, 
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_middle,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_middle
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > 5 AND CEIL(overs) <= 10
  GROUP BY batsman
),
late_phase AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_late,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_late
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > 10
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(i.batsman, m.batsman, l.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN i.balls_initial > 0 THEN CAST(i.runs_initial AS REAL) * 100 / i.balls_initial ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_initial,
  CASE WHEN m.balls_middle > 0 THEN CAST(m.runs_middle AS REAL) * 100 / m.balls_middle ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_middle,
  CASE WHEN l.balls_late > 0 THEN CAST(l.runs_late AS REAL) * 100 / l.balls_late ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_late
FROM initial_phase i
FULL OUTER JOIN middle_phase m ON i.batsman = m.batsman
FULL OUTER JOIN late_phase l ON COALESCE(i.batsman, m.batsman) = l.batsman
WHERE i.balls_initial > 0 OR m.balls_middle > 0 OR l.balls_late > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Compare the wicket-taking efficiency (wickets per run conceded) of bowlers in the initial phase versus the middle phase of the innings.
structure: Use two CTEs to calculate wickets and runs for each bowler in the initial (first 6 overs) and middle (overs 7-15) phases. Then, join these CTEs and calculate the wickets-per-run ratio for each phase.
sql:
WITH initial_phase AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_initial,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_initial
  FROM df
  WHERE ceil(overs) <= 6
  GROUP BY bowler
  HAVING SUM(bowler_runs_given) > 0
),
middle_phase AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_middle,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_middle
  FROM df
  WHERE ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15
  GROUP BY bowler
  HAVING SUM(bowler_runs_given) > 0
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(i.bowler, m.bowler) AS bowler,
  CASE WHEN i.runs_initial > 0 THEN CAST(i.wickets_initial AS REAL) / i.runs_initial ELSE 0 END AS wicket_run_ratio_initial,
  CASE WHEN m.runs_middle > 0 THEN CAST(m.wickets_middle AS REAL) / m.runs_middle ELSE 0 END AS wicket_run_ratio_middle
FROM initial_phase i
FULL OUTER JOIN middle_phase m ON i.bowler = m.bowler

WITH total_bowler_stats AS (

sql:
WITH phase_boundary_stats AS (

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate overall strike rate and death over strike rate separately. Join the CTEs and use conditional aggregation for strike rate calculation. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
death_over_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.batsman, d.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN o.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(o.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / o.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN d.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / d.death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_over_strike_rate
FROM overall_stats AS o
FULL OUTER JOIN death_over_stats AS d
  ON o.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
  o.total_balls > 0 OR d.death_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_over_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Analyze the performance of bowlers in the first powerplay (first 6 overs) by calculating their average runs conceded per ball.

sql:
WITH first_powerplay_stats AS (

intent: Examine the trend of batsman boundaries (fours and sixes) across different phases of an innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Use a CTE with CASE expressions to define three phases based on CEIL(overs). Calculate the total boundaries (fours + sixes) and total balls faced for each batsman within each phase. Then, compute the boundary percentage for each phase. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH phase_boundary_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_middle,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_late,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_middle,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_late
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN balls_early > 0 THEN CAST(boundaries_early AS REAL) * 100 / balls_early ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_early,
  CASE WHEN balls_middle > 0 THEN CAST(boundaries_middle AS REAL) * 100 / balls_middle ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_middle,
  CASE WHEN balls_late > 0 THEN CAST(boundaries_late AS REAL) * 100 / balls_late ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_late
FROM phase_boundary_stats
WHERE
  balls_early > 0 OR balls_middle > 0 OR balls_late > 0
ORDER BY
  boundary_percentage_late DESC;

intent: Analyze the trend of a batsman's scoring rate by comparing their strike rate in the first half of their innings versus the second half.
structure: CTEs for first and second halves, grouping by batsman, calculating sums for runs and balls, then averaging strike rates, and comparing these averages.
sql:
WITH distinct_over_numbers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CEIL(overs) AS over_num
    FROM df
),
ranked_over_numbers AS (
    SELECT
        over_num,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY over_num) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_distinct_overs
    FROM distinct_over_numbers
),
median_over_number AS (
    SELECT
        over_num AS median_val
    FROM ranked_over_numbers
    WHERE rn = CEIL(total_distinct_overs / 2.0)
    LIMIT 1
),
batsman_half_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT median_val FROM median_over_number) THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT median_val FROM median_over_number) THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS first_half_balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT median_val FROM median_over_number) THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT median_val FROM median_over_number) THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS second_half_balls
    FROM df AS d
    GROUP BY d.batsman
)
SELECT
    bhs.batsman,
    bhs.first_half_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(bhs.first_half_balls, 0) AS first_half_strike_rate,
    bhs.second_half_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(bhs.second_half_balls, 0) AS second_half_strike_rate
FROM batsman_half_stats AS bhs
WHERE bhs.first_half_balls > 0 AND bhs.second_half_balls > 0
ORDER BY bhs.batsman;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate overall strike rate and death overs strike rate for each batsman using SUM aggregations and CASE expressions for filtering death overs. Use CTEs to structure the calculation. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH max_over AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num FROM df
)
SELECT
    d.batsman,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.batsman_runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced), 0), 0) AS overall_strike_rate,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (m.max_over_num - 5) THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (m.max_over_num - 5) THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0),
    0) AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM
    df AS d,
    max_over AS m
GROUP BY
    d.batsman
ORDER BY
    death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

sql: WITH BoundaryMarkers AS (SELECT batsman, overs, (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) AS is_boundary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS ball_num, batsman_bowls_faced FROM df), BoundaryIntervals AS (SELECT batsman, ball_num AS boundary_start_ball_num, LEAD(ball_num) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS next_boundary_ball_num FROM BoundaryMarkers WHERE is_boundary = TRUE), BallsAfterBoundary AS (SELECT bi.batsman, bi.boundary_start_ball_num, SUM(bm.batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_faced_after_this_boundary FROM BoundaryIntervals bi JOIN BoundaryMarkers bm ON bm.batsman = bi.batsman AND bm.ball_num > bi.boundary_start_ball_num AND (bm.ball_num < bi.next_boundary_ball_num OR bi.next_boundary_ball_num IS NULL) GROUP BY bi.batsman, bi.boundary_start_ball_num) SELECT batsman, AVG(balls_faced_after_this_boundary) AS avg_balls_after_boundary FROM BallsAfterBoundary GROUP BY batsman

intent: Analyze the change in batsman strike rate from the first half to the second half of an innings.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate strike rates for the first and second halves of the innings separately. Use CASE statements and subqueries to define the halves. Then, join the results and calculate the difference.
sql:
WITH first_half AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_fh,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_fh
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) / 2 FROM df)
  GROUP BY batsman
),
second_half AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_sh,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_sh
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) / 2 FROM df)
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(fh.batsman, sh.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN fh.balls_fh > 0 THEN CAST(fh.runs_fh AS REAL) * 100 / fh.balls_fh ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_fh,
  CASE WHEN sh.balls_sh > 0 THEN CAST(sh.runs_sh AS REAL) * 100 / sh.balls_sh ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_sh,
  CASE WHEN fh.balls_fh > 0 AND sh.balls_sh > 0 THEN (CAST(sh.runs_sh AS REAL) * 100 / sh.balls_sh) - (CAST(fh.runs_fh AS REAL) * 100 / fh.balls_fh) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_change
FROM first_half AS fh
FULL OUTER JOIN second_half AS sh
  ON fh.batsman = sh.batsman
WHERE (fh.balls_fh > 0 OR sh.balls_sh > 0)
ORDER BY strike_rate_change DESC;

intent: Determine the bowler's wicket-taking efficiency by calculating wickets per run conceded in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Filter for death overs using CEIL(overs), group by bowler, calculate wickets and runs conceded, then compute wickets per run ratio. Uses a subquery to determine the last 5 overs.
sql:
WITH death_over_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS death_wickets,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS death_runs
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN death_runs > 0 THEN CAST(death_wickets AS REAL) / death_runs
    ELSE death_wickets
  END AS wickets_per_run_given
FROM death_over_stats
WHERE
  death_runs > 0
ORDER BY
  wickets_per_run_given DESC;

intent: Measure bowler economy rate in the powerplay (first 6 overs) for bowlers who have bowled a minimum number of overs in that phase.
structure: Filters for the first 6 overs, groups by bowler, calculates economy rate, and applies a HAVING clause for minimum overs bowled.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(CEIL(overs) AS INTEGER)) AS economy_rate
FROM df
WHERE
  CEIL(overs) <= 6
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(CEIL(overs) AS INTEGER)) >= 2
ORDER BY
  economy_rate ASC;

intent: Assess bowler performance by calculating wickets per over in the middle overs (overs 7-15).
structure: Filters for middle overs using CEIL(overs), groups by bowler, calculates total wickets and total overs bowled in this phase, then computes wickets per over.

intent: Calculate the average strike rate of batsmen during the first powerplay (first 6 overs) and compare it with their overall strike rate.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate overall strike rate and first powerplay strike rate for each batsman. Group by batsman. Employ CASE for division by zero prevention.
sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
first_powerplay_stats AS (
  SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS pp_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS pp_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(o.batsman, pp.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN o.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(o.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / o.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN pp.pp_balls > 0 THEN CAST(pp.pp_runs AS REAL) * 100 / pp.pp_balls ELSE 0 END AS powerplay_strike_rate
FROM overall_stats o
FULL OUTER JOIN first_powerplay_stats pp ON o.batsman = pp.batsman
WHERE o.total_balls > 0 OR pp.pp_balls > 0
ORDER BY powerplay_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Identify bowlers who are more economical (lower runs per ball) in the first powerplay (first 6 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs conceded per ball for bowlers in the first powerplay and in the rest of the match separately. Group by bowler. Use CASE for division by zero.
sql:
WITH first_powerplay_stats AS (
  SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_pp, SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS balls_bowled_pp
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6
  GROUP BY bowler
),
rest_of_match_stats AS (
  SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_rest, SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS balls_bowled_rest
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > 6
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(pp.bowler, r.bowler) AS bowler,
  CASE WHEN pp.balls_bowled_pp > 0 THEN CAST(pp.runs_conceded_pp AS REAL) / pp.balls_bowled_pp ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_ball_pp,
  CASE WHEN r.balls_bowled_rest > 0 THEN CAST(r.runs_conceded_rest AS REAL) / r.balls_bowled_rest ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_ball_rest
FROM first_powerplay_stats pp
FULL OUTER JOIN rest_of_match_stats r ON pp.bowler = r.bowler
WHERE pp.balls_bowled_pp > 0 OR r.balls_bowled_rest > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_ball_pp ASC;

intent: Determine the number of wickets taken by each bowler in each phase of the innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Use CASE expressions to define three phases based on CEIL(overs). Group by bowler and the defined phase. Sum bowler_wickets for each group.
sql:
SELECT 
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_early,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 16 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 16 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_late
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Find the batsman with the highest strike rate in overs where they scored at least one six.
structure: Use a subquery or CTE to filter for deliveries where a batsman scored a six. Then, calculate the strike rate for those batsmen based on all their runs and balls faced in the entire match. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH batsmen_with_sixes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT batsman
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_sixes > 0
)
SELECT 
  df.batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(df.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(df.batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(df.batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate
FROM df
JOIN batsmen_with_sixes ON df.batsman = batsmen_with_sixes.batsman
GROUP BY df.batsman
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC;

intent: Calculate the percentage of runs scored by each batsman in boundaries (fours and sixes) throughout the match.
structure: Group data by batsman. Calculate the total runs scored by each batsman and the total runs scored by them in boundaries (fours + sixes). Compute the percentage.
sql:
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_runs) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC;

intent: Compare the boundary-hitting capability (fours and sixes) of batsmen between the first half and second half of an innings, to see if their aggression changes.
structure: Using CTEs to define innings halves, grouping by batsman. Aggregations include sums of fours, sixes, and total boundaries. Utilizes subqueries to determine innings halves and CASE statements for phase grouping.
sql:
WITH InningsHalf AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) / 2 FROM df) THEN 'First Half'
      ELSE 'Second Half'
    END AS phase,
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_fours) AS fours,
    SUM(batsman_sixes) AS sixes
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    phase,
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Half' THEN fours ELSE 0 END) AS fours_first_half,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Half' THEN sixes ELSE 0 END) AS sixes_first_half,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Second Half' THEN fours ELSE 0 END) AS fours_second_half,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Second Half' THEN sixes ELSE 0 END) AS sixes_second_half,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Half' THEN fours + sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_first_half,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Second Half' THEN fours + sixes ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_second_half
FROM InningsHalf
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  boundaries_first_half > 0 OR boundaries_second_half > 0
ORDER BY
  batsman;

intent: Compare the dot ball percentage of bowlers in the first 10 overs versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Use CTEs to categorize deliveries into 'first 10 overs' and 'rest'. Group by bowler and phase. Calculate dot balls and total balls for each phase. Use CASE expressions for phase definition. Aggregations: SUM, COUNT, division for percentage.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN 'First 10 Overs' ELSE 'Rest of Innings' END AS phase,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, phase
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN dot_balls ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN total_balls ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_first_10,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN dot_balls ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN total_balls ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_rest
FROM over_phases
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(total_balls) > 0
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Calculate the average runs scored by a batsman immediately following a boundary (4 or 6) hit by them.
structure: Use a CTE with window functions to identify boundary balls and the runs scored on the subsequent ball. Group by batsman. Aggregations: AVG, SUM (for runs and balls faced).
sql:
WITH boundary_events AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    LAG(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS was_previous_boundary
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM boundary_events
WHERE was_previous_boundary > 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Analyze the correlation between consecutive balls faced by a batsman, specifically if a boundary is followed by a period of dot balls.
structure: Use a CTE to lag the batsman_runs column to check the previous ball's outcome. Group by batsman and filter for instances where a boundary was followed by at least two dot balls. Calculate the average number of dot balls faced after a boundary.
sql:
WITH numbered_balls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_boundary,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_dot_ball,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overs) AS ball_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS batsman_ball_id
    FROM df
),
boundary_balls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        ball_id AS boundary_ball_id,
        batsman_ball_id AS boundary_batsman_ball_id
    FROM numbered_balls
    WHERE is_boundary = 1
),
balls_after_boundary AS (
    SELECT
        bb.batsman,
        bb.boundary_ball_id,
        nb.ball_id AS current_ball_id,
        nb.batsman_ball_id,
        nb.is_dot_ball,
        nb.batsman_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.batsman, bb.boundary_ball_id ORDER BY nb.ball_id) AS seq_after_boundary
    FROM boundary_balls bb
    JOIN numbered_balls nb
        ON bb.batsman = nb.batsman
       AND nb.batsman_ball_id > bb.boundary_batsman_ball_id
),
dot_ball_sequences AS (
    SELECT
        bab.batsman,
        bab.boundary_ball_id,
        COALESCE(
            MIN(CASE WHEN bab.is_dot_ball = 0 THEN bab.seq_after_boundary ELSE NULL END) - 1,
            SUM(CASE WHEN bab.is_dot_ball = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS num_dot_balls_after_boundary
    FROM balls_after_boundary bab
    GROUP BY bab.batsman, bab.boundary_ball_id
),
all_boundary_dot_counts AS (
    SELECT
        bb.batsman,
        bb.boundary_ball_id,
        COALESCE(dbs.num_dot_balls_after_boundary, 0) AS num_dot_balls_after_boundary
    FROM boundary_balls bb
    LEFT JOIN dot_ball_sequences dbs
        ON bb.batsman = dbs.batsman
       AND bb.boundary_ball_id = dbs.boundary_ball_id
),
batsman_summary AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        AVG(CAST(num_dot_balls_after_boundary AS REAL)) AS avg_dot_balls_after_boundary,
        SUM(num_dot_balls_after_boundary) AS total_dot_balls_after_boundaries_sum
    FROM all_boundary_dot_counts
    GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    avg_dot_balls_after_boundary
FROM batsman_summary
WHERE total_dot_balls_after_boundaries_sum > 2
ORDER BY avg_dot_balls_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Analyze batsman's boundary percentage (fours and sixes) across different phases of the innings (e.g., early, middle, late).
structure: Use a CASE expression on CEIL(overs) to define three phases: early (1-6 overs), middle (7-15 overs), and late (16+ overs). Group by batsman and phase, calculating the total boundaries and balls faced, then the boundary percentage for each phase.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Early'
    WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle'
    ELSE 'Late'
  END AS phase,
  SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS total_boundaries,
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced,

intent: Examine the strike rate of batsmen when facing a specific bowler, looking at their performance in the first 10 overs versus the rest of the match.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate strike rates for batsmen against a specific bowler in the first 10 overs and in the remaining overs. Compare these strike rates. Strike rate is calculated as (total batsman runs / total batsman balls faced) * 100.
sql:
WITH first_10_overs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_first_10
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) <= 10 AND bowler = 'Azmatullah'
  GROUP BY
    batsman
  HAVING
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
),
rest_of_match AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_rest
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > 10 AND bowler = 'Azmatullah'
  GROUP BY
    batsman
  HAVING
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(f10.batsman, rom.batsman) AS batsman,
  f10.strike_rate_first_10,
  rom.strike_rate_rest
FROM first_10_overs AS f10
FULL OUTER JOIN rest_of_match AS rom
  ON f10.batsman = rom.batsman
WHERE
  f10.batsman IS NOT NULL OR rom.batsman IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  f10.strike_rate_first_10 DESC NULLS LAST;

intent: Compare a bowler's wicket-taking ability in the middle overs (overs 7-15) versus the death overs (last 5 overs) by calculating wickets per over.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate total wickets and total overs for middle and death overs separately for each bowler. Then, calculate wickets per over for each phase.
sql:
WITH middle_overs AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS middle_wickets,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CEIL(overs)) AS middle_overs_count
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15
  GROUP BY
    bowler
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT CEIL(overs)) >= 1
),
death_overs AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS death_wickets,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CEIL(overs)) AS death_overs_count
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    bowler
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT CEIL(overs)) >= 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(m.bowler, d.bowler) AS bowler,
  CASE WHEN m.middle_overs_count > 0 THEN CAST(m.middle_wickets AS REAL) / m.middle_overs_count ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_over_middle,
  CASE WHEN d.death_overs_count > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_wickets AS REAL) / d.death_overs_count ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_over_death
FROM middle_overs AS m
FULL OUTER JOIN death_overs AS d
  ON m.bowler = d.bowler
WHERE
  m.middle_overs_count > 0 OR d.death_overs_count > 0
ORDER BY
  wickets_per_over_middle DESC NULLS LAST;

intent: Find the sequence of overs where a batsman scored boundaries, and calculate the average runs scored in the ball immediately following a boundary.
structure: Use a window function to identify if the previous ball resulted in a boundary. Then, group by batsman and calculate the average runs scored on deliveries that follow a boundary.
sql:
WITH boundary_events AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary
  FROM df
),
subsequent_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    LAG(is_boundary, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS previous_ball_was_boundary
  FROM boundary_events
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM subsequent_balls
WHERE
  previous_ball_was_boundary = 1
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate overall strike rate and strike rate in death overs. Group by batsman. CASE expression is used to define death overs.
sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
),
death_over_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 5 FROM df)
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  coalesce(o.batsman, d.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN o.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(o.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / o.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN d.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / d.death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM overall_stats AS o
FULL OUTER JOIN death_over_stats AS d
  ON o.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
  o.total_balls > 0 OR d.death_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

structure: Use CEIL(overs) to get the over number. Group by bowler and over number. Sum the runs given by the bowler in each over. Then, calculate the average of these over-sums for each bowler.
sql:
WITH runs_per_over AS (
  SELECT

    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,

  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler,

SELECT

FROM runs_per_over
GROUP BY

  CASE

intent: Analyze the momentum of batsmen by calculating the strike rate in the over immediately following a boundary (4 or 6).
structure: Use a window function (LAG) to find the runs scored on the previous ball. Filter for balls that were boundaries. Then, group by batsman and calculate the average of runs scored on the ball *after* a boundary, using a CASE expression to define the 'over following boundary'.
sql:
WITH boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary
  FROM df
),
runs_after_boundary AS (
  SELECT
    b1.batsman,
    b1.overs,
    b1.batsman_runs,
    LAG(b1.is_boundary, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY b1.batsman ORDER BY b1.overs) AS previous_ball_was_boundary
  FROM boundaries AS b1
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(batsman_runs) AS strike_rate_after_boundary
FROM runs_after_boundary
WHERE previous_ball_was_boundary = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls faced by any batsman in the first 10 overs of an innings.
structure: Use CTEs to identify dot balls. Then use another CTE with a window function to count consecutive dot balls. Finally, group by batsman and find the maximum consecutive dot balls within the first 10 overs.
sql:
WITH dot_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 10
),
consecutive_dots AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    is_dot,
    SUM(is_dot) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_dots
  FROM dot_balls
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  MAX(prev_dots + is_dot) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM consecutive_dots
WHERE is_dot = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING MAX(prev_dots + is_dot) > 0
ORDER BY max_consecutive_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Analyze the batsman's strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs of the match) versus their overall strike rate, to understand performance under pressure.
structure: Calculate overall strike rate and death overs strike rate for each batsman using conditional aggregation and CTEs. Group by batsman. Compare the two strike rates.
sql:
WITH death_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    batsman
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS overall_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS overall_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  os.batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN os.overall_balls > 0 THEN CAST(os.overall_runs AS REAL) * 100 / os.overall_balls
    ELSE 0
  END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN dos.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(dos.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / dos.death_balls
    ELSE 0
  END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM overall_stats AS os
LEFT JOIN death_overs_stats AS dos ON os.batsman = dos.batsman
WHERE os.overall_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  overall_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Find the bowlers who have a higher than average number of wickets in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their wickets in the first 10 overs.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate wickets in the first 10 overs and death overs for each bowler. Compare these counts using a CASE expression. Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH first_10_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_first_10
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) <= 10
  GROUP BY
    bowler
),
death_overs_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_death
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    bowler
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(f10.bowler, d.bowler) AS bowler,
  f10.wickets_first_10,
  d.wickets_death,
  CASE
    WHEN d.wickets_death > f10.wickets_first_10 THEN 'More Wickets in Death Overs'
    WHEN f10.wickets_first_10 > d.wickets_death THEN 'More Wickets in First 10 Overs'
    ELSE 'Equal Wickets'
  END AS wicket_comparison
FROM first_10_wickets AS f10
FULL OUTER JOIN death_overs_wickets AS d ON f10.bowler = d.bowler
WHERE
  f10.bowler IS NOT NULL OR d.bowler IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  f10.wickets_first_10 DESC NULLS LAST;

intent: Examine the strike rate of a specific batsman, '{batsman}', during the powerplay (first 6 overs) and compare it to their strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use CTEs to calculate strike rate for the specified batsman in powerplay and death overs. Group by batsman. Compare the two strike rates.
sql:
WITH powerplay_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS powerplay_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS powerplay_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE

),
death_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,

  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 AND batsman = 'Head'
  GROUP BY

)
SELECT

  CASE
    WHEN p.powerplay_balls > 0 THEN CAST(p.powerplay_runs AS REAL) * 100 / p.powerplay_balls
    ELSE 0
  END AS powerplay_strike_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN d.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / d.death_balls
    ELSE 0
  END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM powerplay_stats AS p
LEFT JOIN death_overs_stats AS d ON p.batsman = d.batsman;

intent: Analyze the bowler's effectiveness by comparing their strike rate (balls per wicket) in the first powerplay (overs 1-6) versus the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use CTEs to calculate total balls and total wickets for the first powerplay and death overs for each bowler. Compute strike rate (balls/wickets) for each phase, handling division by zero.
sql:
WITH powerplay_bowling AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS pp_balls,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS pp_wickets
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) <= 6

),
death_bowling AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS death_balls,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS death_wickets
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    bowler
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(pp.bowler, d.bowler) AS bowler,
  CAST(pp.pp_balls AS REAL) / NULLIF(pp.pp_wickets, 0) AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  CAST(d.death_balls AS REAL) / NULLIF(d.death_wickets, 0) AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM powerplay_bowling AS pp

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls a bowler has bowled within the first 6 overs.
structure: Use CTEs to flag dot balls and then a window function to count consecutive dots, filtering for the first 6 overs. Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH filtered_deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        overs,
        bowler,
        batsman_runs,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) <= 6
),
numbered_deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        is_dot_ball,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS rn_overall,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler, is_dot_ball ORDER BY overs) AS rn_is_dot_specific
    FROM
        filtered_deliveries
),
grouped_dot_balls AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        (rn_overall - rn_is_dot_specific) AS group_key,
        COUNT(*) AS consecutive_count
    FROM
        numbered_deliveries
    WHERE
        is_dot_ball = 1
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        group_key
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    MAX(consecutive_count) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM
    grouped_dot_balls
GROUP BY
    bowler
HAVING
    MAX(consecutive_count) >= 4
ORDER BY
    max_consecutive_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Analyze the variation in a bowler's strike rate across different phases of the match (powerplay, middle, death) to identify how their wicket-taking ability changes.
structure: Use CASE statements to define three phases: powerplay (1-6), middle (7-12), death (13+). For each bowler and each phase, calculate deliveries bowled, wickets taken, and strike rate (deliveries per wicket).
sql:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 12 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_taken,
    SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS balls_bowled
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, phase
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) AS pp_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN wickets_taken ELSE 0 END) AS pp_wickets,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN wickets_taken ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pp_strike_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) AS mo_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN wickets_taken ELSE 0 END) AS mo_wickets,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN wickets_taken ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mo_strike_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) AS do_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN wickets_taken ELSE 0 END) AS do_wickets,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN wickets_taken ELSE 0 END), 0) AS do_strike_rate
FROM phase_stats
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(balls_bowled) > 20
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Determine the extent to which batsmen rely on boundaries (fours and sixes) for their scoring, and how this varies between early and late stages of the innings.
structure: Use CASE statements to categorize deliveries into 'early' (first 6 overs) and 'late' (last 6 overs). For each batsman, calculate total runs, boundary runs, and total balls faced in each phase. Then compute the percentage of runs from boundaries in each phase.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        df.batsman,
        CEIL(df.overs) AS current_over_ceil,
        df.batsman_runs,
        df.batsman_fours,
        df.batsman_sixes
    FROM
        df
),
MaxOver AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(current_over_ceil) AS max_inning_over
    FROM
        OverStats
)
SELECT
    os.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil <= 6 THEN os.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil <= 6 THEN os.batsman_fours ELSE 0 END) AS fours_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil <= 6 THEN os.batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS sixes_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil > (SELECT max_inning_over FROM MaxOver) - 6 THEN os.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_late,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil > (SELECT max_inning_over FROM MaxOver) - 6 THEN os.batsman_fours ELSE 0 END) AS fours_late,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil > (SELECT max_inning_over FROM MaxOver) - 6 THEN os.batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS sixes_late,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil <= 6 THEN (os.batsman_fours * 4 + os.batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil <= 6 THEN os.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) AS boundary_percentage_early,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil > (SELECT max_inning_over FROM MaxOver) - 6 THEN (os.batsman_fours * 4 + os.batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN os.current_over_ceil > (SELECT max_inning_over FROM MaxOver) - 6 THEN os.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) AS boundary_percentage_late
FROM
    OverStats AS os
GROUP BY
    os.batsman;

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls bowled by each bowler.
structure: Use CTEs to flag dot balls, then a window function to calculate cumulative dot balls, and finally group by bowler to find the maximum consecutive count.
sql:
WITH BowlerDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
    FROM
        df
),
CalculatedConsecutiveDots AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        -- Create a group identifier that increments whenever a non-dot ball is encountered.
        -- This effectively groups consecutive dot balls together, separated by non-dot balls.
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_dot_ball = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS non_dot_ball_group
    FROM
        BowlerDeliveries
),
ConsecutiveDotCounts AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        -- For each bowler and each 'non_dot_ball_group', count consecutive dot balls.
        -- This count resets to 0 for non-dot balls and increments for each dot ball within a sequence.
        CASE WHEN is_dot_ball = 1 THEN
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler, non_dot_ball_group ORDER BY overs)
        ELSE 0 END AS current_consecutive_dot_balls
    FROM
        CalculatedConsecutiveDots
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    MAX(current_consecutive_dot_balls) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM
    ConsecutiveDotCounts
GROUP BY
    bowler
HAVING
    MAX(current_consecutive_dot_balls) >= 1 -- Only include bowlers with at least one dot ball
ORDER BY
    max_consecutive_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls conceded by each bowler.
structure: Use CTEs to flag dot balls, then a window function to count consecutive dots, and finally aggregate to find the maximum.
sql:
WITH BallFlags AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
    FROM
        df
),
StreaksIdentified AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        -- Flag a new dot ball streak if the current ball is a dot ball AND the previous ball was NOT a dot ball (or it's the first ball for the bowler)
        CASE
            WHEN is_dot_ball = 1 AND LAG(is_dot_ball, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS streak_start_flag
    FROM
        BallFlags
),
StreakGroups AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        -- Create a unique group ID for each consecutive streak of dot balls by cumulatively summing streak_start_flag
        SUM(streak_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS dot_ball_streak_group
    FROM
        StreaksIdentified
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    MAX(dot_balls_in_streak) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        dot_ball_streak_group,
        COUNT(*) AS dot_balls_in_streak
    FROM
        StreakGroups
    WHERE
        is_dot_ball = 1 -- Only count actual dot balls within these identified groups
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        dot_ball_streak_group
) AS BowlerDotBallStreaks
GROUP BY
    bowler;

FROM df

intent: Analyze the momentum shift by observing runs scored in the ball immediately following a boundary.
structure: Use a window function to identify if the previous ball was a boundary. Calculate the average runs scored on the current ball, conditional on the previous ball being a boundary.
sql:
WITH boundary_and_next_ball AS (
  SELECT batsman, overs, batsman_runs,
         LAG(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS previous_ball_was_boundary
  FROM df
)
SELECT batsman,
       AVG(batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_boundary,
       COUNT(*) AS balls_after_boundary
FROM boundary_and_next_ball
WHERE previous_ball_was_boundary = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Identify batsmen who are most consistent at hitting dot balls.
structure: Use window functions to count consecutive dot balls for each batsman. Find the maximum consecutive dot ball count.
sql:
WITH dot_ball_flags AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
    FROM
        df
),
streak_groups AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_dot_ball = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as streak_group_id
    FROM
        dot_ball_flags
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        streak_group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS current_streak_length
    FROM
        streak_groups
    WHERE
        is_dot_ball = 1
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        streak_group_id
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    MAX(current_streak_length) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM
    streak_lengths
WHERE
    current_streak_length >= 5
GROUP BY
    batsman
ORDER BY
    max_consecutive_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Analyze bowler economy rate during different phases of the innings (PP, Middle, Death).
structure: Use a CASE statement to define three phases based on `CEIL(overs)`. Calculate economy rate for each bowler in each phase using CTEs.
sql:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT bowler,
         CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
              WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
              ELSE 'Death Overs' END AS phase,
         SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_given,
         COUNT(overs) AS balls_bowled
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, phase
)
SELECT bowler,
       CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS pp_economy_rate,
       CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS mo_economy_rate,
       CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN balls_bowled ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS do_economy_rate
FROM phase_stats
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(balls_bowled) > 10
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Examine the sequence of dot balls bowled by a specific bowler to understand their ability to build pressure.
structure: Filter for a specific bowler. Use a CASE statement to identify dot balls. Use a window function (cumulative sum) to count consecutive dot balls. Find the maximum streak of consecutive dot balls for that bowler.
sql:
WITH Nabi_Deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        overs,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_dot_ball
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        bowler = 'M Nabi'
),
Numbered_Deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overs) AS rn
    FROM
        Nabi_Deliveries
),
Streaks AS (
    SELECT
        is_dot_ball,
        rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY is_dot_ball ORDER BY overs) AS streak_group_id
    FROM
        Numbered_Deliveries
    WHERE
        is_dot_ball = 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(dot_ball_count), 0) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM (
    SELECT
        COUNT(streak_group_id) AS dot_ball_count
    FROM
        Streaks
    GROUP BY
        streak_group_id
) AS dot_ball_counts

intent: Examine the variation in a batsman's run-scoring rate (runs per ball) across different phases of the match (e.g., first 6 overs, overs 7-15, last 5 overs).
structure: Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to define three phases. Group by batsman and phase, calculating the sum of batsman runs and sum of balls faced. Then, calculate runs per ball for each phase. Finally, compare these rates across phases for each batsman.
sql:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_phase1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_phase1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_phase2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_phase2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_phase3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_phase3
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN balls_phase1 > 0 THEN CAST(runs_phase1 AS REAL) / balls_phase1 ELSE 0 END AS rate_phase1,
  CASE WHEN balls_phase2 > 0 THEN CAST(runs_phase2 AS REAL) / balls_phase2 ELSE 0 END AS rate_phase2,
  CASE WHEN balls_phase3 > 0 THEN CAST(runs_phase3 AS REAL) / balls_phase2 ELSE 0 END AS rate_phase3
FROM phase_stats
WHERE balls_phase1 > 0 OR balls_phase2 > 0 OR balls_phase3 > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

structure: Use a window function (LAG) on bowler_wickets to identify deliveries immediately following a wicket. Filter for these deliveries. Then, calculate strike rate (sum of runs / sum of balls faced) for batsmen in these specific situations. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH deliveries_after_wicket AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN LAG(bowler_wickets, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS after_wicket
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN after_wicket = 1 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_after_wicket,
  SUM(CASE WHEN after_wicket = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_after_wicket,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN after_wicket = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN after_wicket = 1 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN after_wicket = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_after_wicket
FROM deliveries_after_wicket
WHERE after_wicket = 1
GROUP BY batsman
ORDER BY strike_rate_after_wicket DESC;

sql:
WITH phase_bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_phase1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_phase1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_phase2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_phase2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_phase3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_phase3
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN wickets_phase1 > 0 THEN CAST(runs_phase1 AS REAL) / wickets_phase1 ELSE NULL END AS sr_phase1,
  CASE WHEN wickets_phase2 > 0 THEN CAST(runs_phase2 AS REAL) / wickets_phase2 ELSE NULL END AS sr_phase2,
  CASE WHEN wickets_phase3 > 0 THEN CAST(runs_phase3 AS REAL) / wickets_phase3 ELSE NULL END AS sr_phase3
FROM phase_bowling_stats
WHERE wickets_phase1 > 0 OR wickets_phase2 > 0 OR wickets_phase3 > 0

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Uses CTEs to calculate overall and death over stats, then joins them. Aggregates by batsman, calculates strike rates, and compares them. Uses conditional aggregation for strike rate calculation.
sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
),
death_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.batsman, d.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN o.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(o.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / o.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN d.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / d.death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM overall_stats AS o
FULL OUTER JOIN death_overs_stats AS d ON o.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
  o.total_balls > 0 OR d.death_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Find the batsmen who have the highest proportion of their runs scored from boundaries (4s and 6s) in the death overs.
structure: Uses CTEs to calculate total boundary runs and total runs for each batsman specifically in the death overs. Then calculates the boundary percentage.
sql:
WITH death_over_boundary_runs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 THEN batsman_fours * 4 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN batsman_sixes > 0 THEN batsman_sixes * 6 ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs_death,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_death
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_runs_death > 0 THEN CAST(boundary_runs_death AS REAL) * 100 / total_runs_death ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_death_overs
FROM death_over_boundary_runs
WHERE total_runs_death > 0
ORDER BY
  boundary_percentage_death_overs DESC;

intent: Compare the number of maiden overs bowled by each bowler against the number of overs they bowled where more than 10 runs were conceded.
structure: Uses conditional aggregation (CASE statements) within a GROUP BY clause to count maiden overs and overs with >10 runs conceded for each bowler.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(CEIL(df.overs) AS INT) AS over_number,
        df.bowler,
        SUM(df.bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_in_over
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        CAST(CEIL(df.overs) AS INT),
        df.bowler
)
SELECT
    o.bowler,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.runs_conceded_in_over = 0 THEN 1 END) AS maiden_overs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.runs_conceded_in_over > 10 THEN 1 END) AS overs_conceding_gt_10_runs
FROM
    OverStats AS o
GROUP BY
    o.bowler
ORDER BY
    maiden_overs DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in the first 10 overs versus the last 10 overs of an innings.
structure: Uses CTEs to calculate strike rates for the first 10 overs and the last 10 overs separately. Joins these CTEs and presents the comparison for each batsman.
sql:
WITH first_10_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_first_10,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_first_10
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 10
  GROUP BY batsman
),
last_10_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_last_10,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_last_10
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df)
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(f10.batsman, l10.batsman) AS batsman,
  CASE WHEN f10.balls_first_10 > 0 THEN CAST(f10.runs_first_10 AS REAL) * 100 / f10.balls_first_10 ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_first_10,
  CASE WHEN l10.balls_last_10 > 0 THEN CAST(l10.runs_last_10 AS REAL) * 100 / l10.balls_last_10 ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_last_10
FROM first_10_overs_stats AS f10
FULL OUTER JOIN last_10_overs_stats AS l10 ON f10.batsman = l10.batsman
WHERE f10.balls_first_10 > 0 OR l10.balls_last_10 > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_last_10 DESC;

intent: Analyze the batting performance by batsmen in the first 6 balls of each over versus the rest of the over, focusing on run scoring efficiency.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to differentiate between the first 6 balls of an over (first_6_balls) and the rest of the over (rest_of_over). Calculate the sum of batsman_runs and sum of batsman_bowls_faced for each phase. Compute strike rates for each phase. Use conditional aggregation for sums and strike rate calculations.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 <= CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_first_6_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 <= CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_first_6_balls,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 <= CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 <= CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 <= CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_6_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 > CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_rest_of_over,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 > CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_rest_of_over,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 > CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 > CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 > CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_over
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 <= CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) * 10 + (overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10 > CEIL(overs) * 10 + 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_rest_of_over DESC;

intent: Calculate the average runs conceded by a bowler in overs where they have taken at least one wicket.
structure: Use a CTE to identify overs where the bowler took at least one wicket. Then, group by bowler and calculate the average runs conceded in those specific overs.
sql:
WITH bowler_wicket_overs AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_in_over,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs)
  HAVING
    SUM(bowler_wickets) >= 1
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  AVG(runs_in_over) AS avg_runs_conceded_in_wicket_overs
FROM bowler_wicket_overs
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_conceded_in_wicket_overs ASC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of a specific batsman across different phases of an innings (defined by overs).
structure: Use a CASE statement to define three phases: early (1-10 overs), middle (11-30 overs), and late (31+ overs). Calculate runs scored and balls faced for each batsman in each phase. Compute strike rate for each phase.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_early,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_early,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_early,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_middle,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 30 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_late,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_late,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 30 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_late
FROM df
WHERE batsman = 'Smith'  -- Placeholder for batsman name
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 30 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_late DESC;
