intent: Analyze the correlation between dot balls faced and subsequent boundary-hitting by batsmen. This query seeks to understand if batsmen tend to hit boundaries after facing dot balls to compensate.
structure: Uses a CTE to lag the runs of the previous ball faced by each batsman. Then, it calculates the ratio of boundaries (fours + sixes) to balls that followed a dot ball, for batsmen who faced a significant number of dot balls. Uses CTE, window function (LAG), and CASE.
sql:
WITH batsman_deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        -- Assign a unique sequence number for each ball faced by a batsman to ensure correct LAG operation
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS rn,
        -- Flag if the current ball is a dot ball (0 runs scored by batsman)
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_current_dot,
        -- Flag if the current ball is a boundary (four or six)
        CASE WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_current_boundary
    FROM
        df
),
analyzed_deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        is_current_dot,
        is_current_boundary,
        -- Get the 'is_current_dot' status of the immediately preceding ball for the same batsman
        LAG(is_current_dot, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY rn) AS is_previous_dot
    FROM
        batsman_deliveries
)
SELECT
    a.batsman,
    -- Calculate the percentage of boundaries hit immediately after a dot ball
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_previous_dot = 1 AND a.is_current_boundary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_previous_dot = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS boundary_rate_after_dot
FROM
    analyzed_deliveries a
GROUP BY
    a.batsman
HAVING
    -- Filter for batsmen who faced more than 10 dot balls
    SUM(a.is_current_dot) > 10
    -- Ensure there is at least one ball after a dot to avoid division by zero
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_previous_dot = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Analyze the batting performance by calculating the average runs scored per ball faced by each batsman during the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Group by batsman, calculate the average of batsman_runs divided by batsman_bowls_faced for deliveries within the last 5 overs. Use a CTE to define the death overs phase. Use a CASE expression to filter for death overs. Use subqueries to determine the maximum over.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced)
    ELSE 0
  END AS avg_runs_per_ball_death_overs
FROM death_overs
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_per_ball_death_overs DESC;

intent: Identify batsmen who have a higher strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Uses CTEs to calculate strike rates for different phases (death overs vs. rest), then compares them.
sql:
WITH phase_strike_rates AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 'Death Overs'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS phase,
    CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
  GROUP BY batsman, phase
)
SELECT
  sr1.batsman
FROM phase_strike_rates sr1
JOIN phase_strike_rates sr2 ON sr1.batsman = sr2.batsman
WHERE sr1.phase = 'Death Overs' AND sr2.phase = 'Other' AND sr1.strike_rate > sr2.strike_rate;

intent: Analyze the boundary percentage (fours and sixes) hit by batsmen during the first 10 overs versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Calculate boundary percentage for the first 10 overs (CEIL(overs) <= 10) and for the rest of the innings. Percentage is calculated as (SUM(batsman_fours) + SUM(batsman_sixes)) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced). Use CASE statements for conditional aggregation based on over phases. Group by batsman. Wide output preference applied by having two boundary percentage columns.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_percentage_first_10_overs,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_percentage_rest_of_innings
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Analyze the conversion rate of 'dot balls' into 'wickets' for each bowler. That is, for every N dot balls bowled by a bowler, how many wickets do they take.
structure: Calculate the number of dot balls and wickets per bowler. Use a CASE statement to identify dot balls (batsman_runs = 0). Calculate the ratio of wickets to dot balls bowled: SUM(bowler_wickets) / SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Group by bowler. Use window functions to establish a sequence of dot balls faced by a batsman to analyze streaks. Use CTEs to compute dot balls and then analyze sequences.
sql:
WITH dot_ball_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
    bowler_wickets
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(is_dot_ball) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_wickets) AS REAL) / SUM(is_dot_ball)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS wickets_per_dot_ball
FROM dot_ball_analysis
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(is_dot_ball) > 0
ORDER BY wickets_per_dot_ball DESC;

intent: Analyze the change in a batsman's strike rate from the first half of their innings to the second half.
structure: Group by batsman and a CASE expression defining the first/second half of innings based on CEIL(overs). Calculate strike rate (runs/balls) for each half using SUM and COUNT. Use a subquery to find the maximum over.
sql:
WITH innings_halves AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) / 2 THEN 'First Half'
      ELSE 'Second Half'
    END AS innings_phase,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
  GROUP BY batsman, innings_phase
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN innings_phase = 'First Half' THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_balls, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS strike_rate_first_half,
  SUM(CASE WHEN innings_phase = 'Second Half' THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_balls, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS strike_rate_second_half
FROM innings_halves
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN innings_phase = 'First Half' THEN total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_phase = 'Second Half' THEN total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over
  FROM df
)

  batsman,

  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT max_over FROM max_over) - 2 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0

    ELSE 0

FROM df
GROUP BY batsman

intent: Identify the longest streak of dot balls faced by each batsman.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls. Use another CTE with window functions (LAG) to find consecutive dot balls. Group by batsman to find the maximum streak.
sql:
WITH BatsmanOrderedBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS rn
    FROM
        df
),
DotBallGroups AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        rn,
        rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY rn) AS group_id
    FROM
        BatsmanOrderedBalls
    WHERE
        batsman_runs = 0
),
SequenceLengths AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS current_sequence_length
    FROM
        DotBallGroups
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        group_id
),
MaxSequencePerBatsman AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        MAX(current_sequence_length) AS longest_consecutive_dot_balls_calc
    FROM
        SequenceLengths
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    DISTINCT t.batsman,
    COALESCE(m.longest_consecutive_dot_balls_calc, 0) AS longest_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM
    df AS t
LEFT JOIN
    MaxSequencePerBatsman AS m
ON
    t.batsman = m.batsman;

structure: Use a subquery to find the maximum over. Filter deliveries to the last 2 overs using CEIL(overs). Calculate economy rate (SUM(team_runs) / COUNT(overs)). Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH MatchStats AS (
    SELECT CEIL(MAX(overs)) AS max_match_over
    FROM df
),
DeathOverBowlerStats AS (
    SELECT
        df.bowler,
        SUM(df.bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(df.bowler_bowls_done) AS total_balls_bowled
    FROM
        df
    JOIN
        MatchStats ON 1=1
    WHERE
        CEIL(df.overs) > (MatchStats.max_match_over - 2)
    GROUP BY
        df.bowler
)

    bowler,
    CASE
        WHEN total_balls_bowled > 0 THEN (CAST(total_runs_conceded AS REAL) * 6.0) / total_balls_bowled
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS economy_rate_death_overs
FROM
    DeathOverBowlerStats
ORDER BY
    economy_rate_death_overs ASC

structure: Grouping by batsman. Calculating strike rate (runs/balls) for two phases: 'death overs' (last 5 overs) and 'rest of innings'. Uses CASE expressions for phase definition and conditional aggregation. Filters for batsmen with a minimum number of balls faced in each phase.
sql:
WITH max_over_val AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_ov
    FROM df
),
over_classification AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(overs) >= (SELECT max_ov FROM max_over_val) - 4
            THEN 'death_overs'
            ELSE 'rest_of_innings'
        END AS over_phase
    FROM df
),
batsman_phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        over_phase,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM over_classification
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        over_phase
)
SELECT
    s.batsman,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.over_phase = 'death_overs' AND s.total_balls_faced > 0 THEN (s.total_runs * 100.0) / s.total_balls_faced ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS strike_rate_death_overs,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.over_phase = 'rest_of_innings' AND s.total_balls_faced > 0 THEN (s.total_runs * 100.0) / s.total_balls_faced ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM batsman_phase_stats s
GROUP BY
    s.batsman
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.over_phase = 'death_overs' THEN s.total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 10 OR
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.over_phase = 'rest_of_innings' THEN s.total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 10

intent: Analyze the momentum of batsmen by calculating their strike rate in the ball following a boundary (4 or 6).
structure: Uses a CTE and window functions. Identifies boundaries and then calculates the strike rate in the subsequent ball faced by the same batsman. Filters for batsmen who have faced a minimum number of balls after hitting a boundary.
sql:
WITH ballsequence AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary,
    lead(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_ball,
    lead(batsman_bowls_faced, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS bowls_faced_on_next_ball
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(bowls_faced_on_next_ball) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(runs_on_next_ball) AS REAL) * 100.0 / sum(bowls_faced_on_next_ball)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_after_boundary
FROM ballsequence
WHERE
  is_boundary = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  sum(bowls_faced_on_next_ball) > 5
ORDER BY

SELECT

  CASE

FROM df

intent: Find the count of maiden overs bowled by each bowler.
structure: Filter for overs where total team runs given is 0. Group by bowler. Count the number of such overs.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_in_over,
        MAX(overs) AS last_ball_in_over_decimal
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    COUNT(over_number) AS maiden_overs
FROM OverStats
WHERE
    runs_conceded_in_over = 0
    AND (CAST(last_ball_in_over_decimal * 10 AS INTEGER) % 10) = 6
GROUP BY
    bowler
HAVING
    COUNT(over_number) > 0
ORDER BY
    maiden_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen during death overs (last 5 overs of the innings) and compare it to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate overall strike rate and death over strike rate for each batsman using conditional aggregation and subqueries. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH MaxOverNum AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_o_num FROM df
)
SELECT
    t1.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(t1.overs) > (m.max_o_num - 5) THEN t1.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(t1.overs) > (m.max_o_num - 5) THEN t1.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS death_overs_strike_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(t1.overs) <= (m.max_o_num - 5) THEN t1.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(t1.overs) <= (m.max_o_num - 5) THEN t1.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS early_overs_strike_rate
FROM
    df AS t1, MaxOverNum AS m
GROUP BY
    t1.batsman
HAVING
    SUM(t1.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
    t1.batsman;

intent: Compare batsman strike rates in the first 10 balls of an innings vs. the rest of the innings.
structure: Use a CTE with ROW_NUMBER to rank balls within an innings. Then, use CASE expressions to separate the first 10 balls from the rest and calculate strike rates for each phase.
sql:
WITH BatsmanInningsSequence AS (
    SELECT
        match_id, -- Assuming these columns exist for proper innings identification
        innings_no, -- Assuming these columns exist for proper innings identification
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no, batsman ORDER BY overs) AS ball_seq_num
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        batsman_bowls_faced > 0
),
PerBatsmanInningsStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ball_seq_num <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_first_10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ball_seq_num <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_first_10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ball_seq_num > 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_after_10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ball_seq_num > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_after_10
    FROM
        BatsmanInningsSequence
    GROUP BY
        batsman, match_id, innings_no
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(runs_first_10) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(balls_first_10), 0),
        0.0
    ) AS strike_rate_first_10_balls,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(runs_after_10) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(balls_after_10), 0),
        0.0
    ) AS strike_rate_after_10_balls
FROM
    PerBatsmanInningsStats
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    SUM(balls_first_10) + SUM(balls_after_10) > 0;

WITH AllOverRuns AS (
    SELECT
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        MAX(team_runs) AS end_of_over_score
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        CEIL(overs)
),
RunsPerOver AS (
    SELECT
        over_number,
        end_of_over_score - COALESCE(LAG(end_of_over_score, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY over_number), 0) AS runs_scored_in_over
    FROM
        AllOverRuns
),
AzmatullahWicketOvers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        bowler = '{bowler}' AND bowler_wickets > 0
)
SELECT
    rpo.over_number,
    rpo.runs_scored_in_over AS total_runs_in_wicket_overs
FROM
    RunsPerOver rpo
INNER JOIN
    AzmatullahWicketOvers awo
ON
    rpo.over_number = awo.over_number
ORDER BY
    rpo.over_number;

WITH WicketOvers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        bowler_wickets > 0
),
BowlerBallsPerWicketOver AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS total_balls_bowled_by_bowler_in_this_over
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) IN (SELECT over_num FROM WicketOvers)
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    AVG(total_balls_bowled_by_bowler_in_this_over) AS avg_balls_in_wicket_overs
FROM
    BowlerBallsPerWicketOver
GROUP BY
    bowler
HAVING
    AVG(total_balls_bowled_by_bowler_in_this_over) > 0
ORDER BY
    bowler;

intent: Determine the boundary percentage (fours and sixes) for batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to find the total number of overs, then filter for the last 5 overs. Group by batsman and calculate the ratio of boundaries to balls faced in these overs. Use CASE statements for filtering.
sql:
WITH max_over AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM max_over) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM max_over) - 5 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM max_over) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_percentage_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM max_over) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  batsman;

intent: Calculate the average runs conceded by bowlers in overs where they took at least one wicket, split by whether the over was a maiden over.
structure: Use a CTE to identify maiden overs and wicket-taking overs. Group by bowler and a CASE expression for maiden/wicket-over status. Calculate average runs conceded.
sql:
WITH over_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(team_runs) AS runs_in_over,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_in_over,
    CASE WHEN SUM(team_runs) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_maiden
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 AND is_maiden = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 AND is_maiden = 1 THEN runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 AND is_maiden = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS avg_runs_in_maiden_wicket_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 AND is_maiden = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 AND is_maiden = 0 THEN runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 AND is_maiden = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS avg_runs_in_non_maiden_wicket_overs
FROM over_analysis
WHERE
  wickets_in_over > 0
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_in_over > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  bowler;

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsman '{batsman}' after hitting a boundary.
structure: Use a CTE to identify boundary hits and the subsequent balls faced by the same batsman. Group by batsman and calculate the strike rate for balls following a boundary. Includes a placeholder for batsman.
sql:
WITH ballsequence AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary,
    LEAD(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_ball,
    LEAD(batsman_bowls_faced, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS bowls_faced_on_next_ball
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman = 'Head'
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(bowls_faced_on_next_ball) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(runs_on_next_ball) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(bowls_faced_on_next_ball)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_after_boundary
FROM ballsequence
WHERE is_boundary = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(bowls_faced_on_next_ball) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_after_boundary DESC;

WITH next_ball_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_six,

    LEAD(batsman_bowls_faced, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS bowls_faced_on_next_ball

)
SELECT

  CASE
    WHEN SUM(bowls_faced_on_next_ball) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(runs_on_next_ball) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(bowls_faced_on_next_ball)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_after_six
FROM next_ball_analysis
WHERE
  is_six = 1
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(bowls_faced_on_next_ball) > 0
ORDER BY

    FROM
        OverRuns

    GROUP BY

BowlerStats AS (

    FROM

)

    CAST(bs.total_wickets AS REAL) / mo.total_maiden_overs AS wickets_per_maiden_over
FROM

intent: Analyze the change in batting strike rate from the first 10 overs to the last 10 overs for batsmen who batted significantly in both phases.

sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first_10_overs,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_last_10_overs
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_10_overs = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_10_overs = 1 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_10_overs = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_first_10_overs,

FROM over_phases
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_10_overs = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN is_last_10_overs = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0

WITH boundary_impact AS (
  SELECT

intent: Analyze the momentum of scoring by calculating the ratio of runs per ball in the current over to the previous over for each batsman.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate runs and balls per over for each batsman. Then use a window function (lag) to get the previous over's stats. Finally, calculate the momentum ratio.
sql:
WITH OverBallStats AS (
    -- Aggregate runs and balls faced per batsman per over
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_no,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_current_over,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_current_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs)
),
RunsPerBall AS (
    -- Calculate runs per ball for current over and previous over
    SELECT
        batsman,
        over_no,
        -- Calculate current over runs per ball, ensuring balls faced > 0 to avoid division by zero and NULLs for invalid overs
        CASE
            WHEN total_balls_current_over > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs_current_over AS REAL) / total_balls_current_over
            ELSE NULL
        END AS current_over_runs_per_ball,
        -- Calculate previous over runs per ball using LAG, applying the same logic for validity
        LAG(
            CASE
                WHEN total_balls_current_over > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs_current_over AS REAL) / total_balls_current_over
                ELSE NULL
            END,
            1
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS previous_over_runs_per_ball,
        total_balls_current_over -- Keep this for filtering the current over
    FROM OverBallStats
)
-- Final selection and momentum ratio calculation
SELECT
    batsman,
    over_no,
    current_over_runs_per_ball,
    previous_over_runs_per_ball,
    -- Calculate momentum ratio: current / previous.
    -- If previous_over_runs_per_ball is NULL or 0, momentum_ratio will be NULL, as per requirements.
    current_over_runs_per_ball / NULLIF(previous_over_runs_per_ball, 0) AS momentum_ratio
FROM RunsPerBall
WHERE
    total_balls_current_over > 0 -- Only include current overs where at least one ball was faced
    AND previous_over_runs_per_ball IS NOT NULL -- Exclude first overs where no previous over exists (LAG returns NULL)
    AND previous_over_runs_per_ball > 0 -- Exclude cases where previous over had 0 runs per ball
ORDER BY
    batsman,
    over_no;

intent: Determine the strike rate of each batsman in the death overs (last 2 overs of the innings).

WITH max_over AS (

FROM
    InitialOversStats AS ios

ON

intent: Analyze the batsman's strike rate in overs where the bowler recorded a wicket, compared to overs where they did not.
structure: Grouping by batsman. Using CASE statements on bowler_wickets to create two groups and calculating strike rate for each.
sql:
WITH OverWicketStatus AS (
    SELECT
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num,
        bowler,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_had_wicket
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        CEIL(overs), bowler
),
BatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ows.over_had_wicket = 1 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_wicket_over,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ows.over_had_wicket = 1 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_wicket_over,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ows.over_had_wicket = 0 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_no_wicket_over,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ows.over_had_wicket = 0 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_no_wicket_over
    FROM
        df AS d
    JOIN
        OverWicketStatus AS ows
    ON
        CEIL(d.overs) = ows.over_num AND d.bowler = ows.bowler
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman
)
SELECT
    bs.batsman,
    CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_wicket_over * 100.0 / NULLIF(bs.balls_wicket_over, 0), 0.0) AS REAL) AS strike_rate_when_bowler_takes_wicket,
    CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_no_wicket_over * 100.0 / NULLIF(bs.balls_no_wicket_over, 0), 0.0) AS REAL) AS strike_rate_when_bowler_does_not_take_wicket
FROM
    BatsmanStats AS bs
WHERE
    bs.balls_wicket_over > 0
    AND bs.balls_no_wicket_over > 0
ORDER BY
    bs.batsman;

intent: Assess the contribution of boundaries (fours and sixes) to a batsman's total runs in each phase of the innings (powerplay, middle overs, death overs).
structure: Define three phases: powerplay (1-6 overs), middle overs (7-15 overs), and death overs (last 5 overs) using CASE statements based on CEIL(overs). Calculate the percentage of runs scored from boundaries for each batsman in each phase.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS current_over,
        batsman_runs,
        (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) AS boundary_runs
    FROM df
),
MaxOverallOver AS (
    SELECT MAX(current_over) AS max_over_value
    FROM OverPhases
),
CategorizedRuns AS (
    SELECT
        op.batsman,
        CASE
            WHEN op.current_over <= 6 THEN op.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END AS powerplay_total_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN op.current_over <= 6 THEN op.boundary_runs
            ELSE 0
        END AS powerplay_boundary_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN op.current_over > 6 AND op.current_over <= (moo.max_over_value - 5) THEN op.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END AS middle_overs_total_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN op.current_over > 6 AND op.current_over <= (moo.max_over_value - 5) THEN op.boundary_runs
            ELSE 0
        END AS middle_overs_boundary_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN op.current_over > (moo.max_over_value - 5) THEN op.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END AS death_overs_total_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN op.current_over > (moo.max_over_value - 5) THEN op.boundary_runs
            ELSE 0
        END AS death_overs_boundary_runs
    FROM OverPhases op
    CROSS JOIN MaxOverallOver moo
)
SELECT
    c.batsman,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.powerplay_boundary_runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.powerplay_total_runs), 0), 0) AS boundary_percentage_powerplay,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.middle_overs_boundary_runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.middle_overs_total_runs), 0), 0) AS boundary_percentage_middle_overs,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.death_overs_boundary_runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.death_overs_total_runs), 0), 0) AS boundary_percentage_death_overs
FROM CategorizedRuns c
GROUP BY c.batsman
HAVING (SUM(c.powerplay_total_runs) + SUM(c.middle_overs_total_runs) + SUM(c.death_overs_total_runs)) > 0
ORDER BY c.batsman

intent: Analyze the batting performance by calculating the ratio of boundaries (fours and sixes) to dot balls for each batsman, focusing on their ability to find scoring opportunities after a non-scoring delivery.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE expressions to identify dot balls and boundary balls. Calculate the ratio of boundary balls to dot balls using SUM aggregation. Filter to include only batsmen with a sufficient number of dot balls.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_to_dot_ball_ratio
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 10
ORDER BY boundary_to_dot_ball_ratio DESC;

intent: Determine the most effective bowlers by calculating their wickets per over in the middle overs (overs 11-15), identifying bowlers who perform well during a crucial phase of the innings.
structure: Use a CASE expression to filter for middle overs. Group by bowler. Calculate the total wickets and total overs within this phase. Compute the wickets per over metric. Filter for bowlers who bowled a minimum number of overs in this phase.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_wickets) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS wickets_per_middle_over
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
ORDER BY wickets_per_middle_over DESC;

intent: Assess batsman scoring momentum by analyzing the average runs scored on the ball immediately following a boundary, indicating their ability to capitalize on momentum.
structure: Use a CTE with a window function to get the runs scored on the next ball. Use a CASE expression to identify boundary balls. Calculate the average runs scored on the ball after a boundary for each batsman. Filter for batsmen who hit at least one boundary.
sql:
WITH boundary_info AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    (CASE WHEN batsman_fours = 1 OR batsman_sixes = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_boundary_ball,
    LEAD(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_delivery
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(runs_on_next_delivery) AS avg_runs_following_boundary
FROM boundary_info
WHERE
  is_boundary_ball = 1
  AND runs_on_next_delivery IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_following_boundary DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen during the death overs (last 10 overs) to identify aggressive finishers.
structure: Use a CASE expression to filter for death overs. Group by batsman. Calculate total runs scored and total balls faced in the death overs. Compute strike rate. Filter for batsmen who faced a minimum number of balls.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) >= 10
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

structure: Using a CTE to determine the maximum over number, then grouping by bowler to calculate economy rate for middle overs (e.g., overs 11-15) and death overs (last 5 overs) using SUM aggregations and CASE expressions.
sql: WITH max_over AS ( select max(ceil(overs)) as max_over from df ) SELECT bowler, case when sum(case when ceil(overs) > 10 and ceil(overs) <= 15 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then cast(sum(case when ceil(overs) > 10 and ceil(overs) <= 15 then bowler_runs_given else 0 end) as real) * 6.0 / sum(case when ceil(overs) > 10 and ceil(overs) <= 15 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end as economy_rate_middle_overs, case when sum(case when ceil(overs) > (select max_over from max_over) - 5 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then cast(sum(case when ceil(overs) > (select max_over from max_over) - 5 then bowler_runs_given else 0 end) as real) * 6.0 / sum(case when ceil(overs) > (select max_over from max_over) - 5 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end as economy_rate_death_overs FROM df GROUP BY bowler HAVING sum(case when ceil(overs) > 10 and ceil(overs) <= 15 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 OR sum(case when ceil(overs) > (select max_over from max_over) - 5 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Examine the scoring rate of batsmen on a ball-by-ball basis, specifically looking at the runs scored on the very next ball after a dot ball. This helps understand if batsmen are attacking or defensive after failing to score.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls. Then, use a window function (LEAD) to get the runs scored on the next ball for each batsman, ordered by overs. Calculate the average runs scored on the next ball after a dot ball.
sql:
WITH BallSequence AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs AS current_ball_runs,
        LEAD(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS next_ball_runs
    FROM
        df
),
DotBallNextRuns AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        next_ball_runs
    FROM
        BallSequence
    WHERE
        current_ball_runs = 0 AND next_ball_runs IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(next_ball_runs) AS avg_runs_after_dot
FROM
    DotBallNextRuns
GROUP BY
    batsman

intent: Analyze batsman momentum by comparing their strike rate in a given over with their strike rate in the immediately preceding over.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs per ball for each batsman in each over. Then use a window function (LAG) to get the previous over's runs per ball. Calculate the ratio of current over's runs per ball to the previous over's runs per ball.
sql: WITH over_runs_per_ball AS ( SELECT batsman, CEIL(overs) as over_no, SUM(batsman_runs) as runs_in_over, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) as balls_in_over FROM df GROUP BY batsman, over_no ), lagged_over_runs AS ( SELECT batsman, over_no, runs_in_over, balls_in_over, LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) as prev_runs_in_over, LAG(balls_in_over, 1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) as prev_balls_in_over FROM over_runs_per_ball ) SELECT batsman, over_no, CASE WHEN balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS current_over_runs_per_ball, CASE WHEN prev_balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS previous_over_runs_per_ball, CASE WHEN (prev_balls_in_over > 0 AND CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over > 0) THEN (CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over) / (CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over) ELSE NULL END AS momentum_ratio FROM lagged_over_runs WHERE balls_in_over > 0 ORDER BY batsman, over_no;

intent: Identify batsmen who are good at hitting boundaries (fours and sixes) by calculating their boundary percentage (boundaries / balls faced) during powerplay overs (first 6 overs) and compare it with their boundary percentage in the middle overs (overs 7-15).
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to categorize deliveries into 'powerplay' and 'middle overs'. Calculate the sum of fours and sixes and sum of balls faced for each phase. Compute boundary percentage for each phase.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS powerplay_boundary_percentage,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_fours + batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS middle_overs_boundary_percentage
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Investigate bowler's wicket-taking ability by comparing the proportion of maiden overs bowled by them in the first 10 overs versus the rest of the innings. A maiden over is an over where no runs are scored.
structure: Group by bowler. Use CASE statements to identify maiden overs within the first 10 and remaining overs. Calculate the count of maiden overs and total overs bowled for each phase. Compute the proportion.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_in_over,
        1 AS total_over_count -- Each row here represents a distinct over bowled by the bowler
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
),
MaidenOverFlags AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        over_num,
        CASE WHEN runs_conceded_in_over = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_maiden_over,
        total_over_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN over_num <= 10 THEN 'first_10'
            ELSE 'rest_of_innings'
        END AS over_phase
    FROM
        OverStats
)
SELECT
    m.bowler,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.over_phase = 'first_10' THEN m.is_maiden_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m.over_phase = 'first_10' THEN m.total_over_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS maiden_over_proportion_first_10,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.over_phase = 'rest_of_innings' THEN m.is_maiden_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m.over_phase = 'rest_of_innings' THEN m.total_over_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS maiden_over_proportion_rest
FROM
    MaidenOverFlags AS m
GROUP BY
    m.bowler
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.over_phase = 'first_10' THEN m.total_over_count ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.over_phase = 'rest_of_innings' THEN m.total_over_count ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY m.bowler;

intent: Examine the strike rate of batsmen against bowlers who have a higher than average economy rate in the match.
structure: Calculate the average economy rate for all bowlers. Then, filter for deliveries bowled by bowlers exceeding this average. Finally, group by batsman to calculate their strike rate against these specific bowlers.
sql:
WITH bowler_total_stats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_given,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS total_balls_done
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler
),
overall_match_economy AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(total_runs_given) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_balls_done), 0) AS overall_avg_economy
    FROM
        bowler_total_stats
),
high_economy_bowlers_list AS (
    SELECT
        bts.bowler
    FROM
        bowler_total_stats bts
    CROSS JOIN
        overall_match_economy ome
    WHERE
        bts.total_balls_done > 0
        AND (bts.total_runs_given * 1.0 / bts.total_balls_done) > ome.overall_avg_economy
)
SELECT
    d.batsman,
    (SUM(d.batsman_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced), 0)) * 100 AS strike_rate_vs_high_economy_bowlers
FROM
    df d
JOIN
    high_economy_bowlers_list hebl
ON
    d.bowler = hebl.bowler
GROUP BY
    d.batsman
HAVING
    SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0;

structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to differentiate between the first 10 overs and the remaining overs. Calculate the boundary rate for each phase. Filter for batsmen who have faced a minimum number of balls in each phase.
sql:
WITH batsman_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_fours ELSE 0 END) AS fours_first_10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS sixes_first_10,

        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_fours ELSE 0 END) AS fours_rest_innings,

        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_rest_innings

            ELSE 0.0
        END AS REAL
    ) AS boundary_rate_first_10_overs,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN balls_rest_innings > 0 THEN (fours_rest_innings + sixes_rest_innings) * 1.0 / balls_rest_innings
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS REAL
    ) AS boundary_rate_rest_of_innings

intent: Find batsmen who score a high proportion of their runs through boundaries in the death overs.
structure: Filter for death overs, group by batsman, calculate total runs and total boundaries. Compute the ratio.
sql:
WITH MaxOver AS (
    SELECT CEIL(MAX(overs)) AS max_over_number
    FROM df
)
SELECT
    d.batsman,
    CAST(SUM(d.batsman_fours * 4 + d.batsman_sixes * 6) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.batsman_runs), 0) AS boundary_run_ratio_death_overs
FROM
    df AS d
JOIN
    MaxOver AS mo ON 1=1
WHERE
    CEIL(d.overs) > mo.max_over_number - 2
GROUP BY
    d.batsman
HAVING
    SUM(d.batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY
    boundary_run_ratio_death_overs DESC;

structure: Group by bowler and calculate the average runs conceded per over, comparing the first 10 overs with the remaining overs. Uses CASE expressions to filter for the specified over ranges and calculate averages.
sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) <= 10 THEN df.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_first_10_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) <= 10 THEN df.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS balls_first_10_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) > 10 THEN df.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_rest_of_innings,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) > 10 THEN df.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS balls_rest_of_innings,
        SUM(df.bowler_bowls_done) AS total_deliveries_bowled
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE
        WHEN balls_first_10_overs > 0 THEN CAST(runs_first_10_overs AS REAL) / (balls_first_10_overs / 6.0)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS avg_runs_conceded_first_10_overs,
    CASE
        WHEN balls_rest_of_innings > 0 THEN CAST(runs_rest_of_innings AS REAL) / (balls_rest_of_innings / 6.0)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS avg_runs_conceded_rest_of_innings
FROM
    BowlerStats
WHERE
    total_deliveries_bowled > 10;

intent: Analyze the momentum of scoring by looking at the average runs scored in the over immediately following an over where a batsman scored at least one six.
structure: Use a CTE to identify overs with at least one six for each batsman. Then, use another CTE to calculate the runs scored in the subsequent over for each batsman. Finally, calculate the average of these subsequent over runs, grouped by batsman.
sql:
WITH six_overs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_no
  FROM df
  WHERE
    batsman_sixes > 0
),
runs_after_six AS (
  SELECT
    s.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) = s.over_no + 1 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_in_next_over
  FROM six_overs AS s
  JOIN df AS d
    ON s.batsman = d.batsman
  GROUP BY
    s.batsman,
    s.over_no
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(runs_in_next_over) AS avg_runs_following_six
FROM runs_after_six
WHERE
  runs_in_next_over > 0
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_following_six DESC;

structure: Use conditional aggregation with CASE expressions to count wickets and total balls bowled in the first 10 overs and after the 10th over. Calculate the ratio (wickets / balls) for each phase. Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH BowlerPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_first_10,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS bowls_first_10,

intent: Analyze the sequence of batsman runs by ordering deliveries and looking at the runs scored immediately following a boundary (four or six).
structure: Use a window function to identify if a delivery was a boundary. Then, use the LEAD function to get the runs scored on the next ball, ordered by 'overs'. Calculate the average runs scored on the ball following a boundary, grouped by batsman.
sql:
WITH LaggedData AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        overs,
        LEAD(batsman, 1) OVER (ORDER BY overs) AS next_batsman,
        LEAD(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (ORDER BY overs) AS next_batsman_runs
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(next_batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM
    LaggedData
WHERE
    (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) -- Current delivery is a boundary
    AND batsman = next_batsman             -- The same batsman is on strike for the next delivery
    AND next_batsman_runs IS NOT NULL     -- Ensure a subsequent delivery exists
    AND next_batsman_runs > 0             -- The batsman scored runs on the subsequent delivery
GROUP BY
    batsman;

intent: Assess the dot ball percentage for batsmen in the powerplay (first 6 overs) and death overs (last 6 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to calculate total balls faced and dot balls for the specified phases. Then calculate the dot ball percentage for each phase.
sql:
WITH phase_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_powerplay,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 AND CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls_powerplay,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_death,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 AND CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls_death
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN balls_powerplay > 0 THEN CAST(dot_balls_powerplay AS REAL) * 100 / balls_powerplay ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_powerplay,
  CASE WHEN balls_death > 0 THEN CAST(dot_balls_death AS REAL) * 100 / balls_death ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_death
FROM phase_balls
WHERE balls_powerplay >= 10 AND balls_death >= 10
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in overs where the team scored boundaries (fours or sixes) versus overs where they did not.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to differentiate overs with boundaries from overs without. Calculate strike rate for both conditions using conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH OverBoundaryStatus AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_boundary_in_over
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs)
),
BatsmanCategoryAggregates AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        obs.has_boundary_in_over,
        SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS total_runs_in_category,
        SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced_in_category
    FROM
        df d
    JOIN
        OverBoundaryStatus obs ON d.batsman = obs.batsman AND CEIL(d.overs) = obs.over_number
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman,
        obs.has_boundary_in_over
),
BatsmanOverallAggregates AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN total_runs_in_category ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN total_balls_faced_in_category ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_overs_balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN total_runs_in_category ELSE 0 END) AS non_boundary_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN total_balls_faced_in_category ELSE 0 END) AS non_boundary_overs_balls
    FROM
        BatsmanCategoryAggregates
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    b.batsman,
    (CAST(b.boundary_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(b.boundary_overs_balls, 0) AS strike_rate_boundary_overs,
    (CAST(b.non_boundary_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(b.non_boundary_overs_balls, 0) AS strike_rate_non_boundary_overs
FROM
    BatsmanOverallAggregates b
WHERE
    b.boundary_overs_balls >= 10 OR b.non_boundary_overs_balls >= 10
ORDER BY
    b.batsman;

intent: Analyze the momentum shift by comparing the runs scored per ball in the current over against the previous over for each batsman.
structure: Using CTEs to first calculate runs and balls per over for each batsman, then using the LAG window function to get previous over's runs, and finally calculating the ratio of current over's runs per ball to previous over's runs per ball.
sql:
WITH over_runs_per_ball AS (
  SELECT batsman, CEIL(overs) AS over_no, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman, over_no
),
lagged_over_runs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    over_no,
    runs_in_over,
    balls_in_over,
    LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_runs_in_over,
    LAG(balls_in_over, 1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_balls_in_over
  FROM over_runs_per_ball
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  over_no,
  CASE WHEN balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS current_over_runs_per_ball,
  CASE WHEN prev_balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS previous_over_runs_per_ball,
  CASE WHEN prev_balls_in_over > 0 AND CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over > 0 THEN (CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over) / (CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over) ELSE NULL END AS momentum_ratio
FROM lagged_over_runs
WHERE balls_in_over > 0
ORDER BY batsman, over_no;

intent: Analyze the variation in a bowler's economy rate across different phases of the innings (powerplay, middle overs, death overs).
structure: Group by bowler, calculate average runs conceded per ball for defined phases (powerplay: first 6 overs, middle: 7-15 overs, death: last 5 overs) using CASE statements on CEIL(overs), and then calculate economy rates for each phase.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS economy_rate_powerplay,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS economy_rate_middle_overs,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS economy_rate_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING sum(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Analyze the wicket-taking ability of a bowler by comparing their wickets per ball in the powerplay versus the death overs.
structure: Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to partition bowler data into powerplay (first 6 overs) and death overs (last 5 overs). Calculate wickets per ball for each phase. Group by bowler and order by wickets per ball in the death overs.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_ball_powerplay,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_ball_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING sum(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY wickets_per_ball_death_overs DESC;

intent: Determine the average runs scored by a batsman in overs immediately following an over in which they hit at least one six.
structure: Use a CTE to identify overs where a batsman hit a six. Then, join this back to the main table to calculate the average runs scored by that batsman in the over immediately following the six-hitting over. Group by batsman and order by the average runs.
sql:
WITH six_overs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT batsman, ceil(overs) as over_no
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_sixes > 0
),
runs_after_six AS (
  SELECT
    s.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(d.overs) = s.over_no + 1 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_in_next_over
  FROM six_overs AS s
  JOIN df AS d ON s.batsman = d.batsman
  GROUP BY s.batsman, s.over_no
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(runs_in_next_over) AS avg_runs_following_six
FROM runs_after_six
WHERE runs_in_next_over > 0
GROUP BY batsman
ORDER BY avg_runs_following_six DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of a bowler when they take wickets versus when they don't, against a specific batsman.

sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_when_wicket_taken,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets = 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_when_no_wicket_taken

intent: Examine the bowling economy rate of bowlers across different phases of the innings (e.g., first 10 overs vs. rest of the innings).
structure: Group bowlers and calculate their economy rate (runs given per ball) for the first 10 overs and the rest of the innings using conditional aggregation. This involves grouping by bowler and using CASE statements on CEIL(overs) to segment the innings.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rate_first_10_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) >= 1 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) >= 1
ORDER BY bowler;

SELECT

  CASE

intent: Analyze the bowling economy rate for a specific bowler across different phases of the match.
structure: Uses CTEs to first calculate runs and balls per over for each bowler. Then, in the main query, calculates the economy rate for the first 10 overs and the remaining overs for a specified bowler using CASE statements and filtering. The core logic here is calculating economy rate per phase using CEIL(overs).
sql:
WITH over_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) as over_no,
    SUM(team_runs) as runs_in_over,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wickets_in_over,
    COUNT(*) as balls_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN balls_in_over ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN balls_in_over ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_first_10_overs,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN balls_in_over ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN balls_in_over ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rest_of_innings
FROM over_stats
WHERE bowler = 'Azmatullah' 
GROUP BY bowler;

intent: Determine the strike rate of batsmen in high-scoring overs (defined as overs with more than 10 runs) versus low-scoring overs.
structure: Use a CASE expression to categorize overs as high-scoring or low-scoring. Group by batsman and calculate strike rate for each category using conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH OverScoresCategory AS (
    SELECT
        FLOOR(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(team_runs) AS total_runs_in_over,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(team_runs) > 10 THEN 'high_scoring'
            ELSE 'low_scoring'
        END AS over_category
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        FLOOR(overs)
)
SELECT
    d.batsman,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN osc.over_category = 'high_scoring' THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN osc.over_category = 'high_scoring' THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0),
    0) AS strike_rate_high_scoring_overs,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN osc.over_category = 'low_scoring' THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN osc.over_category = 'low_scoring' THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0),
    0) AS strike_rate_low_scoring_overs
FROM
    df AS d
JOIN
    OverScoresCategory AS osc
    ON FLOOR(d.overs) = osc.over_number
GROUP BY
    d.batsman;

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen in overs where they hit boundaries (fours or sixes) versus overs where they did not hit any boundaries.
structure: Use CASE statements to categorize overs into boundary-hitting and non-boundary-hitting overs for each batsman. Calculate strike rate for each category.
sql:
WITH OverBoundaryFlags AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        FLOOR(overs) AS over_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_boundary_in_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY batsman, FLOOR(overs)
)
SELECT
    t1.batsman,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t2.has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN t1.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN t1.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(CASE WHEN t2.has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN t1.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
        END AS REAL
    ) AS strike_rate_boundary_overs,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t2.has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN t1.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN t1.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(CASE WHEN t2.has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN t1.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
        END AS REAL
    ) AS strike_rate_non_boundary_overs
FROM df AS t1
JOIN OverBoundaryFlags AS t2
    ON t1.batsman = t2.batsman AND FLOOR(t1.overs) = t2.over_number
GROUP BY t1.batsman

intent: Analyze the trend of strike rates for batsmen across different phases of an innings: early (first 10 overs), middle (next 10 overs), and late (rest of the innings).
structure: Use CASE expressions to define three phases based on CEIL(overs). Calculate strike rate for each batsman in each phase using conditional aggregation.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_early_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_middle_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 20 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_late_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Determine the ratio of runs scored per ball by a batsman compared to their previous over's performance, to analyze batting momentum.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate runs and balls per over for each batsman. Then use a window function (lag) to get previous over's data. Calculate the ratio of runs per ball.
sql:
WITH OverRunsPerBall AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_no,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_in_over
  FROM
    df
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    over_no
),
LaggedOverRuns AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    over_no,
    runs_in_over,
    balls_in_over,
    LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_runs_in_over,
    LAG(balls_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_balls_in_over
  FROM
    OverRunsPerBall
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  over_no,
  CASE WHEN balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS current_over_runs_per_ball,
  CASE WHEN prev_balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS previous_over_runs_per_ball,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_balls_in_over > 0 AND CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over > 0 THEN
      (CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over) / (CAST(prev_runs_in_over AS REAL) / prev_balls_in_over)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS momentum_ratio
FROM
  LaggedOverRuns
WHERE
  balls_in_over > 0
ORDER BY
  batsman,
  over_no;

)
SELECT

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in overs where they hit boundaries versus overs where they did not.
structure: Group by batsman, use a CASE expression to categorize overs (boundary hit or not), and calculate strike rate for each category using conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH BatsmanOverSummary AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_in_over,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced_in_over,
        MAX(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_boundary_in_over
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs)
),
BatsmanAggregatedStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN total_runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS runs_from_overs_with_boundaries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN total_balls_faced_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS balls_from_overs_with_boundaries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN total_runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS runs_from_overs_without_boundaries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN total_balls_faced_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS balls_from_overs_without_boundaries
    FROM
        BatsmanOverSummary
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(runs_from_overs_with_boundaries AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(balls_from_overs_with_boundaries, 0) AS strike_rate_with_boundaries,
    CAST(runs_from_overs_without_boundaries AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(balls_from_overs_without_boundaries, 0) AS strike_rate_without_boundaries
FROM
    BatsmanAggregatedStats
WHERE
    (balls_from_overs_with_boundaries > 0 OR balls_from_overs_without_boundaries > 0)
ORDER BY
    batsman;

intent: Identify which bowlers tend to concede more runs in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the powerplay overs (first 5 overs).

sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS avg_runs_per_ball_powerplay,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS avg_runs_per_ball_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_per_ball_death_overs - avg_runs_per_ball_powerplay DESC;

intent: Examine the momentum shift after a batsman hits a six by analyzing the runs scored off the next ball they face.
structure: Use CTEs to identify balls following a six, then calculate the average runs scored on the next ball.
sql:
WITH SixHitBalls AS (
  SELECT
    overs,
    batsman,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overs) as rn
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_sixes > 0
),
NextBallRuns AS (
  SELECT
    df.batsman,
    SUM(df.batsman_runs) AS runs_on_next_ball
  FROM df
  JOIN SixHitBalls AS shb ON df.batsman = shb.batsman AND df.overs > shb.overs
  WHERE
    df.overs = (SELECT MIN(overs) FROM df WHERE overs > shb.overs AND batsman = shb.batsman)
  GROUP BY
    df.batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(runs_on_next_ball) AS avg_runs_after_six
FROM NextBallRuns
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING AVG(runs_on_next_ball) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_after_six DESC;

intent: Analyze the wicket-taking ability of bowlers against specific batsmen.

intent: Identify the batsmen who score the majority of their runs through boundaries (fours and sixes) during the death overs.
structure: Filter for death overs (last 5 overs), group by batsman, calculate total boundary runs and total runs, then find the percentage of runs from boundaries.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,

  SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_death_overs,

intent: Examine the wicket-taking efficiency of bowlers across different phases of the innings. This query identifies bowlers who are most effective at taking wickets per ball bowled during the powerplay (first 6 overs) and death overs (last 6 overs).

sql: WITH OverPhases AS ( SELECT bowler, bowler_wickets, bowler_bowls_done, CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay' WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 6 THEN 'Death' ELSE 'Middle' END AS phase FROM df ) SELECT bowler, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_per_ball_powerplay, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_per_ball_death FROM OverPhases GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY wickets_per_ball_death DESC;

intent: Examine the change in batsman's strike rate over the course of an innings. This query calculates the strike rate for the first half and the second half of the balls faced by each batsman, showing their ability to accelerate or decelerate.
structure: Use a CTE to split deliveries faced by each batsman into two halves (using ROW_NUMBER() or similar logic based on 'overs'). Then, calculate strike rate for each half using conditional aggregation. Group by batsman.
sql: WITH BallSplit AS ( SELECT batsman, batsman_runs, batsman_bowls_faced, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman) as total_balls FROM df ), FirstHalf AS ( SELECT batsman, CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_first_half FROM BallSplit WHERE rn <= total_balls / 2 GROUP BY batsman ), SecondHalf AS ( SELECT batsman, CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_second_half FROM BallSplit WHERE rn > total_balls / 2 GROUP BY batsman ) SELECT fs.batsman, fs.strike_rate_first_half, ss.strike_rate_second_half FROM FirstHalf fs JOIN SecondHalf ss ON fs.batsman = ss.batsman WHERE fs.strike_rate_first_half IS NOT NULL AND ss.strike_rate_second_half IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ss.strike_rate_second_half - fs.strike_rate_first_half DESC;

intent: Calculate the average number of balls a batsman faces between consecutive boundaries (fours or sixes) to understand their boundary-hitting rhythm.
structure: Group by batsman, use a CTE to find the delivery index of each boundary, then use a window function to find the next boundary's index, calculate the difference in delivery indices, and finally average these differences.
sql:
WITH BallSequence AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS ball_number_faced,
    batsman_fours,
    batsman_sixes
  FROM df
),
BoundaryBalls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    ball_number_faced
  FROM BallSequence
  WHERE
    batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0
),
BoundaryIntervals AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    ball_number_faced AS current_boundary_ball_number,
    LEAD(ball_number_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY ball_number_faced) AS next_boundary_ball_number
  FROM BoundaryBalls
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(next_boundary_ball_number - current_boundary_ball_number) AS avg_balls_between_boundaries
FROM BoundaryIntervals
WHERE
  next_boundary_ball_number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  avg_balls_between_boundaries DESC;

intent: Determine the strike rate of a batsman in overs where they scored runs versus overs where they did not score any runs.
structure: Group by batsman, use CASE statements to differentiate between overs with and without batsman runs, then calculate strike rate for each category using conditional aggregation.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs > 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs > 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs > 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_with_runs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_without_runs
FROM df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
  batsman;

intent: Calculate the average runs conceded by a bowler in the death overs (last 5 overs) versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Use a CTE to define 'death overs' and 'rest of innings' based on CEIL(overs). Group by bowler and use conditional aggregation to calculate average runs conceded in each phase.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_runs_given,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 'Death Overs'
      ELSE 'Rest of Innings'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE NULL END) AS avg_runs_conceded_death_overs,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE NULL END) AS avg_runs_conceded_rest_of_innings
FROM OverPhases
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) > 0 OR COUNT(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) > 0
ORDER BY
  bowler;

intent: Compare the strike rate of a batsman in overs where they hit at least one boundary versus overs where they did not hit any boundary.
structure: Group by batsman, use CASE statements to define two types of overs: those with boundaries and those without. Calculate strike rate for each category using conditional aggregation. This uses CASE expressions.
sql:
WITH over_boundary_status AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(batsman_fours) > 0 OR SUM(batsman_sixes) > 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS has_boundary_in_over
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs)
),
delivery_classification AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        d.batsman_runs,
        d.batsman_bowls_faced,
        obs.has_boundary_in_over
    FROM
        df AS d
    JOIN
        over_boundary_status AS obs
    ON
        d.batsman = obs.batsman AND CEIL(d.overs) = obs.over_number
),
batsman_over_type_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        has_boundary_in_over,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_scored,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM
        delivery_classification
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        has_boundary_in_over
),
pivoted_batsman_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN total_runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs_boundary_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_boundary_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN total_runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs_non_boundary_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_non_boundary_overs
    FROM
        batsman_over_type_stats
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    pbs.batsman,
    CAST(pbs.runs_boundary_overs * 100.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(pbs.balls_boundary_overs, 0) AS strike_rate_with_boundary_overs,
    CAST(pbs.runs_non_boundary_overs * 100.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(pbs.balls_non_boundary_overs, 0) AS strike_rate_without_boundary_overs
FROM
    pivoted_batsman_stats AS pbs
WHERE
    pbs.balls_boundary_overs > 0 AND pbs.balls_non_boundary_overs > 0;

intent: Calculate the average number of balls a bowler bowls before taking their first wicket.
structure: Use a CTE to rank deliveries for each bowler. Filter for deliveries where wickets were taken and find the minimum delivery sequence for each bowler (first wicket). Then calculate the average of these minimums.
sql:
WITH bowler_delivery_rank AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_wickets,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) as delivery_seq
  FROM df

),
first_wicket_delivery AS (
  SELECT

    MIN(delivery_seq) AS first_wicket_delivery_num
  FROM bowler_delivery_rank

)

FROM first_wicket_delivery;

intent: Analyze the variation in strike rates between the middle overs and death overs for batsmen.
structure: Use a CTE with a CASE expression to categorize deliveries into 'middle overs' and 'death overs' based on CEIL(overs). Calculate runs per ball for each batsman in each phase. Then, perform a full outer join to compare these rates and calculate the change.
sql:
WITH MiddleOversRPB AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced), 0) AS middle_overs_runs_per_ball
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15
    GROUP BY
        batsman
),
DeathOversRPB AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced), 0) AS death_overs_runs_per_ball
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) > 15
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(m.batsman, d.batsman) AS batsman,
    m.middle_overs_runs_per_ball,
    d.death_overs_runs_per_ball,
    CASE
        WHEN m.middle_overs_runs_per_ball IS NULL OR m.middle_overs_runs_per_ball = 0 THEN NULL
        WHEN d.death_overs_runs_per_ball IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ((d.death_overs_runs_per_ball - m.middle_overs_runs_per_ball) / m.middle_overs_runs_per_ball) * 100
    END AS change_in_runs_per_ball
FROM
    MiddleOversRPB AS m
FULL OUTER JOIN
    DeathOversRPB AS d ON m.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
    m.middle_overs_runs_per_ball IS NOT NULL OR d.death_overs_runs_per_ball IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    change_in_runs_per_ball DESC NULLS LAST;

sql: WITH BatsmanOverStats AS ( SELECT batsman, CEIL(overs) AS over_number, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS bowls_faced_in_over FROM df GROUP BY batsman, CEIL(overs) ), BusyOversAgg AS ( SELECT batsman, SUM(runs_in_over) AS total_runs_in_busy_overs, SUM(bowls_faced_in_over) AS total_balls_in_busy_overs FROM BatsmanOverStats WHERE bowls_faced_in_over >= 3 GROUP BY batsman ), OverallStatsAgg AS ( SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_overall_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_overall_bowls FROM df GROUP BY batsman ) SELECT osa.batsman, CAST(osa.total_overall_runs * 100.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(osa.total_overall_bowls, 0) AS overall_strike_rate, COALESCE(CAST(boa.total_runs_in_busy_overs * 100.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(boa.total_balls_in_busy_overs, 0), 0.0) AS strike_rate_in_busy_overs FROM OverallStatsAgg osa LEFT JOIN BusyOversAgg boa ON osa.batsman = boa.batsman WHERE osa.total_overall_bowls > 0;

intent: Analyze the momentum of a batsman by comparing their runs per ball in consecutive overs.
structure: Uses a CTE to calculate runs and balls per over for each batsman, then uses a window function to get the previous over's stats, and finally calculates a ratio. Uses CTE and window function.
sql: WITH OverStats AS ( SELECT batsman, CEIL(overs) as over_no, SUM(batsman_runs) as runs_in_over, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) as balls_in_over FROM df GROUP BY batsman, over_no ), LaggedOverStats AS ( SELECT batsman, over_no, runs_in_over, balls_in_over, LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) as prev_over_runs, LAG(balls_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) as prev_over_balls FROM OverStats WHERE balls_in_over > 0 ) SELECT batsman, over_no, CASE WHEN balls_in_over > 0 THEN CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over ELSE 0 END AS current_over_rpb, CASE WHEN prev_over_balls > 0 THEN CAST(prev_over_runs AS REAL) / prev_over_balls ELSE 0 END AS previous_over_rpb, CASE WHEN prev_over_balls > 0 AND CAST(prev_over_runs AS REAL) / prev_over_balls > 0 THEN (CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over) / (CAST(prev_over_runs AS REAL) / prev_over_balls) ELSE NULL END AS momentum_ratio FROM LaggedOverStats WHERE prev_over_balls > 0 ORDER BY batsman, over_no;

intent: Calculate the proportion of runs scored by each batsman that came from boundaries (fours and sixes) in the death overs.
structure: Filter for deliveries in the death overs (last 5 overs). Group by batsman and calculate the sum of runs from boundaries (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) and total runs. Then, compute the percentage of runs from boundaries.
sql:
WITH DeathOversStats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_death,
    SUM(batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) AS boundary_runs_death
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CAST(boundary_runs_death AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_runs_death, 0) AS percentage_runs_from_boundaries_death
FROM DeathOversStats
WHERE total_runs_death > 0
  AND (CAST(boundary_runs_death AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_runs_death, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY percentage_runs_from_boundaries_death DESC;
