intent: Calculate the proportion of wickets taken by a bowler that resulted in dot balls.
structure: Use a CASE statement to identify dot balls and wickets. Group by bowler and calculate the percentage of wickets that occurred on dot balls.
sql:
SELECT 
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 AND bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS wicket_percentage_on_dot_balls
FROM df
WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY wicket_percentage_on_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Find the bowlers who conceded the most runs per ball in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Filter for deliveries in the death overs. Group by bowler and calculate the average runs conceded per ball (bowler_runs_given / bowler_bowls_done). Filter for bowlers who bowled a minimum number of balls in the death overs.
sql:
SELECT 
  bowler,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 1 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS avg_runs_per_ball_death
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 5 -- Minimum balls bowled in death overs
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_ball_death DESC;

intent: Identify batsmen who score significantly more runs per ball in the death overs compared to the middle overs.
structure: Use a CTE to categorize overs into 'middle' and 'death' phases using CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN <num> AND <num> THEN 'Middle' WHEN CEIL(overs) > <num> THEN 'Death' ELSE 'Early' END. Calculate runs per ball for each phase. Join the results for comparison.
sql:
WITH middle_overs_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS middle_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS middle_balls
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15
    GROUP BY
        batsman
),
death_overs_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) > 15
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    m.batsman,
    (m.middle_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.middle_balls, 0)) AS middle_overs_runs_per_ball,
    COALESCE(d.death_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.death_balls, 0), 0) AS death_overs_runs_per_ball,
    ((COALESCE(d.death_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.death_balls, 0), 0)) - (m.middle_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.middle_balls, 0))) / (m.middle_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.middle_balls, 0)) AS change_in_runs_per_ball
FROM
    middle_overs_stats AS m
LEFT JOIN
    death_overs_stats AS d ON m.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
    (m.middle_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.middle_balls, 0)) > 0;

intent: Determine the frequency of batsmen scoring boundaries (fours and sixes) in their first few balls faced.
structure: Group by batsman, calculate boundary percentage within the first 20 deliveries faced using conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH BattingSequence AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS ball_seq
    FROM
        df
),
First20BallsStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_fours) AS total_fours,
        SUM(batsman_sixes) AS total_sixes,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced_in_period
    FROM
        BattingSequence
    WHERE
        ball_seq <= 20
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST((total_fours + total_sixes) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_balls_faced_in_period, 0) AS boundary_percentage_first_20_balls
FROM
    First20BallsStats
WHERE
    total_balls_faced_in_period > 0;

intent: Analyze the momentum of batsmen by looking at the ratio of their runs per ball in an over compared to the previous over. This helps identify batsmen who are building on successful overs or recovering from poor ones.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs and balls faced per over for each batsman. Then, use a window function (LAG) to get the runs per ball from the previous over. Calculate the ratio of current over's RPB to previous over's RPB. Filter for overs where at least one ball was faced.
sql: WITH OverStats AS ( SELECT batsman, CEIL(overs) AS over_no, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_in_over FROM df GROUP BY batsman, CEIL(overs) HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 ), LaggedStats AS ( SELECT batsman, over_no, runs_in_over, balls_in_over, LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_over_runs, LAG(balls_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_over_balls FROM OverStats ) SELECT batsman, over_no, (CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over) AS current_over_rpb, (CAST(prev_over_runs AS REAL) / prev_over_balls) AS previous_over_rpb, (CAST(runs_in_over AS REAL) / balls_in_over) / (CAST(prev_over_runs AS REAL) / prev_over_balls) AS momentum_ratio FROM LaggedStats WHERE prev_over_balls > 0 AND (CAST(prev_over_runs AS REAL) / prev_over_balls) > 0 ORDER BY batsman, over_no;

intent: Compare the average runs conceded per ball by a bowler in overs where they took at least one wicket versus overs where they took no wickets. This reveals if wicket-taking spells are generally more or less expensive for the bowler.
structure: Use a CASE expression within AVG to conditionally average bowler_runs_given based on whether bowler_wickets is greater than 0. Group by bowler. Use a HAVING clause to filter for bowlers with both wicket-taking and non-wicket-taking overs.
sql:
WITH over_summary AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_in_over,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS total_balls_in_over,
        CASE WHEN SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_wicket_in_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
),
bowler_overall_stats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket_in_over = 1 THEN total_runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_wicket_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket_in_over = 1 THEN total_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls_wicket_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket_in_over = 0 THEN total_runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_non_wicket_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket_in_over = 0 THEN total_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls_non_wicket_overs,
        MAX(has_wicket_in_over) AS bowler_has_taken_any_wicket,
        MAX(CASE WHEN has_wicket_in_over = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bowler_has_non_wicket_over
    FROM over_summary
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    CAST(total_runs_wicket_overs AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_balls_wicket_overs, 0) AS avg_runs_per_ball_wicket_overs,
    CAST(total_runs_non_wicket_overs AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_balls_non_wicket_overs, 0) AS avg_runs_per_ball_non_wicket_overs
FROM bowler_overall_stats
WHERE
    bowler_has_taken_any_wicket = 1 AND bowler_has_non_wicket_over = 1
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Analyze the batting efficiency by calculating the ratio of runs scored to balls faced for each batsman in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Group by batsman, calculate the sum of boundary runs (fours and sixes) and sum of total runs in the death overs, then compute the ratio of boundary runs to total runs. Use a subquery to determine the start of death overs.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_runs) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_runs)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_run_percentage_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING sum(batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY boundary_run_percentage_death_overs DESC;

intent: Track the momentum of batsmen by analyzing their strike rate (runs per ball) in consecutive overs.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs and balls faced per over for each batsman. Then use another CTE with window functions (lag) to get the previous over's stats. Calculate the ratio of current over strike rate to previous over strike rate.
sql:
WITH over_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_no,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman, CEIL(overs)
),
lagged_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    over_no,
    runs_in_over,
    balls_in_over,
    LAG(runs_in_over) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_runs_in_over,
    LAG(balls_in_over) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_no) AS prev_balls_in_over
  FROM over_stats
  WHERE balls_in_over > 0 AND runs_in_over > 0
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  over_no,
  (runs_in_over * 100.0 / NULLIF(balls_in_over, 0)) AS current_over_sri,
  (prev_runs_in_over * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_balls_in_over, 0)) AS previous_over_sri,
  (runs_in_over * 100.0 / NULLIF(balls_in_over, 0)) / (prev_runs_in_over * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_balls_in_over, 0)) AS momentum_ratio
FROM lagged_stats
WHERE
  prev_balls_in_over > 0
  AND prev_runs_in_over IS NOT NULL
  AND prev_runs_in_over > 0
ORDER BY
  batsman,
  over_no;

intent: Compare the strike rates of batsmen in the powerplay (first 6 overs) versus the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to calculate runs and balls faced for powerplay and death overs separately. Compute strike rates for both phases and compare.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate_death
FROM df
WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING strike_rate_powerplay IS NOT NULL OR strike_rate_death IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Examine the trend of batsmen's scoring rate by calculating their rolling average runs per ball over a rolling window of 5 deliveries.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate runs per ball for each delivery and then apply a window function for a rolling average. Filter for deliveries where the batsman faced at least one ball.
sql:
WITH delivery_stats_faced AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS rn_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_bowls_faced = 1
),
rolling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    rn_faced,
    SUM(batsman_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sum_runs_5_balls,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sum_bowls_5_balls
  FROM delivery_stats_faced
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  overs,
  CAST(sum_runs_5_balls AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum_bowls_5_balls, 0) AS rolling_avg_sri_5_balls
FROM rolling_stats
WHERE
  rn_faced >= 5
ORDER BY batsman, overs;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the middle overs.
structure: Group by batsman, calculate average runs per ball for middle overs (overs 11-15) and death overs (overs 16-20) using CASE expressions and conditional aggregation, and compare them.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS middle_overs_runs_per_ball,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 AND CEIL(overs) <= 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 AND CEIL(overs) <= 20 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 AND CEIL(overs) <= 20 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_runs_per_ball
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 20
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING middle_overs_runs_per_ball > 0 OR death_overs_runs_per_ball > 0
ORDER BY death_overs_runs_per_ball DESC;

intent: Examine the trend of batsman strike rates across different phases of an innings.
structure: Group by batsman and use CASE expressions to define three phases (e.g., powerplay, middle, death). Calculate the strike rate for each batsman within each phase using conditional aggregation.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS powerplay_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS middle_overs_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate

intent: Find the average number of balls a bowler takes to pick their first wicket in the entire match.
structure: Use a CTE to rank deliveries for each bowler where a wicket was taken, find the minimum rank (first wicket delivery) for each bowler, and then calculate the average of these first wicket delivery numbers.
sql:
WITH ranked_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) as delivery_number
  FROM df
  WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
),
first_wicket AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    MIN(delivery_number) as balls_to_first_wicket
  FROM ranked_wickets
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(balls_to_first_wicket AS REAL)) AS avg_balls_to_first_wicket
FROM first_wicket;

intent: Determine the longest streak of dot balls faced by any batsman.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls, assign a grouping number to consecutive dot balls, and then find the maximum streak length for each batsman using another CTE.
sql:
WITH
  dot_balls AS (
    SELECT
      batsman,
      overs,
      CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot
    FROM df
  ),
  streak_groups AS (
    SELECT
      batsman,
      overs,
      is_dot,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) - SUM(is_dot) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as grp
    FROM dot_balls
  ),
  streaks AS (
    SELECT
      batsman,
      grp,
      COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM streak_groups
    WHERE is_dot = 1
    GROUP BY batsman, grp
  )
SELECT
  batsman,
  MAX(streak_length) AS longest_dot_ball_streak
FROM streaks
GROUP BY batsman
ORDER BY longest_dot_ball_streak DESC;

intent: Calculate the average runs per over conceded by each bowler in the death overs.
structure: Filter for death overs (last 5 overs), group by bowler, and calculate the average of `team_runs` for each bowler, ensuring to group by the over number using CEIL(overs).
sql:
WITH MaxOver AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num
    FROM df
)
SELECT
    d.bowler,
    CEIL(d.overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(d.bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_per_over
FROM
    df AS d
CROSS JOIN
    MaxOver mo
WHERE
    CEIL(d.overs) > mo.max_over_num - 5
GROUP BY
    d.bowler,
    CEIL(d.overs)
ORDER BY
    d.bowler,
    over_number;

intent: Examine the strike rate variation of batsmen across different phases of the innings (e.g., Powerplay, Middle Overs, Death Overs).
structure: Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to define innings phases. Calculate strike rate for each phase. Group by batsman and phase.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
    WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
    ELSE 'Death Overs'
  END AS phase,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate

intent: Compare the average runs scored per ball by a batsman in overs where they hit at least one boundary versus overs where they did not.
structure: Use conditional aggregation with CASE statement to distinguish boundary-hitting overs from non-boundary-hitting overs. Calculate average runs per ball for each case. Group by batsman.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS avg_runs_per_ball_with_boundary,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (batsman_fours = 0 AND batsman_sixes = 0) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN (batsman_fours = 0 AND batsman_sixes = 0) THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS avg_runs_per_ball_without_boundary
FROM df

sql: WITH last_overs AS (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) as total_overs FROM df) SELECT d.batsman, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS strike_rate_death_overs, CAST(SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS overall_strike_rate FROM df d WHERE d.batsman_bowls_faced > 0 GROUP BY d.batsman HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

sql: SELECT batsman, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_first_6, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_rest FROM df GROUP BY batsman HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0) OR (SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) = 0) OR (SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0) ORDER BY (boundary_percentage_first_6 - boundary_percentage_rest) DESC;

intent: Examine the strike rate of batsmen specifically against the bowler '{bowler}'. This focuses on head-to-head performance rather than overall batting.
structure: Filter deliveries for the specific bowler, then group by batsman and calculate their strike rate against that bowler. Include a condition to consider only batsmen who faced a minimum number of balls against the specified bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_vs_bowler
FROM df
WHERE

intent: Track the momentum of batsmen by calculating the rolling average of their strike rate over the last 5 balls faced. This smooths out short-term fluctuations and reveals underlying batting rhythm.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate the strike rate for each ball. Then, use another CTE with a window function to compute the rolling average strike rate over the preceding 5 balls, ordered by overs. Finally, select the rolling average strike rate.
sql:
WITH FacedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_bowls_faced = 1
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  overs,
  (CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS REAL) * 100.0) /
  NULLIF(CAST(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS REAL), 0) AS rolling_avg_strike_rate_5_balls
FROM FacedBalls
ORDER BY
  batsman,
  overs;

intent: Evaluate bowler efficiency by comparing their average runs conceded per ball in the powerplay (first 6 overs) versus the rest of the innings. This highlights their performance during the initial, often high-scoring, phase.
structure: Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to differentiate between powerplay and non-powerplay overs. Group by bowler and calculate the average runs per ball for each phase. Filter bowlers who have bowled in both phases and bowled at least 5 balls.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_ball_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_ball_non_powerplay
FROM df
WHERE bowler_bowls_done > 0
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 5 AND avg_runs_per_ball_powerplay IS NOT NULL AND avg_runs_per_ball_non_powerplay IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_per_ball_powerplay ASC;

intent: Determine the strike rate of batsmen during the death overs (last 5 overs of the innings).
structure: Calculate the total batsman runs divided by total batsman bowls faced for deliveries in the last 5 overs, grouped by batsman. Use a subquery to find the maximum over number.
sql:
WITH MaxOver AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE
  CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over_num FROM MaxOver) - 5 AND batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Find the longest streak of dot balls faced by any batsman in the match.
structure: Identify dot balls, use a window function to group consecutive dot balls, and find the maximum length of these streaks per batsman.
sql:
WITH DotBalls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot
  FROM df
),
StreakGroups AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    is_dot,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) - SUM(is_dot) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS grp
  FROM DotBalls
),
Streaks AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    grp,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM StreakGroups
  WHERE is_dot = 1
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    grp
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  MAX(streak_length) AS longest_dot_ball_streak
FROM Streaks
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  longest_dot_ball_streak DESC
LIMIT 1;

intent: Calculate the average number of balls faced by a batsman before getting out for a duck (0 runs scored).
structure: Filter for deliveries where batsman_runs is 0 and the batsman faced at least one ball. Use a subquery to find the first duck for each batsman, then calculate the average balls faced before that duck.
sql:
WITH BatsmanBallsFaced AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_runs = 0
),
FirstDuckOver AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    MIN(overs) AS first_duck_delivery_index
  FROM BatsmanBallsFaced
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  df.batsman,
  AVG(df.batsman_bowls_faced) AS avg_balls_to_first_duck
FROM df
JOIN FirstDuckOver ON df.batsman = FirstDuckOver.batsman AND df.overs < FirstDuckOver.first_duck_delivery_index
WHERE df.batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY df.batsman
ORDER BY avg_balls_to_first_duck ASC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of a batsman in the death overs (last 5 overs) versus their overall strike rate, for batsmen who have faced a significant number of balls in death overs.
structure: Use a CTE to find the maximum over number. Then, calculate the strike rate for death overs and overall strike rate for each batsman. Filter for batsmen with a minimum number of balls faced in death overs. Use CASE statements and CEIL(overs) for phase definition. Employ window functions for calculating sums within death overs.
sql:
WITH last_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT
  d.batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE WHEN SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate
FROM df d
WHERE d.batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY d.batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 10
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

sql: WITH PowerplayStats AS (SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS pp_runs, SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS pp_bowls FROM df WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 10 GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0), MiddleOversStats AS (SELECT bowler, SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS mo_runs, SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS mo_bowls FROM df WHERE CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 11 AND 15 GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0) SELECT p.bowler, (p.pp_runs * 6.0 / p.pp_bowls) AS economy_rate_powerplay, (m.mo_runs * 6.0 / m.mo_bowls) AS economy_rate_middle_overs FROM PowerplayStats AS p INNER JOIN MiddleOversStats AS m ON p.bowler = m.bowler ORDER BY economy_rate_powerplay ASC

intent: Calculate the proportion of wickets taken by a bowler in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their total wickets.
structure: Use a CTE to find the maximum over number. Then group by bowler. Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to count wickets in death overs and total wickets. Calculate the proportion.
sql:
WITH last_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(bowler_wickets) ELSE 0 END AS death_over_wicket_proportion
FROM df
WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0
ORDER BY death_over_wicket_proportion DESC;

  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_boundary_ball,

intent: Analyze the change in batsman strike rate from the early part of an innings to the death overs.
structure: Group by batsman, calculate strike rate for early overs (1-10) and death overs (last 10), compare these strike rates.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strike_rate_early_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT MAX(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT MAX(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT MAX(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  strike_rate_early_overs IS NOT NULL AND strike_rate_death_overs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the trend of dot ball percentage for a specific bowler across different phases of an innings.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate dot balls. Use another CTE for rolling average of dot ball percentage. Group by bowler and innings phase (early, middle, late).
sql:
WITH DotBallDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
  FROM df
),
PhaseDotBalls AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(is_dot_ball) AS dot_balls,
    COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries
  FROM DotBallDeliveries
  GROUP BY bowler, phase
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  phase,
  CASE WHEN total_deliveries > 0 THEN CAST(dot_balls AS REAL) * 100 / total_deliveries ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage
FROM PhaseDotBalls
ORDER BY bowler, CASE phase WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1 WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2 WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3 END;

intent: Analyze the longest streak of dot balls faced by a batsman.
structure: Use CTEs to identify dot balls, create streak groups using window functions, and then calculate the maximum streak length per batsman.
sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
    -- Assign a sequential number to each ball faced by a batsman (overall `rn_overall`)
    -- and a sequential number to balls of the same type (dot ball or not-dot ball) for each batsman (`rn_type_specific`).
    -- The difference between these two row numbers will be constant for consecutive balls of the same type.
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS rn_overall,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman, (CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY overs) AS rn_type_specific
    FROM
        df
),
StreakIdentifiers AS (
    -- Calculate a unique `streak_group_id` for each consecutive streak of dot balls.
    -- The `rn_overall - rn_type_specific` trick ensures that consecutive identical values
    -- (in this case, `is_dot_ball = 1`) get the same `streak_group_id`.
    SELECT
        batsman,
        (rn_overall - rn_type_specific) AS streak_group_id
    FROM
        RankedBalls
    WHERE
        is_dot_ball = 1 -- We are only interested in streaks of dot balls
),
StreakLengths AS (
    -- Count the number of balls in each identified streak of dot balls for each batsman.
    SELECT
        batsman,
        streak_group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS current_streak_length
    FROM
        StreakIdentifiers
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        streak_group_id
)
-- Finally, find the maximum streak length among all streaks for each batsman.
-- Order the results by the longest streak in descending order.
SELECT
    batsman,
    MAX(current_streak_length) AS longest_dot_ball_streak
FROM
    StreakLengths
GROUP BY
    batsman
ORDER BY
    longest_dot_ball_streak DESC;

intent: Compare the boundary percentage of a specific batsman against all bowlers.
structure: Filter for a specific batsman using a placeholder. Calculate boundary percentage for each bowler faced by this batsman.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_runs) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage
FROM df
WHERE batsman = 'Head'
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC;

intent: Determine the longest streak of dot balls faced by each batsman.
structure: Use CASE expressions to identify dot balls. Employ window functions (ROW_NUMBER and SUM) to group consecutive dot balls. Then, group by batsman and the calculated group to find the length of each streak. Finally, find the maximum streak length per batsman.
sql:
WITH dot_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
  FROM df
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    is_dot_ball,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) - SUM(is_dot_ball) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS streak_group
  FROM dot_balls
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    streak_group,
    COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM streak_groups
  WHERE is_dot_ball = 1
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    streak_group
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  MAX(streak_length) AS longest_dot_ball_streak
FROM streaks
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  longest_dot_ball_streak DESC;

sql: WITH innings_midpoint AS (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) / 2.0 AS mid_over FROM df), strike_rates AS (SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls FROM df GROUP BY batsman), second_half_strike_rates AS (SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) AS second_half_runs, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS second_half_balls FROM df WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT mid_over FROM innings_midpoint) GROUP BY batsman) SELECT s.batsman, CASE WHEN s.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(s.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / s.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate, CASE WHEN sh.second_half_balls > 0 THEN CAST(sh.second_half_runs AS REAL) * 100 / sh.second_half_balls ELSE 0 END AS second_half_strike_rate FROM strike_rates AS s JOIN second_half_strike_rates AS sh ON s.batsman = sh.batsman WHERE s.total_balls > 10 AND sh.second_half_balls > 5 ORDER BY second_half_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Calculate the percentage of runs scored through boundaries (fours and sixes) for each batsman in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to determine the total overs. Filter deliveries within the last 5 overs. Calculate the total runs from boundaries and total runs scored by each batsman in this phase. Compute the percentage.
sql:
WITH last_overs AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_runs)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_percentage_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE
  CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY
  boundary_percentage_death_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the correlation between dot balls faced and subsequent boundaries hit by batsmen.
structure: Use window functions to find the dot ball status and the runs scored on the immediate next ball for each batsman. Then, aggregate to count instances where a dot ball is followed by a boundary.
sql:
WITH delivery_flags AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
    CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary
  FROM df
),
lagged_flags AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    is_boundary,
    LAG(is_dot_ball, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS previous_ball_was_dot
  FROM delivery_flags
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  COUNT(*) AS dot_balls_followed_by_boundary
FROM lagged_flags
WHERE
  previous_ball_was_dot = 1 AND is_boundary = 1
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  dot_balls_followed_by_boundary DESC;

intent: Compare the run differential (runs scored vs. runs conceded) for each bowler across different phases of the game: powerplay, middle overs, and death overs.
structure: Define three phases: powerplay (1-6 overs), middle (7-15 overs), and death (16+ overs) using CEIL(overs) and CASE. Calculate total runs given and total wickets taken for each bowler in each phase. Compute run differential (runs_given - wickets * magic_number). Group by bowler.
sql: WITH phase_runs AS (SELECT bowler, CEIL(overs) AS over_num, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS powerplay_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS powerplay_wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_wickets, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_wickets FROM df GROUP BY bowler, over_num) SELECT bowler, (SUM(powerplay_runs) - SUM(powerplay_wickets)*30) AS powerplay_run_differential, (SUM(middle_overs_runs) - SUM(middle_overs_wickets)*30) AS middle_overs_run_differential, (SUM(death_overs_runs) - SUM(death_overs_wickets)*30) AS death_overs_run_differential FROM phase_runs GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY powerplay_run_differential DESC;

intent: Calculate the longest streak of overs where a specific batsman {batsman} scored at least one boundary.
structure: Create a CTE to identify overs where the specified batsman hit a boundary (four or six). Then, use another CTE to group consecutive overs with boundaries using row numbering and difference of row numbers. Finally, calculate the maximum streak length per batsman.
sql: WITH boundary_overs AS ( SELECT batsman, CEIL(overs) as over_number, CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS had_boundary FROM df WHERE batsman = 'Head' ), streak_groups AS ( SELECT batsman, over_number, had_boundary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_number) - SUM(had_boundary) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_number) as grp FROM boundary_overs ), streaks AS ( SELECT batsman, grp, COUNT(*) as streak_length FROM streak_groups WHERE had_boundary = 1 GROUP BY batsman, grp ) SELECT batsman, MAX(streak_length) as longest_boundary_streak FROM streaks GROUP BY batsman;
description: Finds the longest sequence of consecutive overs in which a specified batsman managed to score at least one boundary (a four or a six).
original_sql:
WITH BoundaryOversPlayed AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_boundary_in_over
    FROM df
    WHERE batsman = '{batsman}'
    GROUP BY batsman, CEIL(overs)
),
Streaks AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        over_number,
        over_number - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY over_number) AS streak_group
    FROM BoundaryOversPlayed
    WHERE had_boundary_in_over = 1
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    COALESCE(MAX(T.streak_length), 0) AS longest_boundary_streak
FROM (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        streak_group,
        COUNT(over_number) AS streak_length
    FROM Streaks
    GROUP BY batsman, streak_group
) AS T
GROUP BY batsman;

intent: Analyze the change in batsman's scoring rate immediately after hitting a boundary versus immediately after not hitting a boundary.
structure: Use CTEs to flag boundaries and calculate scoring rates. Use window functions to get the next ball's boundary status and scoring rate. Calculate the change in scoring rate and average it.
sql:
WITH BallData AS (
    SELECT
        overs,
        batsman,
        (CASE
            WHEN batsman_bowls_faced > 0 THEN CAST(batsman_runs AS REAL) / batsman_bowls_faced
            ELSE 0.0
        END) AS current_ball_scoring_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN batsman_bowls_faced > 0 AND batsman_fours = 0 AND batsman_sixes = 0 THEN 'non_boundary'
            WHEN batsman_bowls_faced > 0 AND (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN 'boundary'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS delivery_type_of_current_ball
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        batsman_bowls_faced > 0 AND batsman IS NOT NULL
),
ScoringRateWithNextBall AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        delivery_type_of_current_ball,
        current_ball_scoring_rate,
        LEAD(current_ball_scoring_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS next_ball_scoring_rate
    FROM
        BallData
    WHERE
        delivery_type_of_current_ball IS NOT NULL
),
ScoringRateChanges AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        delivery_type_of_current_ball,
        next_ball_scoring_rate - current_ball_scoring_rate AS scoring_rate_change
    FROM
        ScoringRateWithNextBall
    WHERE
        next_ball_scoring_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(CASE WHEN delivery_type_of_current_ball = 'non_boundary' THEN scoring_rate_change END) AS avg_scoring_rate_increase_after_non_boundary,
    AVG(CASE WHEN delivery_type_of_current_ball = 'boundary' THEN scoring_rate_change END) AS avg_scoring_rate_increase_after_boundary
FROM
    ScoringRateChanges
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    avg_scoring_rate_increase_after_non_boundary IS NOT NULL OR avg_scoring_rate_increase_after_boundary IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    avg_scoring_rate_increase_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Identify bowlers who concede a high proportion of runs in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a subquery to find the total number of overs. Filter deliveries to the last 5 overs. Group by bowler and calculate the percentage of total runs conceded in this phase.
sql:
WITH MatchOvers AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_match_overs
    FROM df
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_match_overs FROM MatchOvers) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bowler_runs_given), 0) AS death_over_runs_proportion
FROM
    df
GROUP BY
    bowler
HAVING
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) > 0
ORDER BY
    death_over_runs_proportion DESC;

intent: Analyze the run-scoring trend of a specific batsman by looking at their runs scored per over.
structure: Group by batsman and over number, calculate the sum of batsman runs for each over, and then compute the average of these per-over runs for each batsman.
sql:
WITH runs_per_over AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    ceil(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    over_number
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(runs_in_over) AS avg_runs_per_over
FROM runs_per_over
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_per_over DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate overall strike rate and death overs strike rate for each batsman using subqueries or CTEs. Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to handle division by zero.
sql:
WITH batsman_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
death_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  bs.batsman,
  CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(bs.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / bs.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN dos.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(dos.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / dos.death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM batsman_stats AS bs
LEFT JOIN death_overs_stats AS dos
  ON bs.batsman = dos.batsman
WHERE
  bs.total_balls > 0 AND dos.death_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

structure: Use a CASE statement to identify boundaries scored by the batsman. Filter for death overs. Group by bowler and calculate the percentage of boundaries conceded.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS boundary_concession_percentage
FROM df
WHERE
  CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY

intent: Identify the batsmen who have the highest strike rate in the first 10 overs and the last 10 overs of the match.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate strike rates for the first 10 overs and last 10 overs separately. Join the CTEs and order by strike rate.
sql:
WITH first_10_overs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_10,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_10
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) <= 10
  GROUP BY
    batsman
),
last_10_overs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_last_10,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_last_10
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 10
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  f10.batsman,
  CASE WHEN f10.balls_10 > 0 THEN CAST(f10.runs_10 AS REAL) * 100 / f10.balls_10 ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_first_10,
  CASE WHEN l10.balls_last_10 > 0 THEN CAST(l10.runs_last_10 AS REAL) * 100 / l10.balls_last_10 ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_last_10
FROM first_10_overs AS f10
JOIN last_10_overs AS l10
  ON f10.batsman = l10.batsman
WHERE
  f10.balls_10 > 0 AND l10.balls_last_10 > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_first_10 DESC, strike_rate_last_10 DESC;

intent: Determine the proportion of a bowler's total runs conceded that were given away in the death overs (last 5 overs of the match).
structure: Use a CTE to find the total overs in the match. Then, calculate the runs conceded in the death overs and divide by total runs conceded, grouped by bowler.
sql:
WITH MaxOverCeil AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_val
    FROM df
),
BowlerTotalRuns AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler
),
BowlerDeathRuns AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler,
        SUM(d.bowler_runs_given) AS death_over_runs
    FROM
        df AS d
    WHERE
        CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over_val FROM MaxOverCeil) - 5
    GROUP BY
        d.bowler
)
SELECT
    btr.bowler,
    CAST(COALESCE(bdr.death_over_runs, 0) AS REAL) / btr.total_runs AS death_over_runs_proportion
FROM
    BowlerTotalRuns AS btr
LEFT JOIN
    BowlerDeathRuns AS bdr
ON
    btr.bowler = bdr.bowler
WHERE
    btr.total_runs > 0;

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen specifically in the death overs (last 5 overs) and compare it to their strike rate in non-death overs.
structure: Use a CTE to find the total overs. Calculate strike rates for death overs and non-death overs separately using conditional aggregation and division by faced balls, grouped by batsman. Filter for batsmen who have faced balls in both phases.
sql:
WITH last_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strike_rate_non_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING strike_rate_non_death_overs IS NOT NULL AND strike_rate_death_overs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Identify the batsman with the highest strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) who has also faced a minimum of 10 balls in that phase.
structure: Use a CTE to find the total overs. Filter for deliveries in the death overs, calculate strike rate, and then select the batsman with the highest strike rate who meets the minimum balls faced criteria.
sql:
WITH last_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM last_overs) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) >= 10
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC
LIMIT 1;

intent: Analyze the impact of dot balls bowled by a specific bowler on the overall economy rate in the death overs.
structure: Calculate the economy rate for a given bowler, specifically focusing on their performance in death overs (last 5 overs). This involves calculating runs conceded per ball bowled. Use a subquery to determine the total overs and then filter for death overs. Aggregate runs and balls for the specified bowler in this phase. sql:
WITH MaxOver AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS total_max_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(bowler_runs_given) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bowler_bowls_done), 0) AS economy_rate_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_max_over FROM MaxOver) - 5
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY economy_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the performance of a specific bowler in terms of wickets taken per over throughout different phases of the match (powerplay, middle, death).
structure: Calculate wickets taken per over for a specified bowler across three phases: powerplay (overs 1-6), middle overs (overs 7-15), and death overs (overs 16 onwards). Use a CASE expression to categorize deliveries into these phases. Aggregate wickets and count deliveries within each phase for the bowler. Calculate wickets per over by dividing total wickets by total overs in each phase. Use CTEs to structure phase-wise data.
sql:
WITH bowler_phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE 
      WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS wicket_taking_deliveries
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler,
    phase
),
phase_overs AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        phase,
        COUNT(*) as total_deliveries_in_phase
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        phase
)
SELECT
  bps.bowler,
  bps.phase,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(p.overs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bps.total_wickets) AS REAL) / COUNT(p.overs) ELSE 0 END AS wickets_per_over
FROM bowler_phase_stats AS bps
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bowler,
        ceil(overs) as overs,
        CASE 
            WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            ELSE 'Death Overs'
        END AS phase
    FROM df
) as p ON bps.bowler = p.bowler AND bps.phase = p.phase
WHERE bps.bowler = 'Fazalhaq Farooqi'
GROUP BY bps.bowler, bps.phase
ORDER BY
  bps.bowler,
  CASE bps.phase
    WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3
  END;

intent: Compare the number of dot balls faced by batsmen who were dismissed with those who were not dismissed in the death overs.
structure: Differentiate between dismissed and not-dismissed batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs). Calculate the total dot balls faced by each group. Use a CASE statement to identify dot balls and another CASE statement to distinguish between dismissed and not-dismissed batsmen. Group by these categories and sum the dot balls. Use a subquery to identify the death overs.
sql:
WITH MaxOverNum AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num FROM df
),
DeathOversDismissals AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1.batsman
    FROM df AS T1, MaxOverNum AS T2
    WHERE CEIL(T1.overs) > T2.max_over_num - 5
      AND T1.bowler_wickets = 1
),
DotBallsInDeathOvers AS (
    SELECT
        T1.batsman,
        COUNT(*) AS dot_balls_faced_last_5_overs
    FROM df AS T1, MaxOverNum AS T2
    WHERE CEIL(T1.overs) > T2.max_over_num - 5
      AND T1.batsman_runs = 0
    GROUP BY T1.batsman
)
SELECT
    DOD.batsman,
    DBD.dot_balls_faced_last_5_overs
FROM DeathOversDismissals AS DOD
JOIN DotBallsInDeathOvers AS DBD
    ON DOD.batsman = DBD.batsman
WHERE DBD.dot_balls_faced_last_5_overs >= 1
ORDER BY DBD.dot_balls_faced_last_5_overs DESC;

    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_death_overs,

    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS balls_death_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS balls_other_overs
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN balls_death_overs > 0 THEN CAST(runs_death_overs AS REAL) / balls_death_overs
    ELSE NULL
  END AS economy_rate_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN balls_other_overs > 0 THEN CAST(runs_other_overs AS REAL) / balls_other_overs
    ELSE NULL
  END AS economy_rate_other_overs
FROM OverEconomy
WHERE
  balls_death_overs > 0 AND balls_other_overs > 0
ORDER BY
  economy_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Find the longest streak of consecutive overs where a specific bowler took at least one wicket.
structure: Uses CTEs to flag wicket-taking overs for a specific bowler, then uses window functions (ROW_NUMBER, SUM) to identify consecutive streaks of wicket-taking overs, and finally aggregates to find the max streak length. Includes a placeholder for bowler.
sql:
WITH WicketOvers AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wicket_over
  FROM df
  WHERE bowler = 'Azmatullah'
),
StreakGroups AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    over_number,
    is_wicket_over,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_number) - SUM(is_wicket_over) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_number) AS streak_group
  FROM WicketOvers
),
Streaks AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    streak_group,
    COUNT(over_number) AS streak_length
  FROM StreakGroups
  WHERE is_wicket_over = 1
  GROUP BY bowler, streak_group
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  MAX(streak_length) AS longest_wicket_taking_streak
FROM Streaks
GROUP BY bowler;

intent: Analyze the batsman's scoring efficiency (runs per ball) in powerplay overs (first 6) versus middle overs (7-15) and death overs (16+).
structure: Uses CASE statements to define over phases, then calculates average runs per ball faced within each phase for each batsman. Returns wide format.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS scoring_efficiency_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS scoring_efficiency_middle_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS scoring_efficiency_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 30
ORDER BY
  scoring_efficiency_powerplay DESC;

intent: Calculate the average number of runs conceded per wicket taken by each bowler in different phases of the match.
structure: Grouping by bowler and using CASE statements to define phases (early, middle, late). Calculates sum of runs given and sum of wickets taken for each phase, then computes the average runs per wicket. Uses CASE expressions.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_early,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_middle,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_late
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING
  SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_per_wicket_early ASC;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate (runs per ball faced) for each batsman during the 'death overs' (last 5 overs) and compare it to their scoring rate in non-death overs.
structure: Calculate average batsman runs per ball faced, segmented by over phase (death vs. non-death). Uses CASE statements for phase definition and AVG aggregation.
sql:
WITH MaxOverValue AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_overall_over_num
    FROM df
),
BatsmanPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_overall_over_num FROM MaxOverValue) - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_overall_over_num FROM MaxOverValue) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT max_overall_over_num FROM MaxOverValue) - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT max_overall_over_num FROM MaxOverValue) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_overs_balls
    FROM
        df AS d
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(death_overs_balls, 0) AS strike_rate_death_overs,
    CAST(non_death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(non_death_overs_balls, 0) AS strike_rate_non_death_overs
FROM
    BatsmanPhaseStats
WHERE
    (death_overs_balls > 0 OR non_death_overs_balls > 0);

sql: WITH BallSequence AS ( SELECT overs, batsman, batsman_runs, batsman_bowls_faced, LAG(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev1_is_dot, LAG(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev2_is_dot, LAG(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 3, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev3_is_dot FROM df ) SELECT batsman, SUM(batsman_runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced), 0) AS scoring_rate_after_3_dots FROM BallSequence WHERE prev1_is_dot = 1 AND prev2_is_dot = 1 AND prev3_is_dot = 1 GROUP BY batsman HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0;

intent: Compare the overall strike rate of a specific batsman against the strike rate of all other batsmen combined in the match.
structure: Calculates strike rate (runs/balls) for a target batsman and for all other batsmen, using conditional aggregation and subqueries for filtering.
sql:
WITH AllBatsmenStats AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_match_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_match_balls
    FROM
        df
),
IndividualBatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS batsman_total_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS batsman_total_balls_faced
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
)
SELECT
    ibs.batsman,
    CAST(ibs.batsman_total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(ibs.batsman_total_balls_faced, 0) AS batsman_strike_rate,
    CAST((ams.total_match_runs - ibs.batsman_total_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF((ams.total_match_balls - ibs.batsman_total_balls_faced), 0) AS others_strike_rate
FROM
    IndividualBatsmanStats ibs
CROSS JOIN
    AllBatsmenStats ams
WHERE
    (ams.total_match_balls - ibs.batsman_total_balls_faced) > 0;

intent: Identify bowlers who have a significantly higher economy rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs and balls for death and non-death overs for each bowler. Then, calculate economy rates and filter for bowlers with a notable difference.
sql:
WITH PhaseStats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_death,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS balls_death,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_non_death,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS balls_non_death
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN balls_death > 0 THEN CAST(runs_death AS REAL) / balls_death ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate_death,
  CASE WHEN balls_non_death > 0 THEN CAST(runs_non_death AS REAL) / balls_non_death ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate_non_death
FROM PhaseStats
WHERE
  balls_death > 0 AND balls_non_death > 0
ORDER BY
  economy_rate_death DESC;

intent: Determine the longest streak of consecutive wicket-taking overs for a given bowler.
structure: Use CTEs to first identify overs where the specified bowler took wickets. Then, use a window function to assign a streak group. Finally, count the length of these streaks.
sql:
WITH WicketOvers AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    ceil(overs) AS over_number,
    CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wicket_over
  FROM df
  WHERE
    bowler = 'Azmatullah'
    AND bowler_wickets > 0
),
StreakGroups AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    over_number,
    is_wicket_over,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_number) - SUM(is_wicket_over) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_number) AS streak_group
  FROM WicketOvers
),
Streaks AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    streak_group,
    COUNT(over_number) AS streak_length
  FROM StreakGroups
  WHERE
    is_wicket_over = 1
  GROUP BY
    bowler,
    streak_group
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  MAX(streak_length) AS longest_wicket_taking_streak
FROM Streaks
GROUP BY
  bowler;

original_sql:
WITH WicketTakingOvers AS (
    SELECT
        CEILING(overs) AS over_number
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        bowler = '{bowler}'
        AND bowler_wickets > 0
    GROUP BY
        CEILING(overs)
),
NumberedOvers AS (
    SELECT
        over_number,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY over_number) AS rn
    FROM
        WicketTakingOvers
),
StreakGroups AS (
    SELECT
        over_number - rn AS streak_group
    FROM
        NumberedOvers
)
SELECT
    '{bowler}' AS bowler,
    COALESCE(MAX(streak_length), 0) AS longest_wicket_taking_streak
FROM (
    SELECT
        streak_group,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM
        StreakGroups
    GROUP BY
        streak_group
) AS final_streaks;

sql: SELECT bowler, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS dot_ball_percent_early, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 6.0, 0), 0.0) AS wickets_per_over_early, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS dot_ball_percent_middle, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 6.0, 0), 0.0) AS wickets_per_over_middle, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS dot_ball_percent_late, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 6.0, 0), 0.0) AS wickets_per_over_late FROM df GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

intent: Determine the average runs conceded per wicket by bowlers in their first spell (first 4 overs bowled) versus the rest of their spells.
structure: Use CASE expressions to differentiate between 'first spell' (CEIL(overs) <= 4) and 'rest of spell'. Group by bowler and calculate the average runs conceded per wicket for each phase using conditional aggregation.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 4 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 4 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 4 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_first_4_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 4 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 4 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 4 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_rest_of_spell
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 4 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 4 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_wicket_first_4_overs DESC;

intent: Find the total number of dot balls conceded by each bowler in the first 6 overs (powerplay) versus the rest of the match.
structure: Use CASE expressions to categorize deliveries into 'powerplay' (CEIL(overs) <= 6) and 'rest of match'. Group by bowler and count dot balls (batsman_runs = 0) for each phase using conditional aggregation.
sql:
SELECT

FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY dot_balls_powerplay DESC;

intent: Find the batsman who has the highest strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use a CASE expression to define 'death overs' (last 5 overs). Calculate strike rate for death overs and overall strike rate for each batsman. Filter for batsmen who have faced a minimum number of balls in death overs. Order by death over strike rate.
sql:
WITH max_over_info AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_number
    FROM df
),
batsman_death_overs_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_overs_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_overs_balls_faced
    FROM df
    CROSS JOIN max_over_info
    WHERE CEIL(df.overs) > max_over_info.max_over_number - 5
    GROUP BY batsman
    HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) >= 10
),
batsman_overall_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS overall_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS overall_balls_faced
    FROM df
    GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
    td.batsman,
    CAST(td.death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / td.death_overs_balls_faced AS strike_rate_death_overs,
    CAST(toverall.overall_runs AS REAL) * 100 / toverall.overall_balls_faced AS overall_strike_rate
FROM batsman_death_overs_stats AS td
JOIN batsman_overall_stats AS toverall
    ON td.batsman = toverall.batsman
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC
LIMIT 1;

intent: Calculate the longest streak of wicket-taking overs for a specific bowler.
structure: Use a CTE to flag overs where the bowler took wickets. Then, use window functions to assign streak groups based on consecutive wicket-taking overs. Finally, group by streak group to find the length of each streak and identify the maximum streak length.
sql:
WITH wicketovers AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wicket_over
  FROM df
  WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
),
streakgroups AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    over_number,
    is_wicket_over,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_number) - SUM(is_wicket_over) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_number) as streak_group
  FROM wicketovers
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    streak_group,
    COUNT(over_number) AS streak_length
  FROM streakgroups
  WHERE is_wicket_over = 1
  GROUP BY bowler, streak_group
)
SELECT 
  bowler, 
  MAX(streak_length) AS longest_wicket_taking_streak
FROM streaks
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY longest_wicket_taking_streak DESC;

intent: Determine the proportion of total runs scored by each batsman that came from boundaries (fours and sixes) in the first 10 overs.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE expressions with CEIL(overs) to filter for the first 10 overs. Calculate the sum of runs from fours and sixes, and divide by the total runs scored in that phase. Filter for batsmen with runs in this phase.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_run_proportion_first_10_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 10
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  boundary_run_proportion_first_10_overs DESC;

intent: Find the longest streak of overs where a specific bowler did not concede any runs.
structure: Use CTEs. First CTE identifies overs with zero runs conceded by the bowler. Second CTE calculates consecutive streaks of these overs using a row number difference. Finally, group by bowler and find the max streak length.
sql:
WITH AllBowlers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bowler
    FROM df
),
OverRuns AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_conceded
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
),
BowlerOversOrdered AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        over_num,
        (total_runs_conceded = 0) AS is_no_run_over,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_num) AS seq_all_overs
    FROM
        OverRuns
),
StreaksGrouped AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        seq_all_overs - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY over_num) AS streak_group
    FROM
        BowlerOversOrdered
    WHERE
        is_no_run_over = TRUE
),
IndividualStreaks AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        streak_group,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM
        StreaksGrouped
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        streak_group
),
MaxStreaks AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        MAX(streak_length) AS longest_no_run_over_streak
    FROM
        IndividualStreaks
    GROUP BY
        bowler
)
SELECT
    ab.bowler,
    COALESCE(ms.longest_no_run_over_streak, 0) AS longest_no_run_over_streak
FROM
    AllBowlers ab
LEFT JOIN
    MaxStreaks ms ON ab.bowler = ms.bowler;

intent: Calculate the average number of balls a bowler bowls before taking a wicket, considering only overs where they have taken at least one wicket.
structure: Filter for deliveries where bowler_wickets > 0. Calculate the cumulative sum of bowler_bowls_done partitioned by bowler and ordered by overs. Then, calculate the difference between current and previous cumulative balls bowled for wicket-taking overs. Average these differences per bowler.
sql:
WITH wicket_overs AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    bowler_bowls_done,
    bowler_wickets,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS rn
  FROM df
  WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
),
balls_between_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    rn,
    bowler_bowls_done,
    CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wicket,
    bowler_bowls_done - LAG(bowler_bowls_done, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY rn) AS balls_since_last_delivery
  FROM wicket_overs
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  AVG(balls_since_last_delivery) AS avg_balls_per_wicket
FROM balls_between_wickets
WHERE is_wicket = 1
GROUP BY
  bowler
ORDER BY
  avg_balls_per_wicket ASC;

intent: Calculate the strike rate difference between a batsman's performance in death overs and non-death overs.
structure: Use CTEs to define death overs. Use conditional aggregation with CASE statements to calculate strike rates for death and non-death overs separately. Group by batsman. Use window functions.
sql:
WITH MaxOver AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_number
  FROM df
),
BatsmanStats AS (
  SELECT
    d.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (mo.max_over_number - 5) THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (mo.max_over_number - 5) THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls_faced,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (mo.max_over_number - 5) THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (mo.max_over_number - 5) THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_overs_balls_faced
  FROM df AS d
  CROSS JOIN MaxOver AS mo
  WHERE d.batsman_bowls_faced > 0
  GROUP BY d.batsman
  HAVING SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CAST(
    CASE
      WHEN death_overs_balls_faced > 0 THEN (death_overs_runs * 100.0 / death_overs_balls_faced)
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS REAL
  ) AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CAST(
    CASE
      WHEN non_death_overs_balls_faced > 0 THEN (non_death_overs_runs * 100.0 / non_death_overs_balls_faced)
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS REAL
  ) AS strike_rate_non_death_overs
FROM BatsmanStats
ORDER BY (
  CAST(
    CASE
      WHEN death_overs_balls_faced > 0 THEN (death_overs_runs * 100.0 / death_overs_balls_faced)
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS REAL
  ) -
  CAST(
    CASE
      WHEN non_death_overs_balls_faced > 0 THEN (non_death_overs_runs * 100.0 / non_death_overs_balls_faced)
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS REAL
  )
) DESC;

intent: Calculate the proportion of deliveries faced by each batsman that were hit for boundaries in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to define death overs. Filter for death overs. Use CASE to identify boundary hits. Calculate the ratio of boundary hits to total balls faced in death overs. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM death_overs) - 5 AND (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM death_overs) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_percentage_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM death_overs) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY boundary_percentage_death_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen during the initial phase of the innings (first 6 overs) versus the middle phase (overs 7-15).
structure: Group by batsman, calculate average runs per ball faced (strike rate) for two phases using CASE expressions on CEIL(overs), compare these two strike rates.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_6_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_middle_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Analyze the dot ball percentage for bowlers across different phases of the match: powerplay (1-6 overs), middle overs (7-15 overs), and death overs (16+ overs).
structure: Group by bowler, use CASE expressions with CEIL(overs) to define three phases, and calculate the percentage of dot balls (where batsman_runs = 0) in each phase. This utilizes conditional aggregation and CASE statements for bucketing.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percent_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0

  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percent_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
