intent: Analyze the strike rate difference between a batsman's performance in overs where they hit at least one boundary versus overs where they didn't.
structure: Use a CTE to flag overs with boundaries, then group by batsman and calculate strike rates for boundary overs and non-boundary overs using conditional aggregation. This involves a CTE and conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH OversWithBoundaries AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    ceil(overs) AS over_num,
    CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit_boundary_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman, ceil(overs)
)
SELECT
  df.batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
       THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
       ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_boundary_overs,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
       THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
       ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_non_boundary_overs
FROM df
JOIN OversWithBoundaries owb ON df.batsman = owb.batsman AND ceil(df.overs) = owb.over_num
GROUP BY df.batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN owb.hit_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Analyze bowler performance by calculating the percentage of dot balls and wickets per over for each phase of the innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to define phases and calculate aggregations (dot ball percentage, wickets per over) for each phase, grouped by bowler.
sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'early'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN 'middle'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) >= 16 THEN 'late'
        END AS phase,
        COUNT(*) AS total_balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) <= 6 OR (CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15) OR (CEIL(overs) >= 16)
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        phase
)
SELECT
    bs.bowler,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'early' THEN
        CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN (bs.dot_balls * 100.0) / bs.total_balls ELSE 0.0 END
        ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS dot_ball_percent_early,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'early' THEN
        CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN bs.wickets / (bs.total_balls / 6.0) ELSE 0.0 END
        ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS wickets_per_over_early,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'middle' THEN
        CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN (bs.dot_balls * 100.0) / bs.total_balls ELSE 0.0 END
        ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS dot_ball_percent_middle,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'middle' THEN
        CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN bs.wickets / (bs.total_balls / 6.0) ELSE 0.0 END
        ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS wickets_per_over_middle,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'late' THEN
        CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN (bs.dot_balls * 100.0) / bs.total_balls ELSE 0.0 END
        ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS dot_ball_percent_late,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'late' THEN
        CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN bs.wickets / (bs.total_balls / 6.0) ELSE 0.0 END
        ELSE NULL END), 0.0) AS wickets_per_over_late
FROM
    BowlerStats bs
GROUP BY
    bs.bowler
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'early' THEN bs.total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'middle' THEN bs.total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.phase = 'late' THEN bs.total_balls ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Identify the top 5 bowlers with the best wickets per over ratio in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to determine the start of death overs, then group by bowler to calculate wickets per over in the death overs, and order by this ratio in descending order with a limit.
sql:
WITH MatchStats AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_number
    FROM df
)
SELECT
    t1.bowler,
    CAST(SUM(t1.bowler_wickets) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t1.bowler_bowls_done) / 6.0, 0) AS wickets_per_over_death
FROM
    df AS t1,
    MatchStats AS ms
WHERE
    CEIL(t1.overs) > ms.max_over_number - 4

intent: Determine the highest number of consecutive dot balls faced by any batsman.
structure: Use a window function to calculate a running count of dot balls, and identify when this count resets to find the maximum consecutive sequence.
sql:
WITH dot_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
  FROM df
),
consecutive_dots AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    is_dot_ball,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_dot_ball = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS reset_point
  FROM dot_balls
),
consecutive_dot_count AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    COUNT(*) AS consecutive_count
  FROM consecutive_dots
  WHERE
    is_dot_ball = 1
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    reset_point
)
SELECT
  MAX(consecutive_count) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM consecutive_dot_count;

intent: Determine the average number of balls a batsman faces before hitting their first boundary (4 or 6).
structure: Use a CTE to identify the first delivery where a batsman hits a boundary. Then, join back to the main table to count balls faced by that batsman before that specific delivery. Finally, group by batsman and average the count.
sql:
WITH InningsNumbered AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) AS is_boundary,
        -- Generate an innings identifier for each batsman.
        -- A new innings is detected if the current 'overs' value is less than the previous 'overs' value for the same batsman,
        -- indicating a reset of the ball count within an innings. The first segment of balls for a batsman is their first innings.
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN LAG(overs, 1, 0.0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) > overs THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS batsman_innings_group
    FROM df
),
InningsDetails AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        is_boundary,
        (batsman_innings_group + 1) AS innings_id -- Make innings IDs 1-indexed
    FROM InningsNumbered
),
FirstBoundaryBallPerInnings AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        innings_id,
        MIN(overs) AS first_boundary_overs -- Get the 'overs' value of the first boundary hit in each innings
    FROM InningsDetails
    WHERE
        is_boundary = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        innings_id
),
BallsBeforeFirstBoundary AS (
    SELECT
        id.batsman,
        id.innings_id,
        SUM(id.batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_before_boundary -- Sum balls faced strictly *before* the first boundary
    FROM InningsDetails id
    JOIN FirstBoundaryBallPerInnings fb ON
        id.batsman = fb.batsman AND
        id.innings_id = fb.innings_id AND
        id.overs < fb.first_boundary_overs -- Filter for balls strictly preceding the first boundary ball
    GROUP BY
        id.batsman,
        id.innings_id
)
SELECT
    bb.batsman,
    AVG(bb.balls_before_boundary * 1.0) AS avg_balls_to_first_boundary
FROM BallsBeforeFirstBoundary bb
GROUP BY
    bb.batsman
ORDER BY
    bb.batsman;

intent: Calculate the dot ball percentage for each bowler in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to find the total overs. Filter for deliveries in the last 5 overs. Count dot balls (batsman_runs = 0) and total balls bowled by each bowler in this phase. Calculate percentage.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(ceil(overs)) AS total_overs FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS dot_ball_percentage_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE
  ceil(overs) > (SELECT total_overs FROM death_overs) - 5
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY
  dot_ball_percentage_death_overs DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in the first over versus the last over of the innings.
structure: Filter deliveries for the first over (CEIL(overs) = 1) and the last over (CEIL(overs) = MAX(CEIL(overs))). Calculate strike rate (batsman_runs / batsman_bowls_faced * 100) for each of these phases. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH max_over AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS final_over_number FROM df
),
first_over_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_first_over,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_first_over
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) = 1
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
),
last_over_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs_last_over,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_last_over
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) = (SELECT final_over_number FROM max_over)
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
)
SELECT
    fos.batsman,
    CAST(fos.total_runs_first_over AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(fos.total_balls_first_over, 0) AS strike_rate_first_over,
    CAST(los.total_runs_last_over AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(los.total_balls_last_over, 0) AS strike_rate_last_over
FROM
    first_over_stats fos
JOIN
    last_over_stats los ON fos.batsman = los.batsman;

intent: Identify batsmen who show a tendency to score boundaries immediately after playing a dot ball, analyzing this trend in the first 10 overs vs. the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CTE with a LAG window function to check if the previous ball was a dot ball for a specific batsman. Then, group by batsman and the over phase (first 10 vs. rest) to calculate the proportion of boundaries hit after a dot ball.
sql:
WITH ball_events AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        LAG(batsman_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_runs
    FROM
        df
),
batsman_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        -- For the filter condition: "played more than 5 dot balls (previous ball runs was 0)"
        -- Interpreted as: faced more than 5 balls where the previous ball was a dot ball (prev_batsman_runs = 0).
        SUM(CASE WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls_faced_after_any_dot,

        -- Boundaries scored on balls immediately following a dot ball in the first 10 overs
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes)
                ELSE 0
            END) AS boundaries_after_dot_first_10_overs,
        -- Total balls faced immediately after a dot ball in the first 10 overs (denominator for rate)
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS balls_faced_after_dot_first_10_overs,

        -- Boundaries scored on balls immediately following a dot ball in the rest of the match
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes)
                ELSE 0
            END) AS boundaries_after_dot_rest_of_match,
        -- Total balls faced immediately after a dot ball in the rest of the match (denominator for rate)
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS balls_faced_after_dot_rest_of_match
    FROM
        ball_events
    GROUP BY
        batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(boundaries_after_dot_first_10_overs * 1.0 / NULLIF(balls_faced_after_dot_first_10_overs, 0) AS REAL) AS boundary_rate_after_dot_first_10_overs,
    CAST(boundaries_after_dot_rest_of_match * 1.0 / NULLIF(balls_faced_after_dot_rest_of_match, 0) AS REAL) AS boundary_rate_after_dot_rest_of_match
FROM
    batsman_stats
WHERE
    total_balls_faced_after_any_dot > 5
ORDER BY
    boundary_rate_after_dot_first_10_overs DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rates of batsmen in the powerplay (first 6 overs) versus the rest of the match.
structure: Use conditional aggregation with CASE statements to calculate strike rates separately for powerplay overs and non-powerplay overs for each batsman. The output will have one row per batsman with two columns for strike rates. The grain is per batsman.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of a batsman in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Group by batsman, calculate strike rate using CASE for death overs and rest of match. Uses CASE expressions.
sql:
WITH MatchOverInfo AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_in_match
    FROM df
),
BatsmanPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        -- Death Overs (last 5 overs)
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over_in_match FROM MatchOverInfo) - 5
            THEN d.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END) AS death_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over_in_match FROM MatchOverInfo) - 5
            THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced
            ELSE 0
        END) AS death_overs_bowls_faced,
        -- Rest of Match
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT max_over_in_match FROM MatchOverInfo) - 5
            THEN d.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END) AS rest_of_match_runs,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT max_over_in_match FROM MatchOverInfo) - 5
            THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced
            ELSE 0
        END) AS rest_of_match_bowls_faced
    FROM
        df AS d
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman
)
SELECT
    b.batsman,
    -- Strike rate for death overs
    CASE
        WHEN b.death_overs_bowls_faced > 0
        THEN (CAST(b.death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0) / b.death_overs_bowls_faced
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
    -- Strike rate for rest of match
    CASE
        WHEN b.rest_of_match_bowls_faced > 0
        THEN (CAST(b.rest_of_match_runs AS REAL) * 100.0) / b.rest_of_match_bowls_faced
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM
    BatsmanPhaseStats AS b;

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls faced by any batsman in the match.
structure: Uses a CTE to identify dot balls, another CTE to calculate cumulative sums for resetting consecutive counts, and then aggregates to find the maximum consecutive count. Uses CTEs.
sql: WITH dot_balls AS ( SELECT batsman, overs, CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball FROM df ), consecutive_dots AS ( SELECT batsman, overs, is_dot_ball, SUM(CASE WHEN is_dot_ball = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS reset_point FROM dot_balls ), consecutive_dot_count AS ( SELECT batsman, reset_point, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_count FROM consecutive_dots WHERE is_dot_ball = 1 GROUP BY batsman, reset_point ) SELECT MAX(consecutive_count) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls FROM consecutive_dot_count;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate (runs per ball faced) of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Calculate the strike rate (runs/balls_faced) for each batsman, separately for the death overs and non-death overs. Use CASE statements to define the death overs phase based on CEIL(overs). Aggregate by batsman. Use subqueries or CTEs for defining phases.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 'Death Overs'
      ELSE 'Non-Death Overs'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_non_death,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death
FROM OverPhases
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_death DESC;
description: Calculates the strike rate of each batsman in non-death overs (all overs except the last 5) and death overs (last 5 overs). It helps understand if batsmen accelerate or decelerate their scoring in the crucial final overs. A CTE is used to define the over phases.

intent: Determine the strike rate of batsmen during the first 10 overs versus the rest of the match, identifying early aggression or caution.
structure: Use CASE statements to categorize deliveries into 'First 10 Overs' and 'Rest of Match' based on CEIL(overs). Calculate the strike rate (runs/balls_faced) for each batsman in these two categories. Aggregate by batsman. Handle division by zero.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_10_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_first_10_overs DESC;

structure: Filter deliveries to include only those in the death overs (last 5 overs) using a CASE statement on CEIL(overs). sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_ball_percentage_death_overs

WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

intent: Analyze the correlation between dot balls and subsequent wicket-taking for a specific bowler. This seeks to understand if a bowler's pressure build-up through dot balls often leads to wickets.
structure: Use a CTE to lag the 'bowler_wickets' by one ball and label dot balls. Then, calculate the ratio of wicket balls that followed a dot ball to total dot balls for a specific bowler.
sql:
WITH BallData AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    bowler_wickets,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS prev_ball_runs
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ball_runs = 0 AND bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ball_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wicket_concession_rate_after_dot_ball
FROM BallData
WHERE bowler = 'Azmatullah'
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ball_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Identify bowlers whose bowling average (runs conceded per wicket) significantly increases during the death overs (last 5 overs). This can indicate bowlers who become less effective under pressure at the end of an innings.
structure: Calculate the bowling average for two phases: death overs and non-death overs. This involves calculating runs conceded divided by wickets taken for each phase. Group by bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 1 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS bowling_avg_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 1 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS bowling_avg_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
  OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Analyze the strike rate difference between a batsman's first 5 overs faced and their subsequent overs. This aims to see if batsmen typically start slower and accelerate, or vice-versa.
structure: Calculate strike rate for two phases: first 5 overs and rest of the match for each batsman. Use CASE expressions for phase bucketing and ratio calculation. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH batsman_cumulative_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS cumulative_balls_faced
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    b.batsman,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.cumulative_balls_faced <= 30 THEN b.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN b.cumulative_balls_faced <= 30 THEN b.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_first_5_overs,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.cumulative_balls_faced > 30 THEN b.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN b.cumulative_balls_faced > 30 THEN b.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_after_first_5_overs
FROM
    batsman_cumulative_stats AS b
GROUP BY
    b.batsman
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.cumulative_balls_faced <= 30 THEN b.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.cumulative_balls_faced > 30 THEN b.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

structure: Grouping by bowler, using CASE expressions to differentiate between first 6 overs and rest, calculating dot ball percentage using aggregated counts.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percentage_first_6,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percentage_rest
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0

intent: Track the cumulative number of boundaries (fours and sixes) hit by a specific batsman throughout the match.
structure: Using a window function to calculate cumulative sum, ordered by `overs` for sequence.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  overs,
  batsman_fours,
  batsman_sixes,
  batsman_fours + batsman_sixes AS boundaries_on_ball,
  SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_boundaries
FROM df

intent: Calculate the average runs conceded per wicket taken by each bowler across different phases of the innings (powerplay, middle, death).
structure: Grouping by bowler, using CASE expressions to define phases based on `CEIL(overs)`, and calculating average runs per wicket.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_middle_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_death_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) >= 1 AND ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Calculate the average number of boundaries (fours and sixes) per over for each bowler across all their overs.
structure: CTE to calculate boundaries per over per bowler, then aggregation over the CTE using COUNT and SUM, handling division by zero.
sql:
WITH overboundaries AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fours_in_over,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(over_number) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(fours_in_over + sixes_in_over) AS REAL) / COUNT(over_number)
    ELSE 0
  END AS avg_boundaries_per_over
FROM overboundaries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(over_number) > 0
ORDER BY avg_boundaries_per_over ASC;

structure: Conditional aggregation for dot balls and total balls using CASE and CEIL(overs) for phases, ratio calculation, filtering based on deliveries faced in the phase, using a subquery to find the maximum over.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 AND batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percentage_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY dot_ball_percentage_death_overs DESC;

structure: GROUP BY batsman, conditional aggregation using CASE and CEIL(overs) for phase, ratio calculation, filtering by phase and ratio, handling division by zero.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_run_percentage_first_6_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND (
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END)
) > 20 /* Example Threshold: Filter for batsmen whose boundary runs constitute more than 20% of their runs in the first 6 overs */
ORDER BY boundary_run_percentage_first_6_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the trend of batsman runs scored per ball faced across different phases of the innings (first 6 overs, overs 7-15, overs 16-20).
structure: Group by batsman. Use multiple CASE expressions with CEIL(overs) to define three distinct phases. Calculate runs per ball faced (strike rate) for each phase, handling division by zero.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_6_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_overs_7_15,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_overs_16_20
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
  OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
  OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_first_6_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the change in runs scored per over from one over to the next throughout the innings.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs scored in each over (using CEIL(overs)). Use the LAG window function to get the runs scored in the previous over. Calculate the difference between current and previous over's runs.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
  SELECT
    ceil(overs) AS over_num,
    SUM(team_runs) AS runs_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY ceil(overs)
)
SELECT
  over_num,
  runs_in_over,
  LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY over_num) AS previous_over_runs,
  runs_in_over - LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY over_num) AS runs_difference
FROM over_runs
ORDER BY over_num;

intent: Analyze the impact of dot balls on bowler economy rate in the opening powerplay (first 6 overs) versus the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use CASE expressions to identify dot balls and define the two phases (first 6 overs and last 5 overs). Group by bowler. Calculate economy rate (runs per over) for each phase, considering only dot balls bowled.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(ceil(overs)) AS max_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rate_first_6_overs_dot_balls,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM death_overs) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM death_overs) - 5 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM death_overs) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rate_death_overs_dot_balls
FROM df
WHERE
  (ceil(overs) <= 6 AND batsman_runs = 0) OR (ceil(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM death_overs) - 5 AND batsman_runs = 0)
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM death_overs) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  economy_rate_death_overs_dot_balls ASC;

sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
  SELECT CEIL(overs) AS over_num, SUM(team_runs) AS runs_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY CEIL(overs)
)

  over_num,
  runs_in_over,

  runs_in_over - LAG(runs_in_over, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY over_num) AS runs_change

intent: Analyze the trend of batsman strike rates across different phases of an innings (powerplay, middle, death).
structure: Use a CTE to categorize deliveries into phases based on CEIL(overs). Group by batsman and phase, calculating strike rate (runs/balls * 100) for each group. Pivot the results for each batsman to have columns for each phase's strike rate.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM
    df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN CAST(batsman_runs AS REAL) * 100 / batsman_bowls_faced ELSE NULL END) AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN CAST(batsman_runs AS REAL) * 100 / batsman_bowls_faced ELSE NULL END) AS strike_rate_middle_overs,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN CAST(batsman_runs AS REAL) * 100 / batsman_bowls_faced ELSE NULL END) AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM
  OverPhases
WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
GROUP BY
  batsman;

WITH max_over AS (

WITH prev_ball_info AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    bowler_wickets,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_runs
  FROM df

  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0

FROM prev_ball_info
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN prev_batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

WITH MatchStats AS (

    FROM df
)

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(t.overs) <= ms.max_ceil_overs - 5 THEN t.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(t.overs) <= ms.max_ceil_overs - 5 THEN t.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM

intent: Analyze the wicket-taking efficiency of bowlers in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to define death overs, then calculate wickets per ball for bowlers in that phase. Group by bowler and filter for bowlers with significant bowling in death overs.
sql:
WITH death_overs_start AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(bowler_wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bowler_bowls_done), 0) AS wickets_per_ball_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) >= (SELECT start_over FROM death_overs_start)
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(bowler_bowls_done) >= 10
ORDER BY wickets_per_ball_death_overs DESC;

intent: Calculate the average runs conceded per over by each bowler in the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to define death overs, then calculate the average runs given by bowlers per over within that phase. Group by bowler and filter for bowlers with a minimum number of overs bowled in death overs.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT CEIL(overs)) AS avg_runs_conceded_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) >= (SELECT start_over FROM death_overs)
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CEIL(overs)) >= 1
ORDER BY avg_runs_conceded_death_overs ASC;

intent: Find the batsman with the highest dot ball percentage in the first over of the match.
structure: Filter for the first over (CEIL(overs) = 1), count dot balls faced, count total balls faced, and calculate the percentage. Group by batsman and order by the dot ball percentage.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS dot_ball_percentage_first_over
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY dot_ball_percentage_first_over DESC

intent: Calculate the boundary percentage for batsmen in the middle overs (overs 7-15).
structure: Filter data for overs 7-15, calculate the ratio of boundary shots to total runs scored by the batsman in this phase. Group by batsman and filter for batsmen with a significant number of runs scored.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_runs) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_percentage_middle_overs
FROM df
WHERE CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) > 10
ORDER BY boundary_percentage_middle_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze bowler economy rate variation across different phases of the match (Powerplay, Middle Overs, Death Overs).
structure: Use CASE expressions to define three phases based on CEIL(overs). Calculate the average runs given by each bowler per over for each phase. Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH max_over_cte AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  d.bowler,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS economy_rate_powerplay,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= 15 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= 15 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS economy_rate_middle_overs,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM max_over_cte) - 5 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM max_over_cte) - 5 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS economy_rate_death_overs
FROM
  df AS d
GROUP BY
  d.bowler
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= 15 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM max_over_cte) - 5 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  d.bowler;

sql:
SELECT

intent: Calculate the strike rate of each batsman in death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CTE to determine the start of the death overs. Group by batsman. Use conditional aggregation with CASE statements to calculate strike rates for death overs and the rest of the match. Filter for batsmen who have faced a minimum number of balls.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) >= start_over THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) >= start_over THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) >= start_over THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) < start_over THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) < start_over THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) < start_over THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM df, death_overs
GROUP BY batsman, start_over
HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 10
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Find the top N bowlers with the best wickets per ball ratio in the death overs.
structure: Use a CTE to determine the start of the death overs. Filter the data for deliveries within the death overs. Group by bowler and calculate the wickets per ball ratio. Order by this ratio in descending order and limit the results.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(bowler_wickets) AS REAL) / COUNT(bowler_bowls_done) AS wickets_per_ball_death_overs
FROM df, death_overs
WHERE CEIL(overs) >= start_over
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY wickets_per_ball_death_overs DESC
LIMIT 5;

intent: Calculate the economy rate of bowlers specifically in overs where they conceded at least one wicket.
structure: Group by bowler. Use a CASE expression to identify overs where the bowler took at least one wicket. Calculate the total runs conceded and the number of balls bowled within those specific overs. Compute the economy rate (runs per over).
sql:
WITH WicketTakingOvers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_num
  FROM df
  WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
)
SELECT
  d.bowler,
  SUM(d.bowler_runs_given) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done), 0) AS economy_rate_wicket_overs
FROM df AS d
JOIN WicketTakingOvers AS wto
  ON d.bowler = wto.bowler AND CEIL(d.overs) = wto.over_num
GROUP BY
  d.bowler
ORDER BY
  economy_rate_wicket_overs ASC;

intent: Analyze the momentum of batsmen by calculating their strike rate in the first and last 5 overs of their innings.
structure: Calculate strike rate for two phases (first 5 overs and last 5 overs) using CASE statements, grouping by batsman. Use subqueries to determine the maximum over number.
sql:
WITH OverRange AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) as max_over FROM df
)
SELECT 
    batsman,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS strike_rate_first_5_overs,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM OverRange) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM OverRange) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM OverRange) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS strike_rate_last_5_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM OverRange) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Determine the average number of wickets taken by a bowler per over in the death overs (last 5 overs) versus the rest of the match.
structure: Calculate average wickets per over for each bowler. Compare death overs vs. non-death overs. Uses CASE expression for over bucketing and aggregation.
sql:
WITH MaxOverCTE AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num
    FROM df
),
BowlerPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > m.max_over_num - 5 THEN d.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS death_wickets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > m.max_over_num - 5 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS death_balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= m.max_over_num - 5 THEN d.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS rest_wickets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= m.max_over_num - 5 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS rest_balls,
        SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done) AS total_bowls_done
    FROM df AS d
    CROSS JOIN MaxOverCTE AS m
    GROUP BY d.bowler
    HAVING SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done) > 0
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE
        WHEN death_balls = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE CAST(death_wickets AS REAL) / (CAST(death_balls AS REAL) / 6.0)
    END AS wickets_per_over_death,
    CASE
        WHEN rest_balls = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE CAST(rest_wickets AS REAL) / (CAST(rest_balls AS REAL) / 6.0)
    END AS wickets_per_over_rest
FROM BowlerPhaseStats
ORDER BY wickets_per_over_death DESC;

sql: SELECT bowler, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6.0 / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS REAL), 0) AS economy_rate_powerplay, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6.0 / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS REAL), 0) AS economy_rate_rest FROM df GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0 ORDER BY economy_rate_powerplay ASC
description: Compares the economy rate of bowlers during the powerplay overs (first 6) versus the remainder of the match. This identifies bowlers who are effective at restricting runs in the initial phase.
question: For each bowler, calculate their economy rate during the powerplay overs (first 6 overs) and their economy rate for the rest of the match. Display results ordered by economy rate during the powerplay in ascending order. Only consider bowlers who bowled at least one ball.
paraphrases: What is the economy rate for each bowler in the powerplay (first 6 overs) compared to the rest of the match, sorted by powerplay economy rate (lowest first)?
Show the economy rate of bowlers during the powerplay overs and the remainder of the match, ordered by their powerplay economy rate.
Compare the economy rates of all bowlers in the first 6 overs versus the rest of the match, presenting the lowest powerplay economy rates first.

intent: Calculate the proportion of deliveries that result in a wicket for each bowler across the entire match.

sql: SELECT bowler, CAST(sum(bowler_wickets) AS REAL) / count(bowler_bowls_done) AS wicket_proportion FROM df GROUP BY bowler HAVING count(bowler_bowls_done) > 0 ORDER BY wicket_proportion DESC;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Grouping by batsman, calculate the strike rate (runs/balls faced) for death overs and non-death overs separately using CASE expressions. This results in a wide format for binary comparison.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM
  df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0 OR sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0;

The strike rate is calculated as (total runs scored / total balls faced) * 100. Only include batsmen who faced at least one ball in either of these periods.

intent: Identify bowlers who are most economical when bowling in the 'middle overs' phase (overs 7-15).
structure: Group by bowler and calculate the economy rate (runs conceded per ball bowled) specifically for deliveries within the middle overs, using a CASE expression for filtering by over range. Requires a CTE to define the over ranges.
sql:
WITH MiddleOvers AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_runs_given,
    bowler_bowls_done,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_middle_over
  FROM
    df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(is_middle_over * bowler_bowls_done) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(is_middle_over * bowler_runs_given) AS REAL) / sum(is_middle_over * bowler_bowls_done)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS economy_rate_middle_overs
FROM
  MiddleOvers
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  sum(is_middle_over * bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY
  economy_rate_middle_overs ASC;
description: Calculates the economy rate for each bowler specifically during the middle overs (7th to 15th over). This helps identify bowlers who are effective at containing runs during this phase of the game.

Calculate the economy rate of bowlers specifically during the middle overs (overs 7 to 15). The calculation is (runs conceded / balls bowled). Include only those bowlers who bowled at least one ball in overs 7-15.

intent: Determine the frequency of boundary shots (fours and sixes) for each batsman after facing a certain number of deliveries.
structure: Group by batsman. Use a CASE expression to count boundaries (fours + sixes) only for deliveries faced by the batsman. Then, calculate the ratio of boundaries to balls faced within specific delivery count brackets (e.g., first 20 balls, next 30, etc.) using another CASE expression. This demonstrates different grouping/aggregation combinations.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced <= 20) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced <= 20) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced <= 20)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_freq_first_20_balls,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 20 AND batsman_bowls_faced <= 50) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 20 AND batsman_bowls_faced <= 50) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 20 AND batsman_bowls_faced <= 50)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_freq_21_to_50_balls,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 50) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 50) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 50)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_freq_after_50_balls
FROM
  df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0;

intent: Assess bowler performance by calculating the proportion of wickets taken relative to the runs conceded, distinguishing between early and late game phases.
structure: Uses a CTE to define game phases (early: first 10 overs, late: after 10 overs) based on CEIL(overs). Then, groups by bowler to calculate wickets per run conceded ratio for each phase using CASE expressions and conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_wickets,
    bowler_runs_given,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 10 THEN 'Early' WHEN ceil(overs) > 10 THEN 'Late' ELSE 'Other' END AS phase
  FROM
    df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS wicket_to_run_ratio_early,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS wicket_to_run_ratio_late
FROM
  OverPhases
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  bowler;

intent: Track batsman momentum by observing the average runs scored on balls immediately following a boundary.
structure: Uses a window function (LAG) to get the runs scored on the previous ball for each batsman, ordered by 'overs'. Then, filters for balls where the previous ball was a boundary (batsman_runs > 0 and was a 4 or 6, or checking batsman_runs for specific values indicating boundaries), and calculates the average runs scored on the subsequent balls. This involves analysis of ball sequence.
sql:
WITH BallData AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as prev_ball_runs,
    LAG(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as prev_ball_was_boundary
  FROM
    df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN prev_ball_was_boundary > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN prev_ball_was_boundary > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM
  BallData
WHERE
  prev_ball_was_boundary > 0
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN prev_ball_was_boundary > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

This is calculated as the sum of runs scored on such deliveries divided by the count of such deliveries. Only include batsmen for whom there was at least one delivery following a boundary.

Calculate the average runs per ball for deliveries that immediately succeed a boundary hit by the batsman. The average is (runs scored / number of balls after a boundary). Consider only batsmen who have had at least one ball after a boundary.

intent: Examine the correlation between a bowler's wicket-taking ability and the number of boundaries they concede across different phases of the game.
structure: Divides the match into three phases: Powerplay (1-6 overs), Middle (7-15 overs), and Death (16+ overs) using CASE statements. Then, groups by bowler and calculates the ratio of boundaries conceded to wickets taken within each phase. This involves CASE-based bucketing.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN df.batsman_fours + df.batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundaries_per_wicket_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN df.batsman_fours + df.batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundaries_per_wicket_middle,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN df.batsman_fours + df.batsman_sixes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundaries_per_wicket_death
FROM
  df
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
  OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
  OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 15 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  bowler;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen against a specific bowler.
structure: Filter the data for a specific bowler using a WHERE clause with a placeholder. Then, group by batsman and calculate their strike rate (runs scored / balls faced) against that bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_against_bowler
FROM
  df
WHERE
  bowler = 'Azmatullah'
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_against_bowler DESC;

intent: Analyze the change in batsman's strike rate from the first half to the second half of the innings (based on overs).
structure: Uses a CASE expression to define two halves of the innings (e.g., first 10 overs and remaining overs). Groups by batsman and calculates the strike rate for each half using conditional aggregation. This demonstrates different grouping/aggregation combinations and uses CASE for bucketing.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= 10) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= 10) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE ceil(overs) <= 10)

intent: Analyze the trend of runs scored per over throughout the match for each team.
structure: Groups by CEIL(overs) to get over-level data. Calculates the sum of team runs for each over. Then, uses a window function to compute the cumulative sum of runs per over. This demonstrates use of window function and correct over-level aggregation.
sql:
SELECT
  CAST(ceil(overs) AS INTEGER) AS over_number,
  SUM(team_runs) AS runs_in_this_over,
  SUM(SUM(team_runs)) OVER (ORDER BY ceil(overs))
    AS cumulative_runs
FROM
  df
GROUP BY
  ceil(overs)
ORDER BY
  over_number;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of a specific batsman throughout the death overs (last 5 overs) of an innings, and compare it to their strike rate in non-death overs.
structure: Calculate strike rate (batsman_runs * 100 / batsman_bowls_faced) for two phases (death overs and rest of innings) by grouping by batsman. Uses a CTE to determine the start of death overs and CASE expressions for phase splitting. Includes a HAVING clause to filter batsmen with significant contributions in both phases.
sql: WITH MaxOver AS ( SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_completed_over_number FROM df ), DeathOversStart AS ( SELECT max_completed_over_number - 3 AS start_over FROM MaxOver ) SELECT d.batsman, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) >= dos.start_over THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) >= dos.start_over THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_death_overs, SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) < dos.start_over THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) < dos.start_over THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_non_death_overs FROM df AS d CROSS JOIN DeathOversStart AS dos GROUP BY d.batsman HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) >= dos.start_over THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) < dos.start_over THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY d.batsman;
description: Calculates the strike rate for batsmen in death overs vs. non-death overs, filtering for those who faced balls in both phases.

intent: Analyze the contribution of sixes to a batsman's total runs scored in the death overs (last 4 overs).
structure: Filter for death overs. Group by batsman. Calculate the sum of sixes and the sum of total runs. Compute the percentage of total runs that came from sixes. Filter for batsmen who scored a minimum number of runs in death overs.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_sixes * 6) AS REAL) * 100.0 / sum(batsman_runs)
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS percentage_runs_from_sixes_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE
  ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 4
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  sum(batsman_runs) > 10
ORDER BY
  percentage_runs_from_sixes_death_overs DESC;

intent: Determine the average number of wickets taken by a bowler per over during the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CASE statement to categorize overs into 'death overs' and 'rest of match'. Group by bowler and calculate the average wickets per over for each category.
sql:
WITH MatchInfo AS (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_ceil_overs FROM df),
BowlerStats AS (
  SELECT
    d.bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > mi.max_ceil_overs - 5 THEN d.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS death_over_wickets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > mi.max_ceil_overs - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS death_over_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (CEIL(d.overs) > mi.max_ceil_overs - 5) THEN d.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS rest_of_match_wickets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (CEIL(d.overs) > mi.max_ceil_overs - 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rest_of_match_balls
  FROM df AS d, MatchInfo AS mi
  GROUP BY d.bowler
)
SELECT
  b.bowler,
  CAST(b.death_over_wickets AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.death_over_balls / 6.0, 0) AS wickets_per_over_death_overs,
  CAST(b.rest_of_match_wickets AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.rest_of_match_balls / 6.0, 0) AS wickets_per_over_rest_of_match
FROM BowlerStats AS b
WHERE (b.death_over_balls + b.rest_of_match_balls) > 10

intent: Analyze bowler performance by comparing their economy rate in overs where they took wickets versus overs where they did not.
structure: Use a CASE statement to distinguish between wicket-taking overs and non-wicket-taking overs. Group by bowler and calculate the economy rate for each category.
sql:
WITH BowlerOverWickets AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        MAX(bowler_wickets) AS had_wicket_in_over
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    d.bowler,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bow.had_wicket_in_over > 0 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN bow.had_wicket_in_over > 0 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0) AS economy_rate_wicket_overs,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bow.had_wicket_in_over = 0 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN bow.had_wicket_in_over = 0 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0) AS economy_rate_non_wicket_overs
FROM
    df AS d
JOIN
    BowlerOverWickets AS bow
    ON d.bowler = bow.bowler AND CEIL(d.overs) = bow.over_number
GROUP BY
    d.bowler
HAVING
    SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done) > 10
ORDER BY
    economy_rate_wicket_overs ASC;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate of batsmen after they have faced a certain number of balls, specifically looking at their strike rate in the first 10 balls faced versus subsequent balls.
structure: Group by batsman, calculate strike rate using conditional aggregation on CEIL(overs) to define phases (first 10 balls vs. rest of innings), and use SUM for runs and balls faced. Use CASE expressions for conditional aggregation.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_first_10_overs,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_post_10_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Examine the strike rate of batsmen during death overs versus non-death overs.
structure: Use a CTE to determine the start of death overs (last few overs). Then, group by batsman and use CASE statements within SUM aggregations to calculate strike rate for death overs and non-death overs separately. Use CAST for division.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  df.batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_non_death_overs
FROM df
CROSS JOIN death_overs
GROUP BY df.batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY df.batsman;

intent: Calculate the average runs scored per ball after a batsman has hit a boundary (four or six).
structure: Use a CTE to create lagged columns for the previous ball's boundary status and runs. Calculate the average of current ball runs for balls that followed a boundary. Use window functions (`lag`) and CASE expressions for conditional aggregation. Use HAVING to filter batsmen with at least one boundary.
sql:
WITH balldata AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    LAG(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_ball_was_boundary
  FROM df
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ball_was_boundary > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ball_was_boundary > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM balldata
WHERE prev_ball_was_boundary > 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ball_was_boundary > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Track the cumulative runs scored over the overs in an innings.
structure: Group by CEIL(overs) to get over-level aggregates. Calculate the sum of team runs for each over. Use a window function SUM() OVER (ORDER BY CEIL(overs)) to compute cumulative runs. Cast CEIL(overs) to integer for cleaner output.
sql:
SELECT
  CAST(CEIL(overs) AS INTEGER) AS over_number,
  SUM(team_runs) AS runs_in_this_over,
  SUM(SUM(team_runs)) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(CEIL(overs) AS INTEGER))
    AS cumulative_runs
FROM df
GROUP BY CEIL(overs)
ORDER BY over_number;

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen during the death overs (last 5 overs) versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Use a CTE to define the start of the death overs. Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to conditionally aggregate `batsman_runs` and `batsman_bowls_faced` for death overs and non-death overs. Calculate strike rate as (total runs * 100) / total balls faced for each period. Filter batsmen who faced a minimum number of balls in each period.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  df.batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_non_death_overs
FROM df
CROSS JOIN death_overs
GROUP BY df.batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5
ORDER BY df.batsman;

intent: Analyze the bowling effectiveness of bowlers in the death overs (last 5 overs) by calculating balls per wicket.
structure: Use a CTE to determine the start of the death overs. Join the CTE with the main table. Group by bowler. Use CASE statements to conditionally sum `bowler_bowls_done` and `bowler_wickets` for death overs and non-death overs. Calculate balls per wicket. Filter bowlers who took wickets in at least one phase.
sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 4 AS start_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  df.bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS balls_per_wicket_death,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS balls_per_wicket_rest
FROM df
CROSS JOIN death_overs
GROUP BY df.bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) >= death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(df.overs) < death_overs.start_over THEN df.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0

intent: Analyze the change in batsman strike rate from the first 6 overs to the next 10 overs.
structure: Use CASE expression to define two phases (first 6 overs, next 10 overs). Calculate strike rate (SUM(batsman_runs) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced)) for each phase. Group by batsman and phase. Use window functions for cumulative strike rate.
sql:
WITH batsman_phase_sr AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE
      WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 'First 6 Overs'
      WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 16 THEN 'Overs 7-16'
      ELSE 'Rest of Innings'
    END AS phase,
    CASE WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman, phase
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 6 Overs' THEN strike_rate ELSE 0 END) AS sr_first_6,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Overs 7-16' THEN strike_rate ELSE 0 END) AS sr_7_to_16,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN strike_rate ELSE 0 END) AS sr_rest
FROM batsman_phase_sr
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING sr_first_6 > 0 OR sr_7_to_16 > 0 OR sr_rest > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Investigate the strike rate of batsmen after a bowler has conceded a high number of runs in their spell.
structure: Combines a CTE for cumulative bowler runs with the main table, filters for high-concession spells, and then calculates batsman strike rate.
sql:
WITH bowler_spell_runs AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS cumulative_runs_in_spell
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  d.batsman,
  CAST(SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS strike_rate_after_high_bowler_concession
FROM df AS d
JOIN bowler_spell_runs AS bsr ON d.bowler = bsr.bowler AND d.overs = bsr.overs
WHERE bsr.cumulative_runs_in_spell > 10
GROUP BY d.batsman
HAVING SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) > 5
ORDER BY strike_rate_after_high_bowler_concession DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen during death overs (last 5 overs) versus the rest of the match, focusing on those who have faced a significant number of balls in both phases.
structure: Grouping by batsman, calculating strike rate (sum(batsman_runs) / sum(batsman_bowls_faced)) using CASE expressions to define 'death overs' (last 5 overs) and 'rest of match' phases, conditional aggregation for runs and balls faced in each phase, and filtering batsmen with significant balls faced in both phases. Ordering by batsman.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5

intent: Determine the average number of runs conceded by a bowler per over, specifically looking at their performance in overs where they took at least one wicket versus overs where they did not.
structure: Grouping by bowler, using CASE expressions to differentiate between wicket-taking overs and non-wicket-taking overs (based on bowler_wickets > 0), and then calculating the average runs given per over for each category. Filtering for bowlers who have bowled a minimum number of overs in each category.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_this_over,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_taken_this_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    os.bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.wickets_taken_this_over > 0 THEN os.runs_conceded_this_over ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
        NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN os.wickets_taken_this_over > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS avg_runs_per_over_wicket_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.wickets_taken_this_over = 0 THEN os.runs_conceded_this_over ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
        NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN os.wickets_taken_this_over = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS avg_runs_per_over_non_wicket_overs
FROM OverStats os
GROUP BY os.bowler
HAVING (COUNT(CASE WHEN os.wickets_taken_this_over > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) > 5
        OR COUNT(CASE WHEN os.wickets_taken_this_over = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) > 5)
ORDER BY os.bowler;

intent: Examine the relationship between a bowler's economy rate and their wicket-taking ability, comparing overs where they took wickets versus those where they did not.
structure: Grouping by bowler, using CASE expressions to separate wicket-taking overs (bowler_wickets > 0) from non-wicket-taking overs (bowler_wickets = 0). Calculating the economy rate (total runs given / total balls bowled) for each category. Filtering for bowlers with sufficient bowling data in both categories.
sql:
WITH over_summary AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CAST(CEIL(overs) AS INT) AS over_number, -- Corrected from FLOOR to CEIL
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_in_over,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_taken_in_over,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS balls_bowled_in_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY bowler, CAST(CEIL(overs) AS INT)
),
bowler_category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_taken_in_over > 0 THEN runs_conceded_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS runs_wicket_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_taken_in_over > 0 THEN balls_bowled_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS balls_wicket_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_taken_in_over = 0 THEN runs_conceded_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS runs_non_wicket_overs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wickets_taken_in_over = 0 THEN balls_bowled_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS balls_non_wicket_overs
    FROM over_summary
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
    bcs.bowler,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN bcs.balls_wicket_overs = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE bcs.runs_wicket_overs * 1.0 / (bcs.balls_wicket_overs / 6.0)
        END AS REAL
    ) AS economy_rate_wicket_overs,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN bcs.balls_non_wicket_overs = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE bcs.runs_non_wicket_overs * 1.0 / (bcs.balls_non_wicket_overs / 6.0)
        END AS REAL
    ) AS economy_rate_non_wicket_overs
FROM bowler_category_stats bcs
WHERE (bcs.balls_wicket_overs * 1.0 / 6.0) > 6 OR (bcs.balls_non_wicket_overs * 1.0 / 6.0) > 6
ORDER BY bcs.bowler;

intent: Analyze the frequency of boundary hits (fours and sixes) per ball faced by bowlers in the initial phase of the innings versus the later stages.

sql:
SELECT

    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 5) > 0

    ELSE 0

    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > 5) > 0

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen in death overs (last 5 overs) versus the rest of the match, specifically focusing on batsmen who have faced at least 5 balls in the death overs.
structure: Grouping by batsman, using CASE expressions to differentiate between 'death overs' (last 5 overs) and 'rest of match'. Calculating strike rate for each phase. Filtering for batsmen who have faced a minimum of 5 balls in the death overs.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5)
    ELSE 0
  END AS death_overs_strike_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_runs) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0 AND SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs))) FROM df) - 5) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5)
    ELSE 0
  END AS rest_of_match_strike_rate
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5) >= 5
ORDER BY death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Analyze bowler's economy rate in different phases of the innings (powerplay, middle, death overs).
structure: Group by bowler. Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to define three phases (e.g., first 6 overs, overs 7-15, overs 16-20). Calculate economy rate (runs/overs) for each phase.
sql:

    WHEN SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_runs_given) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(bowler_bowls_done) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6)

    WHEN SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_runs_given) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(bowler_bowls_done) FILTER (WHERE CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_middle_overs,
