intent: Calculate the average number of balls faced by a batsman after hitting a boundary (four or six).
structure: Use a CTE with a window function to identify boundary balls. Then, for each batsman, calculate the average number of balls faced between consecutive boundary balls.
sql:
WITH BatsmanDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        -- Calculate cumulative balls faced by the batsman up to this delivery
        -- Assuming batsman_bowls_faced > 0 means the batsman faced this specific ball
        SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_bowls_faced > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS cumulative_balls_faced_by_batsman,
        -- Identify if this delivery was a boundary (four or six)
        (CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_boundary
    FROM
        df
),
BoundaryEvents AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        cumulative_balls_faced_by_batsman,
        -- Assign a unique sequence number to each boundary for a given batsman
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS boundary_occurrence_num
    FROM
        BatsmanDeliveries
    WHERE
        is_boundary = 1
),
BoundaryGaps AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        cumulative_balls_faced_by_batsman,
        -- Get the cumulative balls faced at the previous boundary event for the same batsman
        LAG(cumulative_balls_faced_by_batsman) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY boundary_occurrence_num) AS prev_boundary_balls_faced
    FROM
        BoundaryEvents
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(cumulative_balls_faced_by_batsman - prev_boundary_balls_faced) AS avg_balls_after_boundary
FROM
    BoundaryGaps
WHERE
    -- Filter out the first boundary for each batsman, as it has no previous boundary
    prev_boundary_balls_faced IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    -- Ensure that there is at least one calculated gap, which means the batsman hit at least two boundaries
    COUNT(cumulative_balls_faced_by_batsman - prev_boundary_balls_faced) >= 1;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in overs where they scored at least one boundary versus overs where they did not.
structure: Use a CASE statement to flag overs with boundaries. Calculate strike rate for each batsman, aggregating separately for boundary overs and non-boundary overs.
sql:
WITH OverBoundaryStatus AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_boundary_in_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    d.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN obs.has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN obs.has_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_with_boundary_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN obs.has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN obs.has_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_without_boundary_overs
FROM
    df AS d
JOIN
    OverBoundaryStatus AS obs
ON
    d.batsman = obs.batsman AND CEIL(d.overs) = obs.over_number
GROUP BY
    d.batsman
ORDER BY
    d.batsman;

WITH bowler_delivery_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    bowler_wickets,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_dot_ball = 1 AND bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(is_dot_ball) AS dot_ball_wicket_conversion_rate
FROM bowler_delivery_stats
WHERE is_dot_ball = 1
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(is_dot_ball) > 0
ORDER BY dot_ball_wicket_conversion_rate DESC;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate (runs per ball) of batsmen immediately after hitting a boundary.
structure: Use a CTE to identify boundary-hitting deliveries. Use a window function (LAG) to check the status of the previous ball. Group by batsman and calculate the average runs scored per ball in the ball following a boundary.
sql:
WITH boundary_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary
  FROM df
),
subsequent_runs AS (
  SELECT
    bb.batsman,
    bb.overs,
    d.batsman_runs,
    bb.is_boundary,
    LAG(bb.is_boundary, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY bb.batsman ORDER BY bb.overs) AS previous_ball_was_boundary
  FROM boundary_balls AS bb
  JOIN df AS d ON bb.batsman = d.batsman AND bb.overs = d.overs
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_boundary
FROM subsequent_runs
WHERE previous_ball_was_boundary = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_after_boundary DESC;

intent: Compare the bowling economy rate of bowlers who bowl at least one wicket-taking ball versus those who do not, focusing on their performance in overs where they conceded runs.
structure: Group by bowler. Use conditional aggregation to calculate average runs per over for wicket-taking overs and non-wicket-taking overs. Use CTE to identify wicket-taking balls.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num, -- Use CEIL for correct over number
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_in_over,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS total_balls_in_over, -- Use bowler_bowls_done for balls bowled
        MAX(CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_wicket_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    o.bowler,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_wicket_over = 1 THEN o.total_runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_wicket_over = 1 THEN o.total_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END), 0),
        0
    ) AS economy_rate_wicket_overs,
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_wicket_over = 0 THEN o.total_runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_wicket_over = 0 THEN o.total_balls_in_over ELSE 0 END), 0),
        0
    ) AS economy_rate_non_wicket_overs
FROM OverStats o
GROUP BY o.bowler
ORDER BY o.bowler;

  overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs)

FROM df
ORDER BY batsman, overs;

intent: Evaluate the bowling economy rate difference between overs where a bowler takes wickets and overs where they don't.
structure: Group by bowler. Use CASE statements to filter for wicket-taking and non-wicket-taking overs. Calculate economy rate (runs per over) for each case.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded_in_over,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_taken_in_over,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS balls_bowled_in_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
),
CategorizedOvers AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        runs_conceded_in_over,
        balls_bowled_in_over,
        CASE
            WHEN wickets_taken_in_in_over > 0 THEN 'wicket_over'
            ELSE 'non_wicket_over'
        END AS over_type
    FROM OverStats
    WHERE balls_bowled_in_over > 0 -- Ensure only valid overs are considered
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN over_type = 'wicket_over' THEN runs_conceded_in_over ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
     NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN over_type = 'wicket_over' THEN balls_bowled_in_over ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 6 AS economy_rate_wicket_overs,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN over_type = 'non_wicket_over' THEN runs_conceded_in_over ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
     NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN over_type = 'non_wicket_over' THEN balls_bowled_in_over ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 6 AS economy_rate_non_wicket_overs
FROM CategorizedOvers
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY bowler;

structure: Filter for deliveries from a specific bowler in the death overs. Calculate strike rate for batsmen based on runs scored and balls faced in these death overs. Use CASE statement for filtering. Requires a placeholder for the bowler's name. Uses a subquery/CTE.
sql:
WITH DeathOverAnalysis AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE
    bowler = 'Azmatullah'
    AND CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 5 FROM df)
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM DeathOverAnalysis
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY

original_sql:
WITH DeathOverAnalysis AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE
    bowler = '{bowler}'
    AND CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) - 5 FROM df)
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_death_overs

intent: Find the average balls faced by batsmen between their boundary shots (fours or sixes).
structure: Use CTE to identify boundary balls. Then, use another CTE with window function to find the number of balls between consecutive boundaries for each batsman. Finally, calculate the average of these gaps. Uses CTEs and window functions.
sql:
WITH BatsmanBallSequence AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS is_boundary,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS cumulative_balls_faced
    FROM df
    WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
),
BoundaryEventsWithLag AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        cumulative_balls_faced,
        LAG(cumulative_balls_faced, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY cumulative_balls_faced) AS prev_boundary_balls_faced
    FROM BatsmanBallSequence
    WHERE is_boundary = TRUE
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(cumulative_balls_faced - prev_boundary_balls_faced) AS avg_balls_between_boundaries
FROM BoundaryEventsWithLag
WHERE prev_boundary_balls_faced != 0
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(cumulative_balls_faced - prev_boundary_balls_faced) >= 1;

intent: Analyze the momentum shift by comparing a batsman's strike rate in overs where they scored at least one boundary versus overs where they did not.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE to define two types of overs: those with boundaries scored by the batsman, and those without. Calculate strike rate for each category using aggregated runs and balls faced. Uses CASE expressions.
sql:
WITH BatsmanOverStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_over,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_in_over,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(batsman_fours) > 0 OR SUM(batsman_sixes) > 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS hit_boundary_in_over
    FROM df
    WHERE batsman_bowls_faced > 0
    GROUP BY batsman, CEIL(overs)
)
SELECT
    b.batsman,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.hit_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN b.runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN b.hit_boundary_in_over = 1 THEN b.balls_in_over ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_with_boundary_overs,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.hit_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN b.runs_in_over ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN b.hit_boundary_in_over = 0 THEN b.balls_in_over ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_without_boundary_overs
FROM BatsmanOverStats b
GROUP BY b.batsman
HAVING SUM(b.balls_in_over) > 0
ORDER BY b.batsman;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Group by batsman, calculate strike rate using SUM(batsman_runs) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) for death overs (CEIL(overs) > max_over - 5) and for the rest of the match, using CASE statements for conditional aggregation. Use subqueries to determine max_over.
sql:
WITH OverBoundaries AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    over_number
),
MaxOver AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num FROM df
)
SELECT
  ob.batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(ob.total_balls) FILTER (WHERE ob.over_number > mo.max_over_num - 5) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(ob.total_runs) FILTER (WHERE ob.over_number > mo.max_over_num - 5) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(ob.total_balls) FILTER (WHERE ob.over_number > mo.max_over_num - 5)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(ob.total_balls) FILTER (WHERE ob.over_number <= mo.max_over_num - 5) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(ob.total_runs) FILTER (WHERE ob.over_number <= mo.max_over_num - 5) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(ob.total_balls) FILTER (WHERE ob.over_number <= mo.max_over_num - 5)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_match
FROM OverBoundaries AS ob
CROSS JOIN MaxOver AS mo
GROUP BY ob.batsman, mo.max_over_num
HAVING SUM(ob.total_balls) > 0
ORDER BY ob.batsman;

intent: Analyze the effectiveness of bowlers by comparing their economy rate in overs where they took wickets versus overs where they did not.
structure: Group by bowler. Use CASE statements to sum runs and count balls for wicket-taking overs and non-wicket-taking overs separately. Calculate economy rate for each case. Filter for bowlers with a significant number of overs in both categories.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN total_balls_wicket_overs > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs_wicket_overs AS REAL) / total_balls_wicket_overs ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate_wicket_overs,
  CASE WHEN total_balls_non_wicket_overs > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs_non_wicket_overs AS REAL) / total_balls_non_wicket_overs ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate_non_wicket_overs
FROM (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket > 0 THEN over_runs ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_wicket_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket > 0 THEN over_balls ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls_wicket_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket = 0 THEN over_runs ELSE 0 END) AS total_runs_non_wicket_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_wicket = 0 THEN over_balls ELSE 0 END) AS total_balls_non_wicket_overs
  FROM (
    SELECT
      bowler,
      CEIL(overs) AS current_over_number,
      SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS over_runs,
      SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS over_balls,
      MAX(bowler_wickets) AS has_wicket
    FROM df
    GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
  ) AS per_over_stats
  GROUP BY bowler
) AS bowler_summary
WHERE total_balls_wicket_overs > 0 OR total_balls_non_wicket_overs > 0
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Identify instances of consecutive dot balls faced by a batsman and the subsequent scoring, to understand momentum shifts after a period of no runs.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls. Use a window function (LAG) to check if the previous ball was a dot ball. Then, group by batsman to count boundaries (fours/sixes) that occurred immediately after one or more dot balls. Use a HAVING clause to consider batsmen with a sufficient number of balls faced.
sql:
WITH DotBalls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
  FROM df
),
ConsecutiveDots AS (
  SELECT
    db.batsman,
    db.overs,
    db.batsman_runs,
    db.is_dot_ball,
    LAG(db.is_dot_ball, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY db.batsman ORDER BY db.overs) AS previous_ball_was_dot
  FROM DotBalls AS db
)
SELECT
  cd.batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cd.batsman_runs > 0 AND cd.previous_ball_was_dot = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scoring_shots_after_dot,
  COUNT(*) AS total_balls_analyzed
FROM ConsecutiveDots AS cd
WHERE cd.previous_ball_was_dot = 1
GROUP BY cd.batsman
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY scoring_shots_after_dot DESC;

WITH OverInfo AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  d.batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > oi.max_over - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > oi.max_over - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= oi.max_over - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= oi.max_over - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM df AS d
CROSS JOIN OverInfo AS oi
GROUP BY d.batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > oi.max_over - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= oi.max_over - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0

intent: Analyze the scoring rate of batsmen in the initial overs (first 5 overs) versus the later overs of their innings, to understand if they are more aggressive early on or finish strongly.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE expressions to bucket overs into 'early' (first 5) and 'late'. Calculate the strike rate (total runs / total balls faced) for each phase. Requires CTEs to determine the maximum over for each batsman.
sql:
WITH batsman_overs AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
split_innings AS (
  SELECT
    d.batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_early,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_late,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_late
  FROM df AS d
  JOIN batsman_overs AS bo
    ON d.batsman = bo.batsman
  GROUP BY d.batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN balls_early > 0 THEN CAST(runs_early AS REAL) * 100 / balls_early ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_early,
  CASE WHEN balls_late > 0 THEN CAST(runs_late AS REAL) * 100 / balls_late ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_late
FROM split_innings
WHERE balls_early > 0 OR balls_late > 0
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Analyze the number of wickets taken by bowlers in the first ball of an over compared to subsequent balls in the same over.
structure: Use a window function to identify the first ball of each over. Group by bowler and a flag indicating if it's the first ball of an over. Count wickets for each category.
sql:
WITH first_ball_over AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_wickets,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CEIL(overs) ORDER BY overs)
      = 1
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_first_ball_of_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_ball_of_over = 1 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_first_ball,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_first_ball_of_over = 0 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_subsequent_balls
FROM first_ball_over
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0
ORDER BY
  bowler;

intent: Determine the average number of balls faced by a batsman between hitting boundaries (fours or sixes).
structure: Identify boundary balls using a CASE expression. Use a window function to find the previous boundary ball's 'overs' value for each batsman. Calculate the difference in 'overs' and average it.
sql:
WITH BoundaryDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        FLOOR(overs) * 6 + ROUND((overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10) AS total_balls_faced_at_boundary
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0
),
ConsecutiveBoundaryIntervals AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        total_balls_faced_at_boundary,
        LAG(total_balls_faced_at_boundary) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY total_balls_faced_at_boundary) AS prev_total_balls_faced
    FROM
        BoundaryDeliveries
),
CalculatedIntervals AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        total_balls_faced_at_boundary - prev_total_balls_faced AS balls_between_boundaries
    FROM
        ConsecutiveBoundaryIntervals
    WHERE
        prev_total_balls_faced IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(balls_between_boundaries) AS avg_balls_between_boundaries
FROM
    CalculatedIntervals
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    COUNT(balls_between_boundaries) >= 1

intent: Compare the economy rate of bowlers in the powerplay overs (first 6 overs) versus the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Group by bowler. Use CASE expressions with CEIL(overs) to bucket runs and balls into 'powerplay' and 'death overs'. Calculate economy rate (total runs / total balls * 6) for each phase.
sql:
WITH MatchStats AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_overs_completed
    FROM df
),
PowerplayStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS pp_runs,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS pp_balls
    FROM df
    WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6
    GROUP BY bowler
),
DeathOversStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler,
        SUM(d.bowler_runs_given) AS do_runs,
        SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done) AS do_balls
    FROM df d
    CROSS JOIN MatchStats ms
    WHERE CEIL(d.overs) > (ms.max_overs_completed - 5)
    GROUP BY d.bowler
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(ps.bowler, dos.bowler) AS bowler,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.pp_balls > 0 THEN (ps.pp_runs * 6.0) / ps.pp_balls
        ELSE NULL
    END AS economy_powerplay,
    CASE
        WHEN dos.do_balls > 0 THEN (dos.do_runs * 6.0) / dos.do_balls
        ELSE NULL
    END AS economy_death_overs
FROM PowerplayStats ps
FULL OUTER JOIN DeathOversStats dos ON ps.bowler = dos.bowler

intent: Examine the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 2 overs) compared to the rest of the match. This will highlight batsmen who accelerate their scoring rate towards the end of an innings.
structure: Use a CTE to categorize deliveries into 'death overs' and 'non-death overs' based on CEIL(overs). Then, group by batsman and calculate strike rate for each phase using CASE expressions and conditional aggregation. Filter for batsmen with sufficient balls faced in each phase. Order by the difference in strike rates.
sql:
WITH OversPhase AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 2 THEN 'Death Overs'
      ELSE 'Non-Death Overs'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_non_death_overs
FROM OversPhase
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5 OR SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Non-Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

WITH BowlerWicketContext AS (

FROM
    BowlerWicketContext
WHERE

    bowler;

intent: Compare the economy rate of bowlers in the first 6 overs versus the rest of the match.
structure: Use CASE statements to define two phases: 'First 6 Overs' and 'Rest of Match' based on CEIL(overs). Calculate economy rate (SUM(bowler_runs_given) / COUNT(bowler_bowls_done)) for each phase using conditional aggregation. Group by bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rate_first_6_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 6 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS economy_rate_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Find the number of deliveries a bowler has bowled that resulted in a wicket, categorized by the number of runs scored on that delivery (0 to 4 runs).

sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_on_dot_ball,
  SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 1 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_on_1_run,
  SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 2 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_on_2_runs,

intent: Calculate the percentage of deliveries bowled by each bowler that resulted in boundaries (fours or sixes).
structure: Calculate the ratio of (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) to the total balls bowled by each bowler. Use a CASE statement to handle division by zero and group by bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(bowler_bowls_done)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_per_ball_bowled
FROM df
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
ORDER BY
  boundary_per_ball_bowled DESC;

intent: Analyze the scoring pattern of batsmen by comparing their average runs per ball in the death overs (last 5 overs) versus the rest of the innings. This highlights batsmen who accelerate their scoring in high-pressure situations.
structure: Using CTEs to first determine the death overs. Then, grouping by batsman to calculate average runs per ball for death overs and non-death overs separately. Uses CASE expressions for conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH DeathOverAnalysis AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_death_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 1 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_ball_death,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_ball_rest
FROM DeathOverAnalysis
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 1 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_ball_death DESC;

intent: Investigate the scoring momentum of batsmen by comparing their strike rate in the first six balls they face against their overall strike rate. This highlights batsmen who start aggressively.
structure: Using CTEs to first calculate strike rate for the first 6 balls faced by each batsman, and then their overall strike rate. Then, joins these two metrics. Uses CASE expressions to handle division by zero.
sql:
WITH BatsmanBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS ball_number_faced
    FROM df
),
FirstSixBallsStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ball_number_faced <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_first_6,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ball_number_faced <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_first_6
    FROM BatsmanBalls
    GROUP BY batsman
),
OverallStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_overall,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_overall
    FROM df
    GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
    o.batsman,
    CASE
        WHEN f.balls_first_6 < 6 THEN 0.0
        WHEN f.balls_first_6 > 0 THEN (CAST(f.runs_first_6 AS REAL) * 100.0) / f.balls_first_6
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS strike_rate_first_6,
    CASE
        WHEN o.balls_overall > 0 THEN (CAST(o.runs_overall AS REAL) * 100.0) / o.balls_overall
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS strike_rate_overall
FROM OverallStats AS o
LEFT JOIN FirstSixBallsStats AS f ON o.batsman = f.batsman
ORDER BY strike_rate_first_6 DESC;

intent: Determine the impact of wickets on subsequent scoring by calculating the average runs conceded by a bowler in the ball immediately following a wicket. This helps understand how bowlers recover or maintain pressure after a dismissal.
structure: Using a CTE with a window function (LAG) to get the wicket information from the previous ball. Then grouping by bowler to calculate the average runs given on the ball after a wicket.
sql:
WITH BowlerWicketEvents AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        bowler_wickets,
        bowler_runs_given,
        LEAD(bowler_runs_given, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_ball
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    bwe.bowler,
    AVG(bwe.runs_on_next_ball) AS avg_runs_after_wicket
FROM
    BowlerWicketEvents AS bwe
WHERE
    bwe.bowler_wickets = 1
    AND bwe.runs_on_next_ball IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    bwe.bowler
HAVING
    COUNT(bwe.runs_on_next_ball) > 0
ORDER BY
    avg_runs_after_wicket ASC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen specifically during the death overs (last 10 overs) of an innings.
structure: Use a CTE to define phases (death overs vs. other overs), then group by batsman, calculate strike rate using CASE statements for runs and balls faced within the death overs phase, and filter for batsmen with sufficient balls faced in that phase.
sql:
WITH over_phase AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,

    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN 'Death Overs'
      ELSE 'Other Overs'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM over_phase
WHERE phase = 'Death Overs'
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5
ORDER BY strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Determine the average number of runs conceded by bowlers in overs immediately following a wicket.
structure: Use a CTE to identify wicket balls, then a window function to get runs on the next ball for each bowler, and finally, average these runs grouped by bowler, filtering for bowlers with multiple wickets.
sql:
WITH WicketBalls AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_wicket
  FROM df
),
RunsAfterWicket AS (
  SELECT
    wb.bowler,
    AVG(df.team_runs) AS avg_runs_after_wicket
  FROM WicketBalls AS wb
  JOIN df ON wb.bowler = df.bowler AND df.overs > wb.overs
  WHERE wb.is_wicket = 1
  GROUP BY wb.bowler, wb.overs
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 -- Ensures we only consider overs where a wicket was taken
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  AVG(runs_on_next_ball) AS avg_runs_after_wicket
FROM (
  SELECT
    wb.bowler,
    -- Get the runs from the very next ball after a wicket, with a default of 0 if no next ball exists
    LEAD(df.team_runs, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY wb.bowler ORDER BY df.overs) AS runs_on_next_ball
  FROM WicketBalls AS wb
  JOIN df ON wb.bowler = df.bowler AND df.overs > wb.overs -- Joining to get subsequent balls
  WHERE wb.is_wicket = 1
) AS SubsequentBalls
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 -- Consider bowlers with at least 6 wicket-taking instances
ORDER BY avg_runs_after_wicket ASC;

  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN is_death_over = 0 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_non_death_overs

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in the first half versus the second half of their innings, based on balls faced.
structure: For each batsman, divide their innings into two halves based on the total number of balls they faced. Calculate the strike rate for each half. Group by batsman. Use a subquery to determine the halfway point in balls faced.
sql:
WITH BatsmanTotalBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM df
    GROUP BY batsman
    HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 10
),
BatsmanSequencedBalls AS (
    SELECT
        df.batsman,
        df.batsman_runs,
        df.batsman_bowls_faced,
        SUM(df.batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY df.batsman ORDER BY df.overs) AS running_balls_faced_seq
    FROM df
    WHERE df.batsman IN (SELECT batsman FROM BatsmanTotalBalls) -- Filter to relevant batsmen early
)
SELECT
    bsb.batsman,
    -- Strike rate for the first half
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN bsb.running_balls_faced_seq <= (btb.total_balls_faced / 2.0)
            THEN bsb.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE
                   WHEN bsb.running_balls_faced_seq <= (btb.total_balls_faced / 2.0)
                   THEN bsb.batsman_bowls_faced
                   ELSE 0
               END), 0) AS strike_rate_first_half,
    -- Strike rate for the second half
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN bsb.running_balls_faced_seq > (btb.total_balls_faced / 2.0)
            THEN bsb.batsman_runs
            ELSE 0
        END) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE
                   WHEN bsb.running_balls_faced_seq > (btb.total_balls_faced / 2.0)
                   THEN bsb.batsman_bowls_faced
                   ELSE 0
               END), 0) AS strike_rate_second_half
FROM BatsmanSequencedBalls AS bsb
JOIN BatsmanTotalBalls AS btb
    ON bsb.batsman = btb.batsman
GROUP BY bsb.batsman
ORDER BY bsb.batsman;

structure: Define two phases: 'Initial' (first 6 overs) and 'Later' (all subsequent overs). For each batsman, calculate the proportion of their runs that came from boundaries (4s and 6s) in each phase. Group by batsman. Use CASE and CEIL(overs) for phase definition. Filter batsmen who faced a minimum number of balls in each phase.
sql:
WITH initial_overs_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS initial_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS initial_balls
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) <= 6
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
),
later_overs_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS later_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS later_balls
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        CEIL(overs) > 6
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
)
SELECT
    i.batsman,
    (i.initial_runs * 100.0) / NULLIF(i.initial_balls, 0) AS strike_rate_initial,
    (l.later_runs * 100.0) / NULLIF(l.later_balls, 0) AS strike_rate_later
FROM
    initial_overs_stats i
INNER JOIN
    later_overs_stats l ON i.batsman = l.batsman;

intent: Analyze the change in a batsman's strike rate from the first half to the second half of their innings, focusing on innings where they faced a significant number of balls.
structure: Calculate the maximum over faced by each batsman. Then, for each batsman, calculate their strike rate in the first half of their innings (up to the midpoint over) and the second half. This involves using a CTE to find the last over, a CASE statement to define halves, and then aggregations (SUM, COUNT) for strike rate calculation, grouped by batsman. Finally, filter for batsmen who faced a minimum number of balls in the second half.
sql:
WITH batsman_innings_end AS (
  SELECT batsman, MAX(overs) AS last_over_faced
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
innings_halves AS (
  SELECT 
    df.batsman,
    df.batsman_runs,
    df.batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE 
      WHEN df.overs <= (bie.last_over_faced / 2.0) THEN 'First Half'
      ELSE 'Second Half'
    END AS innings_half
  FROM df
  JOIN batsman_innings_end bie ON df.batsman = bie.batsman
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 
      SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_half,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 
      SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_second_half
FROM innings_halves
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 20
ORDER BY batsman;

intent: Analyze the relationship between the number of wickets taken by a bowler and the runs conceded in the subsequent ball, to understand bowler's reaction post-wicket.
structure: Use a CTE to identify deliveries where a bowler took a wicket. Then, use a window function (LEAD) to get the runs scored on the very next ball bowled by the same bowler. Finally, calculate the average of these subsequent runs for each bowler, filtering for bowlers who have had a significant number of wicket-taking instances.
sql:
WITH DeliveriesWithNextBallInfo AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        bowler_wickets,
        LEAD(team_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_delivery
    FROM
        df
),
WicketDeliveriesAndTheirNextBallRuns AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        runs_on_next_delivery
    FROM
        DeliveriesWithNextBallInfo
    WHERE
        bowler_wickets > 0 AND runs_on_next_delivery IS NOT NULL
),
BowlerWicketCounts AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets_taken
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler
)
SELECT
    wd.bowler,
    AVG(wd.runs_on_next_delivery) AS avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket
FROM
    WicketDeliveriesAndTheirNextBallRuns wd
JOIN
    BowlerWicketCounts bwc ON wd.bowler = bwc.bowler
WHERE
    bwc.total_wickets_taken > 5
GROUP BY
    wd.bowler
ORDER BY
    avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket DESC;

intent: Investigate batsman boundary hitting by analyzing the frequency of fours and sixes in the first 6 overs compared to the rest of the innings.
structure: Use a CASE expression to define two phases (first 6 overs and rest of innings). Group by batsman and calculate the sum of fours and sixes for each phase, and also calculate the boundary percentage for each phase. Uses CTE.
sql:
WITH batsman_phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_powerplay,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_rest_of_innings,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_powerplay,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_rest_of_innings,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs_powerplay,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs_rest_of_innings
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) ELSE 0 END) > 5
        OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN (batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) ELSE 0 END) > 5
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    boundaries_powerplay,
    boundaries_rest_of_innings,
    (boundary_runs_powerplay * 100.0) / NULLIF(runs_powerplay, 0) AS boundary_percentage_powerplay,
    (boundary_runs_rest_of_innings * 100.0) / NULLIF(runs_rest_of_innings, 0) AS boundary_percentage_rest_of_innings
FROM
    batsman_phase_stats
ORDER BY
    batsman;

sql:
WITH death_overs AS (
  SELECT batsman, batsman_runs, batsman_bowls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_death_overs
FROM death_overs
GROUP BY
  batsman

  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) >= 10
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Assess bowler performance by comparing their strike rate in the death overs (last 5 overs) to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use a CASE expression with CEIL(overs) to define 'death overs' and 'overall'. Calculate strike rate (balls per wicket) for both phases using conditional aggregation. Group by bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 1 END) -- Use 1 to avoid division by zero if no wickets
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strike_rate_death_overs,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS REAL) / SUM(bowler_wickets)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS overall_strike_rate
FROM df
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_death_overs ASC NULLS FIRST;

intent: Examine bowler wicket-taking ability by calculating the average runs conceded on deliveries immediately following a wicket.
structure: Identify deliveries where a wicket was taken. Use a window function (LEAD) to get the runs conceded on the next ball, partitioned by bowler and ordered by overs. Then calculate the average of these subsequent runs, grouped by bowler. Uses CTE and window functions.
sql:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        bowler_wickets,
        LEAD(bowler_runs_given, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_ball
    FROM
        df
),
WicketFollowUpRuns AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        runs_on_next_ball
    FROM
        WicketEvents
    WHERE
        bowler_wickets > 0 -- This delivery was a wicket
        AND runs_on_next_ball IS NOT NULL -- Ensure there was a next delivery by the same bowler
),
BowlerTotalWickets AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets -- Corrected: Use SUM for total wickets
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        bowler
)
SELECT
    wfr.bowler,
    AVG(wfr.runs_on_next_ball) AS avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket
FROM
    WicketFollowUpRuns wfr
JOIN
    BowlerTotalWickets btw
ON
    wfr.bowler = btw.bowler
WHERE
    btw.total_wickets > 5
GROUP BY
    wfr.bowler
ORDER BY
    avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket ASC;

intent: Calculate the cumulative runs scored by a specific batsman after each over, showing the progression over the innings.
structure: Use a window function to calculate the cumulative sum of batsman_runs, partitioned by batsman and ordered by CEIL(overs). This will show over-by-over cumulative runs.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
  SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_in_this_over,
  SUM(SUM(batsman_runs)) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY CEIL(overs) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_runs_by_end_of_over
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman, CEIL(overs)
ORDER BY batsman, over_number;

intent: Calculate the ratio of dot balls to total balls faced by each batsman in the death overs (last 10 overs).
structure: Use a CTE to filter for the death overs. Then group by batsman and calculate the ratio of dot balls (where batsman_runs = 0) to total balls faced within that phase.
sql:
WITH death_overs_balls AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_death_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_death_overs
FROM death_overs_balls
WHERE is_death_over = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY dot_ball_percentage_death_overs DESC;

sql:

  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(overs AS TEXT) LIKE CAST(CEIL(overs) AS TEXT) || '.1' THEN team_runs ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(overs AS TEXT) LIKE CAST(CEIL(overs) AS TEXT) || '.1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_runs_first_ball,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(overs AS TEXT) NOT LIKE CAST(CEIL(overs) AS TEXT) || '.1' THEN team_runs ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(overs AS TEXT) NOT LIKE CAST(CEIL(overs) AS TEXT) || '.1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS avg_runs_subsequent_balls

intent: Analyze the percentage of dot balls bowled by each bowler in the first 6 overs versus the rest of the match. This helps understand how bowlers adapt their line and length to restrict scoring in different phases.
structure: Group by bowler. Use CASE expressions to categorize deliveries into 'powerplay' (first 6 overs) and 'rest_of_match'. Calculate the count of dot balls (batsman_runs = 0) and total balls for each phase. Then, compute the dot ball percentage for each phase.
sql:
WITH PowerplayStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pp_dot_balls,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS pp_total_balls
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        overs < 6.0 AND batsman_bowls_faced = 1
    GROUP BY
        bowler
),
RestOfMatchStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rom_dot_balls,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS rom_total_balls
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        overs >= 6.0 AND batsman_bowls_faced = 1
    GROUP BY
        bowler
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(pps.bowler, roms.bowler) AS bowler,
    CASE
        WHEN pps.pp_total_balls IS NULL OR pps.pp_total_balls = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (CAST(pps.pp_dot_balls AS REAL) * 100.0) / pps.pp_total_balls
    END AS dot_ball_percentage_powerplay,
    CASE
        WHEN roms.rom_total_balls IS NULL OR roms.rom_total_balls = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (CAST(roms.rom_dot_balls AS REAL) * 100.0) / roms.rom_total_balls
    END AS dot_ball_percentage_rest_of_match
FROM
    PowerplayStats pps
FULL OUTER JOIN
    RestOfMatchStats roms ON pps.bowler = roms.bowler
WHERE
    (pps.pp_total_balls IS NOT NULL AND pps.pp_total_balls > 0) OR
    (roms.rom_total_balls IS NOT NULL AND roms.rom_total_balls > 0)

intent: Investigate the correlation between a bowler's maiden overs and their overall economy rate in specific phases of the innings.
structure: Grouping by bowler and phases (defined by CASE on CEIL(overs)), calculating maiden overs and economy rate. CTE used to define maiden overs.
sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_num,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS balls_bowled
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        CEIL(overs)
),
OverClassified AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        over_num,
        runs_conceded,
        balls_bowled,
        CASE
            WHEN over_num BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN over_num BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            ELSE 'Death Overs'
        END AS phase,
        CASE
            WHEN runs_conceded = 0 AND balls_bowled >= 6 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_maiden_over
    FROM OverStats
),
PhaseSummary AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        phase,
        SUM(is_maiden_over) AS maiden_overs_count,
        SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs_given_phase,
        SUM(balls_bowled) AS total_balls_bowled_phase
    FROM OverClassified
    GROUP BY
        bowler,
        phase
),
QualifiedBowlers AS (
    SELECT
        bowler
    FROM PhaseSummary
    WHERE total_balls_bowled_phase >= 6
    GROUP BY
        bowler
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT phase) = 3
)
SELECT
    ps.bowler,
    ps.phase,
    ps.maiden_overs_count,
    (ps.total_runs_given_phase * 6.0) / NULLIF(ps.total_balls_bowled_phase, 0) AS economy_rate
FROM PhaseSummary ps
JOIN QualifiedBowlers qb ON ps.bowler = qb.bowler
ORDER BY
    ps.bowler,
    CASE ps.phase
        WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

intent: Analyze batsman strike rate progression throughout their innings.
structure: Using a CTE to define innings halves based on the number of balls faced, then calculating strike rate for each half using aggregations.
sql:
WITH batsman_innings_progress AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as delivery_id,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_balls_faced
  FROM df
),
innings_halves AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN cumulative_balls_faced <= (SELECT MAX(cumulative_balls_faced) FROM batsman_innings_progress WHERE batsman = bip.batsman) / 2 THEN 'First Half'
      ELSE 'Second Half'
    END AS innings_half
  FROM batsman_innings_progress bip
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_half,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_second_half
FROM innings_halves
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_first_half DESC;

sql:
WITH BowlerWickets AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        bowler_runs_given,
        LAG(bowler_wickets, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS prev_delivery_wickets
    FROM
        df
),
RunsAfterWicket AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        bowler_runs_given AS runs_conceded_after_wicket
    FROM
        BowlerWickets
    WHERE
        prev_delivery_wickets > 0
),
BowlerWicketCounts AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        bowler_wickets > 0
    GROUP BY
        bowler
    HAVING
        COUNT(*) >= 6
)
SELECT
    raw.bowler,
    AVG(raw.runs_conceded_after_wicket) AS avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket
FROM
    RunsAfterWicket raw
JOIN
    BowlerWicketCounts bwc ON raw.bowler = bwc.bowler
GROUP BY
    raw.bowler
ORDER BY
    avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket DESC;

intent: Find the batsman who scores the fastest in the initial powerplay overs (first 6 overs).
structure: Filtering for the first 6 overs using CASE, calculating strike rate (runs/balls faced) for batsmen, and ordering by strike rate.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_powerplay
FROM df
WHERE ceil(overs) <= 6
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) >= 10
ORDER BY strike_rate_powerplay DESC;

intent: Calculate the average number of boundaries (fours and sixes) hit per over by each batsman.
structure: Grouping by batsman and the over number (CEIL(overs)), summing boundaries, and dividing by the count of overs. Using CTE to get over number.
sql:
WITH over_boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    ceil(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS boundaries_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman, ceil(overs)
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(boundaries_in_over) AS avg_boundaries_per_over
FROM over_boundaries
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(over_number) >= 1
ORDER BY avg_boundaries_per_over DESC;

intent: Analyze the momentum of scoring by batsmen in the death overs, specifically looking at the ratio of boundaries to total runs scored.
structure: Group by batsman, use a CASE expression to identify death overs, calculate the sum of boundaries (fours + sixes) and the sum of runs, then compute the ratio. Uses CTEs and CASE.
sql:
WITH death_overs_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_fours,
    batsman_sixes,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_death_over
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_runs)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_percentage_death_overs
FROM death_overs_analysis
WHERE is_death_over = 1
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING sum(batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY boundary_percentage_death_overs DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in the first over versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Group by batsman, use CASE statements to differentiate first over and rest of innings, calculate strike rate (runs/balls * 100) for both phases. Uses CTEs and CASE.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) = 1 THEN 'First Over' ELSE 'Rest of Innings' END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_over,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM over_phases
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

WITH OverDetails AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        bowler_bowls_done,
        bowler_wickets,
        CEIL(overs) AS current_over_number
    FROM df
),
MaxOver AS (
    SELECT MAX(current_over_number) AS max_over_num
    FROM OverDetails
)

    od.bowler,
    CAST(SUM(od.bowler_bowls_done) AS REAL) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(od.bowler_wickets), 0) AS balls_per_wicket_death_overs
FROM OverDetails od, MaxOver mo

GROUP BY od.bowler
HAVING SUM(od.bowler_wickets) >= 1;

SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_middle_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

intent: Determine the average number of balls a batsman faces before hitting their first six in the match.
structure: Use a CTE to identify the 'overs' value for the first six hit by each batsman. Then, in another CTE, calculate the difference in 'overs' for all balls faced by that batsman before their first six. Finally, calculate the average of these differences, grouped by batsman.
sql:
WITH OrderedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        batsman_sixes,
        overs,
        -- Use overs and bowler_bowls_done for robust chronological ordering
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overs, bowler_bowls_done) AS seq_num,
        -- Identify the batsman from the previous delivery to detect changes
        LAG(batsman) OVER (ORDER BY overs, bowler_bowls_done) AS prev_batsman
    FROM df
),
BattingStints AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        batsman_sixes,
        seq_num,
        -- Assign a unique ID for each continuous batting appearance (stint) at the crease
        -- A new stint starts if it's the very first ball or the batsman has changed
        SUM(CASE WHEN seq_num = 1 OR batsman != prev_batsman THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY seq_num) AS batsman_stint_id
    FROM OrderedDeliveries
),
BallsFacedInStint AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_stint_id,
        batsman_sixes,
        seq_num,
        -- Calculate cumulative balls faced by the batsman within their current stint
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman_stint_id ORDER BY seq_num) AS cumulative_balls_faced_in_stint
    FROM BattingStints
),
FirstSixDetails AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_stint_id,
        -- Find the sequence number of the first six hit in each batting stint
        MIN(seq_num) AS first_six_seq_num
    FROM BallsFacedInStint
    WHERE batsman_sixes > 0 -- Only consider deliveries where a six was hit
    GROUP BY batsman, batsman_stint_id
),
BallsBeforeFirstSixPerStint AS (
    SELECT
        fsd.batsman,
        fsd.batsman_stint_id,
        -- Get the cumulative balls faced *just before* the ball on which the first six was hit
        -- If the first six was hit on the first ball of the stint, there will be no rows
        -- satisfying the condition (seq_num < first_six_seq_num), MAX will return NULL,
        -- and COALESCE will correctly set it to 0.
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN bfis.seq_num < fsd.first_six_seq_num THEN bfis.cumulative_balls_faced_in_stint END), 0) AS balls_faced_before_first_six
    FROM FirstSixDetails fsd
    JOIN BallsFacedInStint bfis
        ON fsd.batsman_stint_id = bfis.batsman_stint_id
    GROUP BY fsd.batsman, fsd.batsman_stint_id
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    -- Calculate the average number of balls faced before hitting the first six across all stints
    AVG(balls_faced_before_first_six * 1.0) AS avg_balls_to_first_six
FROM BallsBeforeFirstSixPerStint
GROUP BY batsman
-- The previous CTEs ensure only batsmen who have hit at least one six are included (implicitly)
ORDER BY avg_balls_to_first_six ASC;

intent: Analyze batsman strike rate variation across different phases of the innings (e.g., powerplay, middle overs, death overs).
structure: Use a CASE expression to define three innings phases based on the over number (derived from CEIL(overs)). Calculate the strike rate (runs/balls faced) for each batsman within each phase. Group by batsman and phase, and filter for batsmen with a minimum number of balls faced in each phase.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
    WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
    ELSE 'Death Overs'
  END AS over_phase,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate
FROM df
GROUP BY
  batsman,
  over_phase
HAVING
  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 10
ORDER BY
  batsman,
  CASE over_phase
    WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END;

intent: Compare the boundary hitting percentage (fours and sixes) for batsmen in the death overs versus their overall boundary hitting percentage.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate the overall boundary percentage for each batsman. In a separate CTE or subquery, calculate the boundary percentage specifically for death overs (e.g., last 5 overs). Join or combine these results to show both percentages for each batsman.
sql:
WITH OverallBoundary AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced), 0) AS overall_boundary_pct,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS overall_balls_faced
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
  HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 10
),
DeathOverBoundary AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced), 0) AS death_over_boundary_pct,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_overs_balls_faced
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY batsman
  HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 5
)
SELECT
  o.batsman,
  o.overall_boundary_pct,
  d.death_over_boundary_pct
FROM OverallBoundary AS o
INNER JOIN DeathOverBoundary AS d
  ON o.batsman = d.batsman
ORDER BY
  o.overall_boundary_pct DESC;

intent: Identify bowlers who are particularly effective at taking wickets in the powerplay versus the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CASE expression to partition bowler wickets into 'Powerplay' (first 6 overs) and 'Rest of Match'. Sum wickets for each bowler in these two categories. Group by bowler.
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_powerplay,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY wickets_powerplay DESC, wickets_rest_of_match DESC;

intent: Identify batsmen who tend to hit boundaries immediately after facing a dot ball.
structure: Use a CTE with a LAG window function on `batsman_runs` to check the previous delivery's outcome. Filter for deliveries where the previous ball was a dot and the current ball resulted in a six or a four. Count these occurrences per batsman.
sql:
WITH PreviousDeliveryStats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_fours,
    batsman_sixes,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_runs
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  COUNT(*) AS boundary_after_dot_count
FROM PreviousDeliveryStats
WHERE
  prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0)
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY
  boundary_after_dot_count DESC;

intent: Calculate the average balls per wicket for bowlers, specifically when bowling to a particular batsman.
structure: Group the data by bowler and batsman. Calculate the total wickets taken by the bowler against that batsman and the total balls bowled by the bowler to that batsman. Compute the average balls per wicket (balls/wickets).
sql:
SELECT
  bowler,
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS REAL) / SUM(bowler_wickets) ELSE NULL END AS avg_balls_per_wicket
FROM df
GROUP BY
  bowler,
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0 AND SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 10
ORDER BY
  avg_balls_per_wicket ASC;

intent: Calculate the percentage of balls bowled by each bowler that resulted in a wicket in the first 10 overs compared to the rest of the match.
structure: Use a CTE to define the first 10 overs and the rest of the match. Calculate total wickets and total balls bowled for each phase. Compute wicket percentage for each phase. Group by bowler. Use CASE expressions for phase definition. Use ratio aggregation.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_wickets,
    bowler_bowls_done,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 10 THEN 'First 10 Overs' ELSE 'Rest of Match' END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS wicket_percentage_first_10_overs,
  CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Match' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Match' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Match' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS wicket_percentage_rest_of_match
FROM over_phases
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Match' THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  wicket_percentage_first_10_overs DESC;

intent: Identify batsmen who consistently hit boundaries in the first over after facing a dot ball in the preceding over.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls and boundary-scoring balls. Use a window function (LAG) to check for a dot ball in the previous over. Filter for boundary hits in the current over immediately following a dot ball in the previous over. Group by batsman and count occurrences. Use ratio aggregation.
sql:
WITH BatsmanEvents AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        CEIL(overs) AS current_over_num,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        LAG(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_runs,
        LAG(CEIL(overs), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_over_num
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    COUNT(*) AS boundaries_after_dot_in_prev_over
FROM
    BatsmanEvents
WHERE
    (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0)
    AND prev_batsman_runs = 0
    AND current_over_num = prev_over_num + 1
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY
    boundaries_after_dot_in_prev_over DESC;

intent: Determine the average number of runs conceded by a bowler on the ball immediately following a wicket they have taken.
structure: Use a CTE to identify wicket-taking deliveries. Use a window function (LEAD) to get the runs scored on the next ball. Calculate the average of these runs. Group by bowler. Use window functions and averaging aggregation.
sql:
WITH BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        bowler_wickets,
        LEAD(bowler_runs_given) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_ball,
        SUM(bowler_wickets) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler) AS total_bowler_wickets
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    AVG(runs_on_next_ball) AS avg_runs_conceded_after_wicket
FROM
    BowlerStats
WHERE
    bowler_wickets > 0
    AND runs_on_next_ball IS NOT NULL
    AND total_bowler_wickets >= 3
GROUP BY
    bowler;

intent: Analyze the momentum of a batsman by comparing their strike rate in the first half of their innings (based on balls faced) versus the second half.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate cumulative balls faced for each batsman. Use a CASE expression to divide the innings into first and second halves based on cumulative balls faced. Calculate strike rate for each half. Group by batsman. Use window functions, CASE expressions, and ratio aggregation.
sql:
WITH batsman_innings_progress AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    -- Calculate cumulative balls faced for each batsman in chronological order
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_balls_faced,
    -- Calculate total balls faced by each batsman in their innings using a window function for efficiency
    MAX(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman) AS total_balls_faced_for_innings
  FROM df
),
inning_halves AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      -- Determine if the current ball falls into the 'First Half' or 'Second Half'
      -- The first half includes FLOOR(total_balls_faced_for_innings / 2) balls.
      WHEN cumulative_balls_faced <= total_balls_faced_for_innings / 2 THEN 'First Half'
      ELSE 'Second Half'
    END AS innings_half
  FROM batsman_innings_progress
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  -- Calculate strike rate for the first half, using NULLIF for divide-by-zero
  SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_first_half,
  -- Calculate strike rate for the second half, using NULLIF for divide-by-zero
  SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS strike_rate_second_half
FROM inning_halves
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  -- Filter to include only batsmen who faced at least one ball in either half
  SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'First Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN innings_half = 'Second Half' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_first_half DESC;

intent: Find the top batsmen who hit the most boundaries (fours and sixes) per over, considering only batsmen who have faced a minimum number of balls.
structure: Calculate the total boundaries (fours + sixes) for each batsman in each over. Calculate the average boundaries per over for each batsman. Filter batsmen based on a minimum number of balls faced. Group by batsman. Use sum aggregation for boundaries and average aggregation for boundaries per over. Use CASE expressions for over number.
sql:
WITH over_boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    ceil(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS boundaries_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    ceil(overs)
)
SELECT
  ob.batsman,
  AVG(ob.boundaries_in_over) AS avg_boundaries_per_over
FROM over_boundaries ob
JOIN (
  SELECT
    batsman, SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) as total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
  HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) >= 20 -- Minimum balls faced threshold
) AS qualifying_batsmen
ON ob.batsman = qualifying_batsmen.batsman
GROUP BY
  ob.batsman
ORDER BY
  avg_boundaries_per_over DESC;

structure: Use a CTE to identify wicket-taking deliveries. Then, use a window function (LEAD) to find the runs scored on the ball immediately following each wicket. Finally, group by bowler and calculate the average of these subsequent runs.

sql:
SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_rest_of_match
FROM df
GROUP BY

ORDER BY

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen in the first over compared to their strike rate in the rest of the innings, considering only batsmen who faced at least 5 balls in the first over.
structure: Use a CTE to categorize deliveries into the 'first over' (CEIL(overs) = 1) and 'rest of innings'. Calculate strike rates for both categories. Use CASE for categorization and aggregation. Apply a HAVING clause to filter batsmen with at least 5 balls faced in the first over. Use CAST for floating-point division.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN ceil(overs) = 1 THEN 'First Over'
      ELSE 'Rest of Innings'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_over,
  CASE
    WHEN sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM over_phases
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  sum(CASE WHEN phase = 'First Over' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_first_over DESC;

intent: Analyze the efficiency of batsmen by looking at their strike rate in the first six balls they face versus their strike rate for the rest of their innings.
structure: Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to categorize deliveries into 'first six balls' and 'rest of innings' based on `overs`. Calculate strike rate (batsman_runs / batsman_bowls_faced * 100) for each phase. Requires CASE and aggregation.
sql:
WITH BattingSequence AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as ball_num
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        batsman_bowls_faced = 1 -- Ensure we only consider balls actually faced by the batsman
)
SELECT
    bs.batsman,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.ball_num <= 6 THEN bs.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.ball_num <= 6 THEN 1 END), 0) AS strike_rate_first_6_balls,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.ball_num > 6 THEN bs.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.ball_num > 6 THEN 1 END), 0) AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM
    BattingSequence bs
GROUP BY
    bs.batsman
HAVING
    COUNT(bs.ball_num) > 0
ORDER BY
    strike_rate_first_6_balls DESC;

structure: Group by batsman. Calculate the total number of balls faced and the total number of runs scored. Calculate the dot ball percentage (100 * (balls_faced - runs_scored) / balls_faced). Requires aggregation.

intent: Determine the average number of balls a batsman faces before hitting their first six.
structure: Use CTEs. The first CTE identifies the 'overs' of the first six hit by each batsman. The second CTE calculates the difference in 'overs' between a batsman's boundary and their first six. Finally, average these differences grouped by batsman. Requires CTEs and window functions.
sql:
WITH FirstSixOver AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        MIN(overs) AS first_six_overs
    FROM df
    WHERE batsman_sixes > 0
    GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
    f.batsman,
    SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS balls_faced_until_first_six
FROM df AS d
JOIN FirstSixOver AS f
    ON d.batsman = f.batsman
WHERE
    d.overs <= f.first_six_overs
GROUP BY
    f.batsman
ORDER BY
    balls_faced_until_first_six ASC;

intent: Determine the average number of balls a batsman takes to hit their first six, considering only batsmen who have hit at least one six.
structure: Use a CTE to identify the 'overs' of the first six for each batsman. Then, join this CTE back to the main table to calculate the difference in 'overs' between the first six and subsequent balls. Group by batsman and calculate the average difference.
sql:
WITH FirstSix AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        MIN(overs) AS first_six_overs -- Identify the 'overs' value for the first six hit by each batsman
    FROM df
    WHERE batsman_sixes > 0
    GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
    f.batsman,
    -- Calculate the average of 'batsman_bowls_faced' for all deliveries before the first six
    -- 'batsman_bowls_faced' is usually 1 for a faced ball and 0 otherwise, so AVG(batsman_bowls_faced) represents the proportion of faced balls among all deliveries before the first six.
    AVG(d.batsman_bowls_faced * 1.0) AS avg_balls_faced_before_first_six
FROM FirstSix AS f
JOIN df AS d
    ON f.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
    d.overs < f.first_six_overs -- Filter for deliveries that occurred strictly before the first six
GROUP BY
    f.batsman
HAVING
    COUNT(d.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 -- Ensure there was at least one delivery before the first six to calculate an average from
ORDER BY
    avg_balls_faced_before_first_six ASC;

intent: Determine the batsmen who have the highest boundary percentage in death overs compared to their overall boundary percentage.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate overall boundary percentage and death over boundary percentage. Boundary percentage is defined as (fours + sixes) / balls faced. Death overs are considered the last 5 overs. Join the CTEs and order by overall boundary percentage.
sql:
WITH overall_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS overall_balls_faced,
        SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS overall_boundaries
    FROM df
    GROUP BY batsman
),
death_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls_faced,
        SUM(d.batsman_fours + d.batsman_sixes) AS death_boundaries
    FROM df AS d
    WHERE CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
    GROUP BY d.batsman
)
SELECT
    o.batsman,
    CAST(o.overall_boundaries AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(o.overall_balls_faced, 0) AS overall_boundary_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN d.death_balls_faced IS NULL OR d.death_balls_faced = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE CAST(d.death_boundaries AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.death_balls_faced, 0)
    END AS death_over_boundary_pct
FROM overall_stats AS o
LEFT JOIN death_stats AS d ON o.batsman = d.batsman
WHERE
    o.overall_balls_faced >= 10
    AND COALESCE(d.death_balls_faced, 0) >= 5
ORDER BY overall_boundary_pct DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in different phases of the innings: powerplay, middle overs, and death overs.
structure: Use a CASE expression to define three phases: Powerplay (1-6 overs), Middle Overs (7-15 overs), and Death Overs (16+ overs). Group by batsman and phase, then calculate the strike rate for each phase. Filter for batsmen who have faced at least 10 balls in each phase.
sql:
WITH phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) >= 16 THEN 'Death Overs'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS phase,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) >= 16 THEN 'Death Overs'
            ELSE NULL
        END
    HAVING
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) >= 16 THEN 'Death Overs'
            ELSE NULL
        END IS NOT NULL
),
qualified_batsmen AS (
    SELECT
        batsman
    FROM phase_stats
    GROUP BY batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' AND total_balls_faced > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
        AND SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' AND total_balls_faced > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
        AND SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' AND total_balls_faced > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT
    ps.batsman,
    ps.phase,
    ps.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(ps.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate
FROM phase_stats ps
JOIN qualified_batsmen qb ON ps.batsman = qb.batsman
WHERE
    ps.total_balls_faced > 10
    AND ps.phase IN ('Powerplay', 'Middle Overs', 'Death Overs')
ORDER BY
    ps.batsman,
    CASE ps.phase
        WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

intent: Analyze the variation in a bowler's economy rate and wicket-taking ability across the match phases (powerplay vs. rest of match).

sql: SELECT bowler, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / (SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) / 6.0) ELSE 0 END AS economy_rate_powerplay, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS avg_balls_per_wicket_rest FROM df GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) >= 6 AND SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) >= 1 ORDER BY economy_rate_powerplay ASC;
