sql:
WITH bowlerprogress AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    bowler_wickets,
    SUM(bowler_bowls_done) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_balls,

)

  bowler,
  overs,
  CASE WHEN cumulative_wickets > 0 THEN CAST(cumulative_balls AS REAL) / cumulative_wickets ELSE NULL END AS balls_per_wicket
FROM bowlerprogress
WHERE cumulative_wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowler, overs;

structure: Identify balls where a wicket was taken. Use a window function to look at the next ball bowled by the same bowler. Calculate the average runs conceded on these subsequent balls. Use CTEs and window functions.
sql:
WITH BowlerWicketFollowUp AS (
    SELECT

intent: Calculate the average runs scored by a batsman after their first boundary of an innings.

WITH first_boundary AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as delivery_no
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0
),
subsequent_deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    df.batsman,
    df.batsman_runs
  FROM df
  JOIN first_boundary ON df.batsman = first_boundary.batsman AND df.overs > first_boundary.overs

  AVG(batsman_runs) AS avg_runs_after_first_boundary
FROM subsequent_deliveries

HAVING COUNT(batsman_runs) > 0
ORDER BY avg_runs_after_first_boundary DESC;

intent: Analyze the number of balls a batsman takes to score their first boundary after facing a specified number of dot balls consecutively.
structure: Use a CTE with a window function to count consecutive dot balls for each batsman, ordered by 'overs'. Filter for instances where the consecutive dot ball count reaches a certain threshold. Then, use another window function to find the 'overs' of the next boundary hit. Calculate the difference in 'overs' between the boundary and the start of the dot ball streak. This involves window functions and ordering by 'overs'.
sql:
WITH DotBallStreak AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
    CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as rn
  FROM df
),
StreakStart AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    is_dot_ball,
    is_boundary,
    SUM(is_dot_ball) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) as consecutive_dots
  FROM DotBallStreak
),
BoundaryAfterStreak AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    consecutive_dots,
    FIRST_VALUE(overs) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) as next_boundary_over
  FROM StreakStart
  WHERE is_boundary = 1
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(next_boundary_over - overs) AS avg_overs_to_boundary_after_dots
FROM BoundaryAfterStreak
WHERE consecutive_dots >= 15
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY avg_overs_to_boundary_after_dots ASC;

intent: Compare the average runs conceded per wicket taken by bowlers in the first 6 overs versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Use a CASE expression to define two phases: 'Powerplay' (CEIL(overs) <= 6) and 'Rest of Innings'. For each bowler, calculate the total runs conceded and total wickets taken in each phase. Compute the average runs per wicket for each phase. This involves CASE statements, aggregation, and ratios.
sql:
WITH PhaseWicketEconomy AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay' ELSE 'Rest of Innings' END AS phase,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_given,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, phase
)
SELECT
  pwe.bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Powerplay' THEN pwe.total_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_given_powerplay,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Powerplay' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_powerplay,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Powerplay' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Powerplay' THEN pwe.total_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Powerplay' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_powerplay,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN pwe.total_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS runs_given_rest,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_rest,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN pwe.total_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS avg_runs_per_wicket_rest
FROM PhaseWicketEconomy AS pwe
WHERE pwe.phase IN ('Powerplay', 'Rest of Innings') AND (pwe.total_wickets > 0 OR pwe.total_runs_given > 0)
GROUP BY pwe.bowler
HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Powerplay' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN pwe.phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN pwe.total_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0)
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_wicket_powerplay ASC;

intent: Analyze the proportion of dot balls bowled by each bowler in the first 10 overs versus the rest of the innings.
structure: Uses a CASE statement to define two phases: 'First 10 Overs' and 'Rest of Innings'. It then calculates the count of dot balls and total deliveries for each phase and bowler, computing the dot ball percentage.
sql:
WITH phase_data AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 10 THEN 'First 10 Overs' ELSE 'Rest of Innings' END AS phase,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
    1 AS total_delivery
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN is_dot_ball ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls_first_10,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) AS total_deliveries_first_10,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN is_dot_ball ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_first_10,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN is_dot_ball ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls_rest,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) AS total_deliveries_rest,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN is_dot_ball ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_rest
FROM phase_data
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'First 10 Overs' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Rest of Innings' THEN total_delivery ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY dot_ball_percentage_first_10 DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rates of batsmen across different phases of the innings: Powerplay (1-6 overs), Middle Overs (7-15 overs), and Death Overs (16+ overs).
structure: Uses a CASE statement to define three distinct phases based on the over number derived from CEIL(overs). It then calculates the strike rate for each batsman within each phase using SUM(batsman_runs) and SUM(batsman_bowls_faced).
sql:
WITH phase_strikerates AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  phase,
  CASE WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate
FROM phase_strikerates
WHERE phase IN ('Powerplay', 'Middle Overs', 'Death Overs')
GROUP BY batsman, phase
HAVING sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN 1
    WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
    WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN 3
  END;

intent: Determine the average number of balls a bowler takes to concede a boundary (4 or 6) after picking up a wicket.
structure: Use CTEs to identify wicket balls and subsequent balls. Use window functions to calculate runs conceded on the ball after a wicket. Aggregate by bowler.
sql:
WITH flagged_df AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    (CASE WHEN bowler_wickets > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_wicket,
    (CASE WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_boundary,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS ball_seq
  FROM df
),
wicket_streaks AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    is_wicket,
    is_boundary,
    ball_seq,
    SUM(is_wicket) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY ball_seq) AS streak_group_id
  FROM flagged_df
),
interval_starts_ends AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    streak_group_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 THEN ball_seq END) AS wicket_ball_seq,
    MIN(CASE WHEN is_boundary = 1 THEN ball_seq END) AS first_boundary_seq
  FROM wicket_streaks
  WHERE streak_group_id > 0
  GROUP BY bowler, streak_group_id
  HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 THEN ball_seq END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MIN(CASE WHEN is_boundary = 1 THEN ball_seq END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MIN(CASE WHEN is_boundary = 1 THEN ball_seq END) > MIN(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 THEN ball_seq END)
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  AVG(CAST(first_boundary_seq - wicket_ball_seq - 1 AS REAL)) AS avg_balls_between_boundary_and_wicket
FROM interval_starts_ends
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Calculate the average number of balls between boundaries conceded by each bowler.
structure: Use CTEs to identify boundary concessions. Use window functions to count balls since the last boundary. Aggregate by bowler.
sql:
WITH AllDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        overs,
        (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) AS is_boundary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY overs) AS ball_seq_num
    FROM
        df
),
BoundaryEvents AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        ball_seq_num,
        LAG(ball_seq_num, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY ball_seq_num) AS prev_boundary_ball_seq
    FROM
        AllDeliveries
    WHERE
        is_boundary = TRUE
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    AVG(CAST(ball_seq_num - prev_boundary_ball_seq AS REAL)) AS avg_balls_between_boundaries
FROM
    BoundaryEvents
GROUP BY
    bowler;

structure: Calculate overall strike rate and strike rate in the first 6 overs for each batsman. Uses CTEs to define phases and conditional aggregation. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH phase_strike_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS first_6_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS first_6_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN first_6_balls > 0 THEN CAST(first_6_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / first_6_balls ELSE 0 END AS first_6_strike_rate
FROM phase_strike_rates
WHERE first_6_balls > 0
ORDER BY first_6_strike_rate DESC;

SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
    WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 4 THEN 'Death Overs'
    ELSE 'Middle Overs'

  SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_in_phase
FROM df
WHERE bowler_wickets > 0
GROUP BY bowler, phase

  CASE phase
    WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3

structure: Calculate strike rates (runs/balls) for powerplay and overall. Use a CASE expression with CEIL(overs) to define powerplay. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH PhaseStrikeRates AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS powerplay_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS powerplay_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN powerplay_balls > 0 THEN CAST(powerplay_runs AS REAL) * 100 / powerplay_balls ELSE 0 END AS powerplay_strike_rate
FROM PhaseStrikeRates
WHERE
  powerplay_balls > 0 OR total_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  powerplay_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Quantify the increase in scoring rate (strike rate) from the death overs compared to the middle overs for batsmen.
structure: Use CASE statements with CEIL(overs) to define middle and death overs. Calculate strike rates for each phase. Use CTEs. Group by batsman. Calculate the difference in strike rates.
sql:
WITH PhaseStrikeRates AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 16 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 16 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 16 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 16 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN middle_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(middle_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / middle_overs_balls ELSE 0 END AS middle_overs_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN death_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / death_overs_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN death_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / death_overs_balls - CASE WHEN middle_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(middle_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / middle_overs_balls ELSE 0 END
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_increase_in_death_overs
FROM PhaseStrikeRates
WHERE
  middle_overs_balls > 0 OR death_overs_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_increase_in_death_overs DESC;

intent: Find batsmen who consistently play dot balls before hitting a boundary, analyzing the average number of dot balls faced before each boundary.
structure: Use CTEs to identify dot balls and boundaries, along with row numbers partitioned by batsman and ordered by overs. Join these CTEs to compare the sequence. Calculate the average count of dot balls preceding each boundary. Group by batsman. Order by the average dot balls.
sql:
WITH BallData AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_boundary,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_dot_ball
    FROM df
),
BoundaryMarkers AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        is_boundary,
        is_dot_ball,
        -- Assign a unique, incrementing ID to each boundary hit by a batsman.
        -- Only actual boundary balls will have a non-NULL boundary_event_id.
        CASE WHEN is_boundary = 1 THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) END AS boundary_event_id
    FROM BallData
),
AssociateBallsWithNextBoundary AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        is_boundary,
        is_dot_ball,
        -- For each ball, propagate the `boundary_event_id` of the *next* boundary backwards.
        -- This assigns a unique `next_boundary_sequence_id` to all balls leading up to a specific boundary (inclusive of the boundary itself).
        LAST_VALUE(boundary_event_id IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs DESC) AS next_boundary_sequence_id
    FROM BoundaryMarkers
),
DotBallsBeforeEachBoundaryEvent AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        next_boundary_sequence_id,
        -- Sum dot balls for deliveries *before* the boundary within each sequence.
        -- The boundary ball itself (is_boundary = 1) is explicitly excluded from dot ball count.
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_boundary = 0 THEN is_dot_ball ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls_before_boundary
    FROM AssociateBallsWithNextBoundary
    WHERE next_boundary_sequence_id IS NOT NULL -- Only consider sequences that actually lead to a boundary (i.e., not balls after the last boundary)
    GROUP BY batsman, next_boundary_sequence_id
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(CAST(dot_balls_before_boundary AS REAL)) AS avg_dot_balls_before_boundary
FROM DotBallsBeforeEachBoundaryEvent
WHERE dot_balls_before_boundary > 0 -- Only consider sequences where at least one dot ball was faced before the boundary
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING COUNT(next_boundary_sequence_id) > 0 -- Ensure the batsman has at least one valid sequence (i.e., hit a boundary and faced dots before it)
ORDER BY avg_dot_balls_before_boundary DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen in different phases of the innings (powerplay, middle overs, death overs) to understand their scoring patterns and aggression levels.
structure: Uses CTEs to define innings phases based on CEIL(overs). Groups by batsman and phase. Calculates total runs, total balls faced, and strike rate within each phase. Uses CASE statements for phase definition and conditional aggregation for calculating phase-specific metrics.
sql:
WITH PhaseAnalysis AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman,
    phase
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_powerplay,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_powerplay,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_middle,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_death,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_death,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_death
FROM PhaseAnalysis
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(total_balls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_death DESC;

intent: Identify batsmen who tend to score fewer runs immediately after getting out. This could indicate pressure on subsequent batsmen or a tailspin effect.
structure: Uses a CTE to flag dot balls and then the LEAD window function to check the runs scored on the ball immediately following a dot ball. Groups by batsman and calculates the average runs scored immediately after a dot ball. Uses ORDER BY overs.
sql:
WITH DeliveryStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
        LEAD(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS runs_on_next_ball,
        SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman) AS total_batsman_dot_balls
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(runs_on_next_ball) AS avg_runs_after_dot_ball
FROM
    DeliveryStats
WHERE
    is_dot_ball = 1
    AND runs_on_next_ball IS NOT NULL
    AND total_batsman_dot_balls > 5
GROUP BY
    batsman;

intent: Determine the distribution of total runs conceded by each bowler across different phases of the innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Uses a CTE with CASE statements to define three phases: 'Early', 'Middle', and 'Late' based on CEIL(overs). Groups by bowler and phase, summing the runs given. Aggregates these phase-wise runs for each bowler in a wide format.
sql:
WITH PhaseRuns AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Early'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle'
      ELSE 'Late'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_conceded
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler,
    phase
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN runs_conceded ELSE 0 END) AS runs_early,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN runs_conceded ELSE 0 END) AS runs_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN runs_conceded ELSE 0 END) AS runs_late
FROM PhaseRuns
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  runs_early + runs_middle + runs_late > 0
ORDER BY
  runs_late DESC;

intent: Analyze the dot ball percentage for each bowler across different phases of an innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Use a CTE to define innings phases based on CEIL(overs). Calculate dot balls (batsman_runs = 0). Group by bowler and phase. Calculate dot ball percentage.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Early'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle'
      ELSE 'Late'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  phase,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN CAST(SUM(is_dot_ball) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percentage
FROM over_phases
GROUP BY
  bowler,
  phase
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  bowler,
  CASE
    WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN 1
    WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN 2
    WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN 3
  END;

intent: Find the frequency of batsmen hitting boundaries (fours and sixes) immediately after a dot ball.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls and boundary hits. Use a window function (LAG) to check if the previous ball was a dot ball. Filter for boundary hits following a dot ball. Calculate frequency.
sql:
WITH BatsmanBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        LAG(batsman_runs, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_ball_batsman_runs
    FROM
        df
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(SUM(CASE
        WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) AND prev_ball_batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE
        WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS boundary_frequency_after_dot
FROM
    BatsmanBalls
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) > 0
ORDER BY
    boundary_frequency_after_dot DESC;

intent: Compare batsmen's strike rates in the early overs versus later overs of their innings.
structure: Use a CTE to define 'early' and 'later' overs based on CEIL(overs). Within the CTE, calculate total runs and balls faced per batsman, and also segment these by phase. The main query then calculates strike rates for each phase and overall, using conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Early Overs' ELSE 'Later Overs' END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Later Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Later Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Later Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS strike_rate_later_overs,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early Overs' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early Overs' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS strike_rate_early_overs
FROM over_phases
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY
  batsman;

intent: Assess the strike rate variation of batsmen across different phases of the innings: powerplay, middle overs, and death overs.
structure: Use a CTE to define phases (powerplay, middle, death) using CASE on CEIL(overs). Group by batsman and phase. Calculate strike rate for each phase. Order by strike rate increase in death overs.
sql:
WITH PhaseStrikerates AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS powerplay_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS powerplay_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 15 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN powerplay_balls > 0 THEN CAST(powerplay_runs AS REAL) * 100 / powerplay_balls ELSE 0 END AS powerplay_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN middle_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(middle_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / middle_overs_balls ELSE 0 END AS middle_overs_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN death_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100 / death_overs_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM PhaseStrikerates
WHERE
  powerplay_balls > 0 OR middle_overs_balls > 0 OR death_overs_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of batsmen in middle overs (overs 7-15) versus death overs (last 5 overs) to understand their finishing ability.
structure: Use a CTE to calculate runs and balls faced in middle and death overs separately using CASE on CEIL(overs). Calculate strike rates for both phases. Order by the increase in strike rate in death overs.
sql:
WITH MaxOverCTE AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num
    FROM df
),
PhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= 15 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= 15 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS middle_overs_balls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over_num FROM MaxOverCTE) - 5 THEN d.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_over_num FROM MaxOverCTE) - 5 THEN d.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls
    FROM df d
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE WHEN middle_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(middle_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / middle_overs_balls ELSE 0.0 END AS middle_overs_strike_rate,
    CASE WHEN death_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / death_overs_balls ELSE 0.0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate,
    (CASE WHEN death_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / death_overs_balls ELSE 0.0 END) -
    (CASE WHEN middle_overs_balls > 0 THEN CAST(middle_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / middle_overs_balls ELSE 0.0 END) AS strike_rate_increase_in_death_overs
FROM PhaseStats
WHERE
    middle_overs_balls > 10 OR death_overs_balls > 10
ORDER BY
    strike_rate_increase_in_death_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the change in bowler's performance by comparing their wickets and economy rate in the first half of the innings versus the second half.
structure: Use a CTE to define two phases (first half and second half) based on CEIL(overs). Group by bowler and phase. Calculate total wickets and total runs given. Compute wickets per runs given (economy rate).
sql:
WITH PhasePerformance AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) / 2.0 THEN 'First Half' ELSE 'Second Half' END AS phase,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS total_wickets,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_given
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    bowler,
    phase
)
SELECT
  bp.bowler,
  bp.total_wickets AS first_half_wickets,
  CASE WHEN bp.total_wickets > 0 THEN CAST(bp.total_runs_given AS REAL) / bp.total_wickets ELSE NULL END AS first_half_economy_rate,
  sp.total_wickets AS second_half_wickets,
  CASE WHEN sp.total_wickets > 0 THEN CAST(sp.total_runs_given AS REAL) / sp.total_wickets ELSE NULL END AS second_half_economy_rate
FROM PhasePerformance bp
JOIN PhasePerformance sp ON bp.bowler = sp.bowler AND bp.phase = 'First Half' AND sp.phase = 'Second Half'
WHERE bp.total_wickets > 0 OR sp.total_wickets > 0
ORDER BY
  second_half_economy_rate ASC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen during the death overs (last 5 overs of the innings) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate overall strike rate and death over strike rate for each batsman using conditional aggregation within a CTE. Group by batsman. Use CASE statements to define death overs based on CEIL(overs).
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 'Death' ELSE 'Normal' END AS phase
  FROM df
),
PhaseStrikeRate AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_balls,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM OverPhases
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM PhaseStrikeRate
WHERE death_balls > 0
ORDER BY death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Calculate the proportion of a bowler's wickets taken in the death overs.
structure: Use a CTE to identify deliveries in the death overs (last 5 overs). Calculate total wickets and death over wickets for each bowler. Compute the ratio. Group by bowler. Use CASE statements for phase definition.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_wickets,
    CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 'Death' ELSE 'Normal' END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(bowler_wickets) ELSE 0 END AS percentage_wickets_in_death_overs
FROM OverPhases
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0
ORDER BY percentage_wickets_in_death_overs DESC;

intent: Determine the average runs conceded per over by each bowler across different phases of the innings (powerplay, middle, death).
structure: Uses a CTE to categorize overs into 'Powerplay', 'Middle', and 'Death' phases and aggregates runs per over by bowler. The main query then calculates the average runs conceded for each phase using conditional aggregation, grouping by bowler.
sql: WITH MaxOver AS ( SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_innings_over FROM df ) SELECT d.bowler, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_powerplay, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT max_innings_over FROM MaxOver) - 20 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > 6 AND CEIL(d.overs) <= (SELECT max_innings_over FROM MaxOver) - 20 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_middle, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_innings_over FROM MaxOver) - 20 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (SELECT max_innings_over FROM MaxOver) - 20 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END), 0), 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_death_overs FROM df AS d GROUP BY d.bowler ORDER BY d.bowler;

intent: Examine the frequency of boundaries hit by batsmen after facing a certain number of dot balls.
structure: Uses a CTE to mark balls as 'dot' or 'boundary'. Another CTE uses a window function to count consecutive dot balls and cumulative boundaries faced by each batsman, ordered by 'overs'. The final query calculates the average number of dot balls faced before each boundary hit by a batsman.
sql:
WITH batsman_ball_seq AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        LAG(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_runs,
        LAG(batsman_fours, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_fours,
        LAG(batsman_sixes, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_batsman_sixes
    FROM
        df
),
ball_outcomes AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        -- A previous ball was a dot if prev_batsman_runs was 0 and it actually existed (not NULL for the first ball)
        (prev_batsman_runs = 0 AND prev_batsman_runs IS NOT NULL) AS is_prev_ball_dot,
        -- The current ball is a boundary if batsman_fours or batsman_sixes is greater than 0
        (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) AS is_current_ball_boundary
    FROM
        batsman_ball_seq
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_prev_ball_dot AND is_current_ball_boundary THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_prev_ball_dot THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_frequency_after_dot
FROM
    ball_outcomes
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_prev_ball_dot AND is_current_ball_boundary THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5

intent: Calculate the strike rate of batsmen during death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use a CTE to define death overs. Calculate overall strike rate and death overs strike rate by summing runs and dividing by summing balls faced, grouped by batsman. Use CASE expressions to differentiate runs and balls in death overs. Use ORDER BY for analysis.
sql:
WITH death_overs_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM death_overs_stats
WHERE
  death_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_runs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_runs) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_run_percentage_middle
FROM df
WHERE
  ceil(overs) > 6 AND ceil(overs) <= 15
GROUP BY
  batsman

  SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 10
ORDER BY
  boundary_run_percentage_middle DESC;

intent: Calculate the average strike rate of batsmen in the first 6 overs (powerplay) and the subsequent overs (middle and death).
structure: Use a CASE expression to divide the deliveries into 'powerplay' (first 6 overs) and 'other' overs. Calculate the strike rate for each batsman within these two phases by summing runs and dividing by summing balls faced. Group by batsman.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_powerplay,
  CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_other_overs
FROM df
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5 OR SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5
ORDER BY
  strike_rate_powerplay DESC;

intent: Calculate the conversion rate of boundaries to runs for batsmen during the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use a CASE expression to filter for death overs. Calculate the total runs scored from boundaries (fours and sixes) and the total runs scored by each batsman in these overs. Then, calculate the conversion rate (boundary runs / total runs). Group by batsman.
sql:
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN (batsman_fours * 4 + batsman_sixes * 6) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS boundary_run_conversion_rate_death_overs
FROM df
WHERE
  ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5
GROUP BY
  batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN ceil(overs) > (SELECT max(ceil(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) > 10
ORDER BY
  boundary_run_conversion_rate_death_overs DESC;

intent: Investigate the most effective opening batsmen by calculating their average runs scored per innings across all their innings.
structure: This query will calculate the total runs scored by each batsman and the total number of innings they have played. An inning is defined by a unique combination of batsman and the start of an over. It will then compute the average runs per inning. intent: Analyze the momentum of boundary scoring by calculating the average number of dot balls faced by a batsman before hitting their first boundary (four or six) in their innings.
structure: Use CTEs to identify dot balls and boundary balls. Then, use window functions to count consecutive dot balls and boundaries. Finally, calculate the average of consecutive dot balls preceding each boundary for each batsman. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH BallEvents AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        (CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_dot_ball,
        (CASE WHEN (batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_boundary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS delivery_order
    FROM
        df
),
CalculatedSegments AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        is_boundary,
        delivery_order,
        MAX(CASE WHEN is_boundary = 1 THEN delivery_order ELSE NULL END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY batsman 
            ORDER BY delivery_order 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS last_boundary_delivery_order
    FROM
        BallEvents
),
DotCountsBeforeBoundary AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        is_boundary,
        SUM(is_dot_ball) OVER (
            PARTITION BY batsman, last_boundary_delivery_order 
            ORDER BY delivery_order
        ) AS dot_balls_before_current_boundary
    FROM
        CalculatedSegments
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    AVG(dot_balls_before_current_boundary) AS avg_dot_balls_before_boundary
FROM
    DotCountsBeforeBoundary
WHERE
    is_boundary = 1
GROUP BY
    batsman
ORDER BY
    batsman;

structure: Use a CTE to define the 'death overs' phase based on `CEIL(overs)`. Then, calculate overall and death overs strike rates using conditional aggregation. Group by batsman.
sql:
WITH BallNumbers AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        CAST(FLOOR(overs) * 6 + ROUND((overs - FLOOR(overs)) * 10) AS INTEGER) AS ball_number
    FROM df
),
MatchInfo AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(ball_number) AS max_ball_number
    FROM BallNumbers
),
BatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT
        bn.batsman,
        SUM(bn.batsman_runs) AS total_runs_scored,
        SUM(bn.batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bn.ball_number >= (mi.max_ball_number - 19) THEN bn.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bn.ball_number >= (mi.max_ball_number - 19) THEN bn.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_overs_balls_faced
    FROM BallNumbers bn
    CROSS JOIN MatchInfo mi
    GROUP BY bn.batsman
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    total_runs_scored * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_balls_faced, 0) AS overall_strike_rate,
    death_overs_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(death_overs_balls_faced, 0) AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM BatsmanStats
WHERE total_balls_faced > 10
  AND death_overs_balls_faced >= 1;

intent: Analyze the trend of dot ball percentage conceded by bowlers over different phases of an innings (e.g., powerplay, middle, death).
structure: Use a CASE statement to define innings phases based on `CEIL(overs)`. Calculate total balls bowled, dot balls faced, and dot ball percentage for each bowler within each phase. Group by bowler and phase.
sql:
WITH phase_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    CASE 
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball,
    1 AS total_balls_bowled
  FROM df
)
SELECT 
  bowler,
  phase,
  SUM(is_dot_ball) AS total_dot_balls,
  SUM(total_balls_bowled) AS total_balls_bowled_in_phase,
  CASE WHEN SUM(total_balls_bowled) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(is_dot_ball) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(total_balls_bowled) ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage
FROM phase_analysis
GROUP BY bowler, phase
ORDER BY bowler, 
  CASE phase
    WHEN 'Powerplay' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Middle Overs' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Death Overs' THEN 3
  END;

intent: Determine the average number of runs conceded by bowlers per over in the initial phase (first 6 overs) versus the death overs (last 6 overs).
structure: Create a CTE that categorizes each over into 'Initial' or 'Death' based on CEIL(overs). Then, group by bowler and this phase, calculating the average team runs conceded. Use CASE statements for phase definition and averaging.
sql:
WITH MaxOverNumber AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_ceil_over
    FROM df
),
InitialPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS initial_runs,
        SUM(bowler_bowls_done) AS initial_balls
    FROM df
    WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 6
    GROUP BY bowler
    HAVING SUM(bowler_bowls_done) > 0
),
DeathPhaseStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler,
        SUM(d.bowler_runs_given) AS death_runs,
        SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done) AS death_balls
    FROM df AS d
    CROSS JOIN MaxOverNumber AS mo
    WHERE CEIL(d.overs) > (mo.max_ceil_over - 6)
    GROUP BY d.bowler
    HAVING SUM(d.bowler_bowls_done) > 0
)
SELECT
    ips.bowler,
    (ips.initial_runs * 6.0) / NULLIF(ips.initial_balls, 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_initial,
    (dps.death_runs * 6.0) / NULLIF(dps.death_balls, 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_death
FROM InitialPhaseStats AS ips
JOIN DeathPhaseStats AS dps
    ON ips.bowler = dps.bowler
ORDER BY ips.bowler;

WITH batsman_boundary_overs AS (

intent: Identify the batsmen who score the most runs per ball faced in overs where they hit a boundary immediately after facing a dot ball.
structure: Uses CTEs and window functions (`LAG`) to identify sequences of dot ball followed by a boundary for each batsman. Filters for these sequences and calculates runs per ball faced.
sql:
WITH PlayerDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        overs,
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_fours,
        batsman_sixes,
        batsman_bowls_faced,
        LAG(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_ball_runs,
        LAG(batsman_fours, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_ball_fours,
        LAG(batsman_sixes, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_ball_sixes,
        LAG(batsman_runs, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS prev_prev_ball_runs
    FROM
        df
),
QualifiedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        batsman_runs,
        batsman_bowls_faced
    FROM
        PlayerDeliveries
    WHERE
        prev_prev_ball_runs = 0
        AND (prev_ball_fours > 0 OR prev_ball_sixes > 0)
        AND batsman_bowls_faced > 0
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS runs_per_ball_after_dot_boundary
FROM
    QualifiedDeliveries
GROUP BY
    batsman
HAVING
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
ORDER BY
    runs_per_ball_after_dot_boundary DESC;

SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_first_6_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM df
GROUP BY batsman
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate_first_6_overs DESC;

intent: Analyze the scoring rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall scoring rate.

sql:
WITH batsman_phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS death_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS death_balls,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM batsman_phase_stats
WHERE
  total_balls > 0 AND death_balls > 0
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Analyze the variation in batsman strike rates across different phases of an innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Use a CTE to define innings phases based on `CEIL(overs)`. Group by batsman and phase to calculate strike rate (runs/balls). Present results wide by phase.
sql:
WITH OverPhases AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Early'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle'
      ELSE 'Late'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN batsman_runs ELSE NULL END) AS early_runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS early_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Early' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS early_strike_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN batsman_runs ELSE NULL END) AS middle_runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS middle_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS middle_strike_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN batsman_runs ELSE NULL END) AS late_runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS late_balls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Late' THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late_strike_rate
FROM OverPhases
GROUP BY batsman
ORDER BY batsman;

WITH BowlerOverStats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
    SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS runs_in_over,
    SUM(bowler_wickets) AS wickets_in_over
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, CEIL(overs)
  HAVING SUM(bowler_wickets) > 0
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(runs_in_over) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wickets_in_over), 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_per_wicket
FROM BowlerOverStats
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY avg_runs_conceded_per_wicket DESC;

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls faced by any batsman.
structure: Use CTEs to identify dot balls and then calculate consecutive dot ball streaks using window functions.
sql:
WITH BallDetails AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
    FROM
        df
),
GroupStarts AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        CASE
            WHEN is_dot_ball = 1 AND LAG(is_dot_ball, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_dot_sequence_flag
    FROM
        BallDetails
),
GroupIDs AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        is_dot_ball,
        SUM(new_dot_sequence_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS dot_sequence_group_id
    FROM
        GroupStarts
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    MAX(consecutive_dot_balls) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        dot_sequence_group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS consecutive_dot_balls
    FROM
        GroupIDs
    WHERE
        is_dot_ball = 1
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        dot_sequence_group_id
) AS DotBallCounts
GROUP BY
    batsman

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen specifically on deliveries where they faced a dot ball on the previous delivery.
structure: Group by batsman, use a window function to look at the previous ball's outcome (dot or not), filter for current balls that are boundaries and previous balls that were dots, then calculate strike rate (runs/balls) for these specific instances.
sql:
WITH lagged_data AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    LAG(batsman_runs, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS previous_ball_runs
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  SUM(batsman_runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(batsman_bowls_faced), 0) AS strike_rate_after_dot
FROM lagged_data
WHERE
  previous_ball_runs = 0
  AND batsman_runs > 0
GROUP BY
  batsman
ORDER BY

intent: Identify batsmen who have a higher strike rate in the death overs compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use CTEs to calculate overall strike rate and death over strike rate for each batsman, then compare them.
sql:
WITH batsman_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls
  FROM df
  GROUP BY
    batsman
),
death_over_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
  FROM df
  WHERE
    CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY
    batsman
)
SELECT
  bs.batsman,
  CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(bs.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / bs.total_balls ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate,
  CASE WHEN dos.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(dos.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / dos.death_balls ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM batsman_stats bs
JOIN death_over_stats dos
  ON bs.batsman = dos.batsman
WHERE
  CASE WHEN dos.death_balls > 0 THEN CAST(dos.death_runs AS REAL) * 100 / dos.death_balls ELSE 0 END > CASE WHEN bs.total_balls > 0 THEN CAST(bs.total_runs AS REAL) * 100 / bs.total_balls ELSE 0 END
ORDER BY
  death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Assess the momentum of a batsman by comparing their strike rate in the first half of their innings versus the second half.
structure: Use a CTE to assign a delivery index and calculate the total deliveries for each batsman. Determine the halfway point for each batsman. Use another CTE to calculate strike rates for the first and second halves by joining with the first CTE and using conditional aggregation.
sql:
WITH batsman_deliveries_indexed AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    overs,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS cumulative_balls_faced
  FROM df
),
batsman_innings_halves AS (
  SELECT
    bdi.batsman,
    bdi.batsman_runs,
    bdi.batsman_bowls_faced,
    bdi.cumulative_balls_faced,
    MAX(bdi.cumulative_balls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY bdi.batsman) AS total_balls_faced_batsman,
    CEIL(MAX(bdi.cumulative_balls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY bdi.batsman) / 2.0) AS halfway_point
  FROM batsman_deliveries_indexed AS bdi
)
SELECT
  bih.batsman,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN bih.cumulative_balls_faced <= bih.halfway_point THEN bih.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN bih.cumulative_balls_faced <= bih.halfway_point THEN bih.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS first_half_strike_rate,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN bih.cumulative_balls_faced > bih.halfway_point THEN bih.batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN bih.cumulative_balls_faced > bih.halfway_point THEN bih.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END), 0) AS second_half_strike_rate
FROM batsman_innings_halves AS bih
GROUP BY
  bih.batsman
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN bih.cumulative_balls_faced <= bih.halfway_point THEN bih.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN bih.cumulative_balls_faced > bih.halfway_point THEN bih.batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 5
ORDER BY
  second_half_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of batsmen in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Use CTEs to define overall and death over metrics. Calculate strike rates using SUM(batsman_runs) / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced). Group by batsman. Compare overall vs. death over strike rates.
sql:
WITH batsman_overall_sr AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
batsman_death_sr AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    CASE WHEN SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS death_over_strike_rate
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  bosr.batsman,
  bosr.overall_strike_rate,
  COALESCE(bdsr.death_over_strike_rate, 0) AS death_over_strike_rate
FROM batsman_overall_sr AS bosr
LEFT JOIN batsman_death_sr AS bdsr ON bosr.batsman = bdsr.batsman
ORDER BY bosr.overall_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Determine the average runs conceded by each bowler in the powerplay (first 6 overs) vs. death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use CASE statements to define 'powerplay' and 'death overs' phases based on CEIL(overs). Calculate average runs conceded per over for each phase. Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH max_over AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_num
    FROM df
),
bowler_phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS pp_runs_conceded,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS pp_balls_bowled,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (mo.max_over_num - 5) THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS do_runs_conceded,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > (mo.max_over_num - 5) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS do_balls_bowled
    FROM df AS d, max_over AS mo
    GROUP BY d.bowler
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    CAST(pp_runs_conceded AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(pp_balls_bowled AS REAL) / 6.0, 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_powerplay,
    CAST(do_runs_conceded AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(do_balls_bowled AS REAL) / 6.0, 0) AS avg_runs_conceded_death
FROM bowler_phase_stats
WHERE pp_balls_bowled >= 6 AND do_balls_bowled >= 6
ORDER BY bowler;

intent: Calculate the percentage of dot balls bowled by each bowler in the first 6 overs, middle overs (overs 7-15), and death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Use CTEs to define over phases using CASE and CEIL(overs). Calculate dot balls and total deliveries for each phase. Compute dot ball percentage using division and CASE for zero total deliveries. Group by bowler and phase.
sql:
WITH phase_dot_balls AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
      ELSE 'Death Overs'
    END AS phase,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls,
    COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler, phase
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  phase,
  CASE
    WHEN total_deliveries > 0 THEN CAST(dot_balls AS REAL) * 100 / total_deliveries
    ELSE 0
  END AS dot_ball_percentage
FROM phase_dot_balls
WHERE phase IN ('Powerplay', 'Middle Overs', 'Death Overs')
ORDER BY bowler, CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN 1 WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN 2 WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;

intent: Find the maximum number of consecutive dot balls faced by each batsman.
structure: Use CTEs to identify dot balls. Use a window function to calculate consecutive dot ball streaks. Group by batsman and find the maximum streak.
sql:
WITH BallGroups AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        -- Assign a group ID to consecutive sequences of dot balls.
        -- The SUM increments whenever a non-dot ball (batsman_runs > 0) occurs.
        -- This means all consecutive dot balls between two non-dot balls (or start/end) will share the same group_id.
        SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) AS group_id
    FROM
        df
),
ConsecutiveDotBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS current_consecutive_dot_balls
    FROM
        BallGroups
    WHERE
        batsman_runs = 0 -- Filter to include only dot balls
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        group_id
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    MAX(current_consecutive_dot_balls) AS max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM
    ConsecutiveDotBalls
GROUP BY
    batsman
ORDER BY
    max_consecutive_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Analyze the strike rate of a batsman in the death overs (last 5 overs) compared to their overall strike rate.
structure: Calculate overall strike rate and death over strike rate for each batsman using CTEs. Compare these two metrics.
sql:
WITH MaxOverNum AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over_val
    FROM df
),
DeathOversBoundary AS (
    SELECT max_over_val - 5 AS death_overs_start_threshold
    FROM MaxOverNum
),
BatsmenWhoBowledInDeathOvers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bowler AS player_name
    FROM
        df AS d,
        DeathOversBoundary AS dob
    WHERE
        CEIL(d.overs) > dob.death_overs_start_threshold AND
        d.bowler_bowls_done > 0
),
OverallBatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS overall_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS overall_balls_faced
    FROM
        df
    GROUP BY
        batsman
),
DeathOversBatsmanStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS death_overs_runs,
        SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_overs_balls_faced
    FROM
        df AS d,
        DeathOversBoundary AS dob
    WHERE
        CEIL(d.overs) > dob.death_overs_start_threshold
    GROUP BY
        d.batsman
)
SELECT
    obs.batsman,
    (CAST(obs.overall_runs AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(obs.overall_balls_faced, 0) AS overall_strike_rate,
    (CAST(dobs.death_overs_runs AS REAL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(dobs.death_overs_balls_faced, 0) AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM
    OverallBatsmanStats AS obs
JOIN
    DeathOversBatsmanStats AS dobs ON obs.batsman = dobs.batsman
WHERE
    obs.batsman IN (SELECT player_name FROM BatsmenWhoBowledInDeathOvers)
    AND obs.overall_balls_faced > 0
    AND dobs.death_overs_balls_faced > 0
ORDER BY
    death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

sql:

  SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS total_runs_conceded,
  COUNT(overs) AS total_balls_bowled,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(overs) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(bowler_runs_given) AS REAL) / COUNT(overs) ELSE 0 END AS economy_rate

sql:
WITH InningsEnd AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CEIL(overs)) as max_over
  FROM df
),
DeathOverBalls AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM InningsEnd) - 2 THEN bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS death_runs_given,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM InningsEnd) - 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS death_balls_bowled
  FROM df
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN death_balls_bowled > 0 THEN CAST(death_runs_given AS REAL) / death_balls_bowled ELSE 0 END AS runs_per_ball_death_overs
FROM DeathOverBalls
WHERE death_balls_bowled > 0
ORDER BY runs_per_ball_death_overs DESC
LIMIT 5;

structure: Use a CTE to split each batsman's innings into two phases: first 10 overs (using CEIL(overs)) and the rest. Aggregate runs and balls faced for each phase. Calculate strike rate for each phase. Finally, present both strike rates for each batsman.
sql:
WITH batsman_innings_splits AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_first_10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_first_10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_rest,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(overs) > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS balls_rest
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  CASE WHEN balls_first_10 >= 1 THEN CAST(runs_first_10 AS REAL) * 100 / balls_first_10 ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_first_10_overs,
  CASE WHEN balls_rest >= 1 THEN CAST(runs_rest AS REAL) * 100 / balls_rest ELSE 0 END AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM batsman_innings_splits
WHERE balls_first_10 >= 1 OR balls_rest >= 1
ORDER BY strike_rate_rest_of_innings DESC;

intent: Analyze bowler boundary concession trends. Calculate the percentage of boundaries conceded by each bowler in the death overs (last 5 overs). This helps identify bowlers who struggle to prevent boundary scoring at the end of the innings.
structure: Use a CTE to determine the last 5 overs of the match. Filter deliveries to include only those in the death overs. Calculate the total number of boundaries conceded and the total number of deliveries bowled by each bowler in these overs. Compute the boundary concession percentage.
sql:
WITH InningsEnd AS (
  SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_over FROM df
),
DeathOvers AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS boundaries_conceded,
    COUNT(overs) AS total_balls_in_death
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT max_over FROM InningsEnd) - 5
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN total_balls_in_death > 0 THEN CAST(boundaries_conceded AS REAL) * 100 / total_balls_in_death ELSE 0 END AS boundary_concession_percentage_death
FROM DeathOvers
ORDER BY boundary_concession_percentage_death DESC;

intent: Assess bowler's effectiveness in non-death vs death overs. Calculate the wickets per ball and runs per ball (economy rate) for each bowler in both the 'non-death' (first X overs) and 'death' (last 5 overs) periods of the innings.
structure: Define 'death overs' as the last 5 overs using a subquery for the max over. For each bowler, calculate wickets and runs given in death overs and non-death overs. Then, calculate wickets per ball and economy rate for both periods.
sql:
WITH MaxOver AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_ov FROM df
),
BowlerStats AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= mo.max_ov - 5 THEN d.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_wickets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= mo.max_ov - 5 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_bowls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) <= mo.max_ov - 5 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS non_death_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > mo.max_ov - 5 THEN d.bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS death_wickets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > mo.max_ov - 5 THEN d.bowler_bowls_done ELSE 0 END) AS death_bowls,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CEIL(d.overs) > mo.max_ov - 5 THEN d.bowler_runs_given ELSE 0 END) AS death_runs
    FROM
        df AS d
    CROSS JOIN MaxOver AS mo
    GROUP BY
        d.bowler
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    CAST(non_death_wickets AS REAL) / NULLIF(non_death_bowls, 0) AS wickets_per_ball_non_death,
    CAST(non_death_runs AS REAL) / NULLIF(non_death_bowls / 6.0, 0) AS economy_rate_non_death,
    CAST(death_wickets AS REAL) / NULLIF(death_bowls, 0) AS wickets_per_ball_death,
    CAST(death_runs AS REAL) / NULLIF(death_bowls / 6.0, 0) AS economy_rate_death
FROM
    BowlerStats
WHERE
    non_death_bowls > 0 AND death_bowls > 0
ORDER BY
    wickets_per_ball_death DESC;

intent: Compare the strike rate of Batsman 'A' against Bowler 'B' in the first 10 overs versus the rest of the innings. This will highlight any significant variations in their head-to-head performance based on match stage.
structure: Use a CTE to filter deliveries for a specific batsman and bowler. Then, use CASE statements on CEIL(overs) to calculate runs scored and balls faced in the first 10 overs and the rest of the innings. Finally, calculate and display the strike rate for both phases.
sql:
WITH BatsmanBowlerSpecific AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    bowler,
    batsman_runs,
    batsman_bowls_faced,
    CEIL(overs) AS over_no
  FROM df
  WHERE batsman = 'Head' AND bowler = 'Fazalhaq Farooqi'
)
SELECT
  batsman,
  bowler,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0 
  END AS strike_rate_first_10_overs,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 
    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0 
  END AS strike_rate_rest_of_innings
FROM BatsmanBowlerSpecific
GROUP BY batsman, bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN over_no <= 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN over_no > 10 THEN batsman_bowls_faced ELSE 0 END) > 0;

WITH batsman_overall_sr AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    CASE WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS overall_strike_rate
  FROM df
  GROUP BY batsman
),
death_overs_sr AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    CASE WHEN sum(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0 THEN CAST(sum(batsman_runs) AS REAL) * 100 / sum(batsman_bowls_faced) ELSE 0 END AS death_overs_strike_rate
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5

)

  bos.batsman,
  bos.overall_strike_rate,
  COALESCE(dos.death_overs_strike_rate, 0) AS death_overs_strike_rate
FROM batsman_overall_sr AS bos

ORDER BY death_overs_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Track the cumulative number of dot balls faced by a batsman throughout an innings, showing their streak progression.
structure: Use a CTE to identify dot balls. Use a window function to calculate the cumulative count of dot balls faced by each batsman, ordered by 'overs'.
sql:
WITH dot_balls AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dot_ball
  FROM df
),
cumulative_dots AS (
  SELECT 
    batsman,
    overs,
    SUM(is_dot_ball) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_dot_balls_faced
  FROM dot_balls
)
SELECT 
  batsman,
  overs,
  cumulative_dot_balls_faced
FROM cumulative_dots
ORDER BY batsman, overs;

intent: Analyze the trend of a batsman's strike rate over the course of an innings, specifically looking at how it changes from the first 5 overs to the death overs (last 10 overs).
structure: Calculate strike rates for a batsman in two distinct phases of the innings (first 5 overs and last 10 overs) using CTEs and CASE expressions for phase definition. Group by batsman and use conditional aggregation for strike rate calculation in each phase. Requires subqueries to determine the maximum over number for phase definition.
sql:
WITH max_over_val AS (
    SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) AS max_o FROM df
),
early_phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS early_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS early_balls
    FROM df
    WHERE CEIL(overs) <= 5
    GROUP BY batsman
    HAVING SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
),
death_phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.batsman,
        SUM(d.batsman_runs) AS death_runs,
        SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) AS death_balls
    FROM df AS d, max_over_val AS m
    WHERE CEIL(d.overs) > (m.max_o - 10)
    GROUP BY d.batsman
    HAVING SUM(d.batsman_bowls_faced) > 0
)
SELECT
    e.batsman,
    CAST(e.early_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(e.early_balls, 0) AS early_strike_rate,
    CAST(d.death_runs AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.death_balls, 0) AS death_strike_rate
FROM early_phase_stats AS e
JOIN death_phase_stats AS d
    ON e.batsman = d.batsman
ORDER BY early_strike_rate DESC;

intent: Analyze the change in a batsman's scoring rate from the powerplay overs to the middle overs.
structure: Define over phases (powerplay, middle overs) using CASE expressions based on CEIL(overs). Calculate total runs and total balls faced for each batsman within each phase. Compute runs per over for each phase using conditional aggregation. Uses CTEs.
sql:
WITH BattingStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CASE
            WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
            WHEN CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15 THEN 'Middle Overs'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS phase,
        SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
        SUM(batsman_bowls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM
        df
    WHERE
        (CEIL(overs) <= 6) OR (CEIL(overs) > 6 AND CEIL(overs) <= 15)
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        phase
),
PivotedStats AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS pp_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS pp_balls_faced,
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_runs ELSE 0 END) AS mo_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' THEN total_balls_faced ELSE 0 END) AS mo_balls_faced
    FROM
        BattingStats
    GROUP BY
        batsman
    HAVING
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' AND total_balls_faced > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND
        SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Middle Overs' AND total_balls_faced > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    pp_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(pp_balls_faced, 0) AS runs_per_ball_powerplay,
    mo_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(mo_balls_faced, 0) AS runs_per_ball_middle
FROM
    PivotedStats
ORDER BY
    runs_per_ball_powerplay DESC;

intent: Determine the average number of runs scored per over in each phase of the innings (early, middle, late).
structure: Uses a CASE expression to categorize each over into 'Early', 'Middle', or 'Late' phases based on CEIL(overs). Calculates the average of `team_runs` for each phase. Groups the results by phase.
sql:
WITH OverRuns AS (
    SELECT
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(team_runs) AS runs_in_over
    FROM df
    GROUP BY
        CEIL(overs)
),
PhasedOverRuns AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN over_number <= 6 THEN 'Early'
            WHEN over_number > 6 AND over_number <= 15 THEN 'Middle'
            ELSE 'Late'
        END AS phase,
        runs_in_over
    FROM OverRuns
)
SELECT
    phase,
    AVG(runs_in_over) AS average_runs_per_over
FROM PhasedOverRuns
GROUP BY
    phase
ORDER BY
    CASE phase WHEN 'Early' THEN 1 WHEN 'Middle' THEN 2 WHEN 'Late' THEN 3 END;

sql:
WITH batsman_over_boundaries AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        CEIL(overs) AS over_number,
        SUM(batsman_fours + batsman_sixes) AS boundaries_in_over
    FROM df

intent: Calculate the average runs conceded per over by bowlers in different phases of the innings.
structure: A CTE is used to assign each over to an innings phase (Powerplay, Middle Overs, Death Overs). The main query then calculates the average `team_runs` for each phase, providing the average runs conceded per over for each phase across all bowlers.
sql:
with over_phases as (
    select
        case
            when ceil(overs) <= 6 then 'Powerplay'
            when ceil(overs) > 6 and ceil(overs) <= 15 then 'Middle Overs'
            else 'Death Overs'
        end as phase,
        team_runs
    from df
)
select
    phase,
    avg(team_runs) as average_runs_per_over
from over_phases
where phase is not null
group by phase
order by
    case phase when 'Powerplay' then 1 when 'Middle Overs' then 2 when 'Death Overs' then 3 else 4 end;

intent: Identify batsmen who have experienced long streaks of consecutive dot balls.
structure: This query first identifies dot balls delivery by delivery using a `CASE` expression. It then uses window functions (`ROW_NUMBER`, `SUM` with `ROWS BETWEEN`) within a CTE to calculate the length of consecutive dot ball streaks for each batsman. The final query filters for batsmen with streaks longer than a specified threshold and orders them by the maximum streak length found.
sql:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as rn_batsman_overall
    FROM
        df
),
GroupedDotBalls AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        -- Identify the start of a new dot ball streak:
        -- It's a dot ball (batsman_runs = 0) AND
        -- either it's the first ball for the batsman (LAG returns default value 1, which means not a dot ball)
        -- or the previous ball was not a dot ball (LAG(batsman_runs) != 0).
        CASE
            WHEN batsman_runs = 0 AND LAG(batsman_runs, 1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) != 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_streak_start
    FROM
        RankedBalls
),
StreakIDs AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        overs,
        batsman_runs,
        -- Assign a unique ID to each consecutive streak of dot balls for a batsman.
        -- This ID increments only when a new streak starts (is_streak_start = 1).
        SUM(is_streak_start) OVER (PARTITION BY batsman ORDER BY overs) as streak_id
    FROM
        GroupedDotBalls
),
ConsecutiveDotStreaks AS (
    SELECT
        batsman,
        streak_id,
        COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM
        StreakIDs
    WHERE
        batsman_runs = 0 -- Only count actual dot balls for the streak length
    GROUP BY
        batsman,
        streak_id
)
SELECT
    batsman,
    MAX(streak_length) as max_consecutive_dot_balls
FROM
    ConsecutiveDotStreaks
WHERE
    streak_length > 5 -- Filter for streaks longer than 5 balls
GROUP BY
    batsman
ORDER BY
    max_consecutive_dot_balls DESC;

intent: Determine the dot ball percentage for each bowler in the death overs (last 5 overs) of the match.
structure: CTE to define death overs and count dot balls, then calculate percentage. Group by bowler.
sql:
WITH death_over_balls AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls_in_death_overs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS non_dot_balls_in_death_overs, 
    COUNT(*) AS total_balls_in_death_overs
  FROM df
  WHERE CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CASE WHEN total_balls_in_death_overs > 0 THEN CAST(dot_balls_in_death_overs AS REAL) * 100.0 / total_balls_in_death_overs ELSE 0 END AS dot_ball_percentage_in_death_overs
FROM death_over_balls
WHERE total_balls_in_death_overs > 0
ORDER BY dot_ball_percentage_in_death_overs DESC;

intent: Show the percentage of balls a batsman faced that resulted in boundaries (fours or sixes), comparing their performance against a specific bowler versus all other bowlers.
structure: CTE to identify boundary balls, then conditional aggregation to calculate percentages against specific and other bowlers, grouped by batsman and bowler.
sql:
WITH boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    batsman,
    bowler,
    overs,
    CASE WHEN batsman_fours > 0 OR batsman_sixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_boundary,
    CASE WHEN batsman_bowls_faced > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_faced
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  b.batsman,
  b.bowler,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowler = 'Fazalhaq Farooqi' AND b.is_faced = 1 THEN b.is_boundary ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowler = 'Fazalhaq Farooqi' AND b.is_faced = 1 THEN b.is_boundary ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowler = 'Fazalhaq Farooqi' AND b.is_faced = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_vs_fazalhaq,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowler != 'Fazalhaq Farooqi' AND b.is_faced = 1 THEN b.is_boundary ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowler != 'Fazalhaq Farooqi' AND b.is_faced = 1 THEN b.is_boundary ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN b.bowler != 'Fazalhaq Farooqi' AND b.is_faced = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS boundary_percentage_vs_others
FROM boundaries b
WHERE b.batsman = 'MW Short'
GROUP BY b.batsman, b.bowler
ORDER BY b.batsman, b.bowler;

intent: Analyze the wicket-taking effectiveness of bowlers in the first 6 overs (powerplay) compared to the death overs (last 5 overs).
structure: Uses CTEs to define over phases (powerplay and death overs), then groups by bowler to count wickets in each phase and calculates the ratio of wickets taken in death overs to powerplay overs. Uses CTEs and CASE for phase definition, aggregation, and ratio calculation.
sql:
WITH over_phases AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    bowler_wickets,
    CASE
      WHEN CEIL(overs) <= 6 THEN 'Powerplay'
      WHEN CEIL(overs) > (SELECT MAX(CEIL(overs)) FROM df) - 5 THEN 'Death Overs'
      ELSE 'Middle Overs'
    END AS phase
  FROM df
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_powerplay,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_death_overs,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Death Overs' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'Powerplay' THEN bowler_wickets ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS death_to_powerplay_wicket_ratio
FROM over_phases
WHERE
  phase IN ('Powerplay', 'Death Overs')
GROUP BY
  bowler
HAVING
  wickets_in_powerplay > 0 OR wickets_in_death_overs > 0
ORDER BY
  death_to_powerplay_wicket_ratio DESC;
